project.name: iceberg
project.description: Apache Iceberg 1.12.0: an open table format for huge analytic tables. This graph covers the Java API (api/src/main) and the core implementation (core/src/main): table metadata, snapshots, manifests, scan planning, commit and catalog logic, and the REST catalog.

nodes.name: FileContent.java
nodes.summary: Enum of the three kinds of content a content file can hold (DATA, POSITION_DELETES, EQUALITY_DELETES), with integer ids used in manifests and a lookup from id.

nodes.name: FileContent
nodes.summary: Enum constants DATA, POSITION_DELETES and EQUALITY_DELETES with id() and a static fromId lookup.

nodes.name: FileFormat.java
nodes.summary: Enum of supported file formats (ORC, PARQUET, AVRO, PUFFIN, METADATA) with extension handling and helpers to resolve a format from a file name or string.
nodes.languageNotes: Java enum with a constructor-bound extension and static lookup helpers; fromFileName does a case-insensitive suffix match using Comparators.charSequences().

nodes.name: FileFormat
nodes.summary: Enum of file formats carrying their extension, with isSplittable, addExtension and static resolvers from file name or string.

nodes.name: addExtension
nodes.summary: Appends this format's extension to a filename if it is not already present.

nodes.name: fromFileName
nodes.summary: Resolves the FileFormat whose extension matches the end of a file name, case-insensitively, or returns null.

nodes.name: Files.java
nodes.summary: Static factory for local-filesystem InputFile and OutputFile implementations, including seekable input and position-tracking output streams backed by java.io.File.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses private static nested classes (LocalInputFile, LocalOutputFile, SeekableFileInputStream, PositionFileOutputStream) to hide implementations behind the io interfaces.

nodes.name: Files
nodes.summary: Static factory with localInput and localOutput overloads for java.io.File backed Iceberg files.

nodes.name: Metrics.java
nodes.summary: Serializable holder of per-file metrics (record count, column sizes, value/null/NaN counts, lower/upper bounds) with custom Java serialization for the ByteBuffer bound maps.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements Serializable and overrides writeObject/readObject because ByteBuffer is not serializable; bounds are converted to byte arrays.

nodes.name: Metrics
nodes.summary: Serializable bundle of per-file metrics maps keyed by column id, with six constructors and custom ByteBuffer serialization.

nodes.name: writeObject
nodes.summary: Custom serialization hook that writes the metrics fields, converting ByteBuffer bound maps to byte arrays.

nodes.name: writeByteBufferMap
nodes.summary: Writes a Map of ByteBuffer values as an int-keyed map of byte arrays.

nodes.name: readObject
nodes.summary: Custom deserialization hook that restores the metrics fields and rebuilds the ByteBuffer bound maps.

nodes.name: readByteBufferMap
nodes.summary: Reads a serialized map of byte arrays back into a Map of ByteBuffer values.

nodes.name: EncryptedInputFile.java
nodes.summary: Interface pairing an InputFile holding encrypted bytes with the key metadata needed to decrypt it.

nodes.name: EncryptedInputFile
nodes.summary: Contract exposing the encrypted InputFile and its EncryptionKeyMetadata.

nodes.name: EncryptedOutputFile.java
nodes.summary: Interface pairing an OutputFile that encrypts on write with the EncryptionKeyMetadata produced for it, and exposing the underlying plain output file.

nodes.name: EncryptedOutputFile
nodes.summary: Contract exposing the encrypting OutputFile, its key metadata, and the underlying plain output file.

nodes.name: EncryptingFileIO.java
nodes.summary: FileIO decorator that transparently decrypts inputs and encrypts outputs through an EncryptionManager, with bulk decrypt support and prefix/bulk-operation variants of the wrapper.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses package-private subclasses (WithSupportsPrefixOperations, WithDelegateFileIO) chosen by wrap() so the wrapper exposes only the optional FileIO capabilities the delegate supports.

nodes.name: EncryptingFileIO
nodes.summary: FileIO that routes reads through decryption and writes through encryption using an EncryptionManager, serializable for distributed use.

nodes.name: combine
nodes.summary: Returns an EncryptingFileIO for the given FileIO and EncryptionManager, reusing or re-wrapping an existing one.

nodes.name: bulkDecrypt
nodes.summary: Decrypts a batch of content files at once by delegating to the EncryptionManager and returns input files by location.

nodes.name: close
nodes.summary: Closes the wrapped FileIO and encryption manager, suppressing secondary failures.

nodes.name: EncryptionKeyMetadata.java
nodes.summary: Interface for opaque per-file encryption key metadata, with a shared empty instance and a copy operation.

nodes.name: EncryptionKeyMetadata
nodes.summary: Contract for opaque key metadata bytes with an empty singleton and copy().

nodes.name: NotFoundException.java
nodes.summary: Unchecked exception signalling that a requested resource (such as a file or table) does not exist.

nodes.name: NotFoundException
nodes.summary: RuntimeException subclass with formatted-message constructors, thrown when a resource is missing.

nodes.name: RuntimeIOException.java
nodes.summary: Unchecked wrapper around IOException used throughout Iceberg to rethrow I/O failures without checked exceptions.

nodes.name: RuntimeIOException
nodes.summary: UncheckedIOException subclass with formatted-message constructors used to wrap IOException.

nodes.name: BulkDeletionFailureException.java
nodes.summary: Exception raised when a bulk delete fails for some files, carrying the number of objects that failed.

nodes.name: BulkDeletionFailureException
nodes.summary: RuntimeException reporting how many objects failed in a bulk deletion.

nodes.name: DelegateFileIO.java
nodes.summary: Marker interface combining FileIO with prefix and bulk operations, for FileIO implementations that delegate to an underlying file system.

nodes.name: DelegateFileIO
nodes.summary: Empty interface that composes FileIO, SupportsPrefixOperations and SupportsBulkOperations.

nodes.name: DelegatingInputStream.java
nodes.summary: Interface for input streams that wrap another stream and expose the delegate.

nodes.name: DelegatingInputStream
nodes.summary: Interface exposing the wrapped delegate InputStream.

nodes.name: DelegatingOutputStream.java
nodes.summary: Interface for output streams that wrap another stream and expose the delegate.

nodes.name: DelegatingOutputStream
nodes.summary: Interface exposing the wrapped delegate OutputStream.

nodes.name: FileAppender.java
nodes.summary: Interface for writers that append records to a file, reporting metrics, length and optional split offsets, and providing a default addAll.

nodes.name: FileAppender
nodes.summary: Generic Closeable writer interface with add, metrics, length and splitOffsets plus a default addAll.

nodes.name: FileInfo.java
nodes.summary: Immutable value object describing a listed file by location, size and creation time, returned by prefix listing operations.

nodes.name: FileInfo
nodes.summary: Value class holding a file location, size in bytes and creation time in milliseconds.

nodes.name: InputFile.java
nodes.summary: Interface for a readable file with length, a seekable stream, a location and an existence check.

nodes.name: InputFile
nodes.summary: Readable file abstraction: getLength, newStream, location and exists.

nodes.name: OutputFile.java
nodes.summary: Interface for a writable file that can be created (failing if present) or overwritten, with a convenience conversion to InputFile.

nodes.name: OutputFile
nodes.summary: Writable file abstraction: create, createOrOverwrite, location and toInputFile.

nodes.name: PositionOutputStream.java
nodes.summary: Abstract OutputStream that can report its current write position and the stored length.

nodes.name: PositionOutputStream
nodes.summary: Abstract OutputStream with getPos and a storedLength that defaults to the position.

nodes.name: RangeReadable.java
nodes.summary: Interface for streams supporting positional range reads, including vectorized reads of multiple ranges with a default implementation that sorts and merges them.

nodes.name: RangeReadable
nodes.summary: Interface for positional range reads with default vectored readVectored that sorts ranges and reads each one.

nodes.name: SeekableInputStream.java
nodes.summary: Abstract InputStream that supports seeking and reporting its current position, used for Parquet/Avro-style random access.

nodes.name: SeekableInputStream
nodes.summary: Abstract InputStream with getPos and seek for random access reads.

nodes.name: SupportsPrefixOperations.java
nodes.summary: FileIO extension adding prefix-based listing and recursive deletion of files.

nodes.name: SupportsPrefixOperations
nodes.summary: FileIO extension with listPrefix and deletePrefix for prefix-addressed storage.

nodes.name: BaseRewriteManifests.java
nodes.summary: SnapshotProducer implementing RewriteManifests: clusters live data file entries into new manifests by a user function, keeps delete manifests, and validates file counts before commit.
nodes.languageNotes: Rewrites in parallel using Tasks and a ConcurrentMap of WriterWrapper instances keyed by the cluster value.

nodes.name: BaseRewriteManifests
nodes.summary: Snapshot producer that rewrites and clusters manifests, tracking kept, deleted, added and rewritten manifests and verifying entry counts.

nodes.name: summary
nodes.summary: Builds the snapshot summary with rewrite-specific manifest and entry counters.

nodes.name: addManifest
nodes.summary: Registers a pre-built manifest to be added by the rewrite after validating it has no deletes or snapshot id.

nodes.name: copyManifest
nodes.summary: Copies a manifest into a new file through ManifestFiles.copyRewriteManifest for use in the new snapshot.

nodes.name: apply
nodes.summary: Computes the new manifest list by rewriting matching manifests (if needed) and combining kept, added and new manifests.

nodes.name: requiresRewrite
nodes.summary: Decides whether the existing manifests must be rewritten based on the configured predicate and added/deleted manifests.

nodes.name: performRewrite
nodes.summary: Reads live entries of eligible manifests in parallel via ManifestFiles.read and appends them into cluster-keyed writers.

nodes.name: validateFilesCounts
nodes.summary: Verifies the rewritten manifests hold the same number of data files as the originals, failing the commit otherwise.

nodes.name: DVUtil.java
nodes.summary: Package-private helpers that read deletion vectors from Puffin files, detect multiple DVs referencing the same data file, merge their position indexes and write the merged DVs.
nodes.languageNotes: Reads duplicate DVs in parallel with an ExecutorService through Tasks.range, then writes one Puffin file containing the merged DVs.

nodes.name: DVUtil
nodes.summary: Utility class (private constructor) with static methods for reading, validating, merging and writing deletion vectors.

nodes.name: readDV
nodes.summary: Reads a deletion vector blob from its Puffin file range and deserializes it into a PositionDeleteIndex.

nodes.name: mergeAndWriteDVsIfRequired
nodes.summary: Groups DVs by referenced data file, merges duplicates and writes the merged result, returning valid DVs plus the new ones.

nodes.name: validateCanMerge
nodes.summary: Checks that duplicate DVs share the same partition spec and partition values before merging.

nodes.name: readAndMergeDVs
nodes.summary: Reads duplicate DVs in parallel and unions their position indexes per referenced data file.

nodes.name: writeDVs
nodes.summary: Writes merged position indexes to a single Puffin file via Deletes.writeDVs, encrypting the output when the FileIO is encrypting.

nodes.name: DataFiles.java
nodes.summary: Factory and builder for DataFile instances plus helpers for building and copying partition data from paths or values.

nodes.name: DataFiles
nodes.summary: Utility class with partition-data helpers and a nested Builder for DataFile objects.

nodes.name: copyPartitionData
nodes.summary: Copies partition values from a source StructLike into a target PartitionData for the given spec.

nodes.name: fillFromPath
nodes.summary: Populates PartitionData from a Hive-style partition path such as a=1/b=2 using Conversions.fromPartitionString.

nodes.name: fillFromValues
nodes.summary: Populates PartitionData from a list of string partition values.

nodes.name: fromManifest
nodes.summary: Creates a DataFile describing a manifest file, used to track manifests as data files.

nodes.name: FastAppend.java
nodes.summary: Append operation that adds new data files or manifests in a new snapshot without merging existing manifests, giving fast commits.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements AppendFiles by extending SnapshotProducer<AppendFiles>, using the self-typed generic pattern for fluent API returns.

nodes.name: FastAppend
nodes.summary: Package-private AppendFiles implementation that stages new files and manifests without merging, and cleans up uncommitted manifests.

nodes.name: appendFile
nodes.summary: Adds a data file to the pending append set, de-duplicating by file and invalidating cached manifests.

nodes.name: appendManifest
nodes.summary: Adds a pre-built manifest to the append, copying it when snapshot id inheritance is disabled.

nodes.name: copyManifest
nodes.summary: Copies an appended manifest via ManifestFiles.copyAppendManifest and tracks it for cleanup.

nodes.name: apply
nodes.summary: Builds the new manifest list from newly written manifests, appended manifests and the base snapshot manifests.

nodes.name: cleanUncommitted
nodes.summary: Deletes manifests created for a failed attempt that are not part of the committed set.

nodes.name: writeNewManifests
nodes.summary: Writes the pending data files into a new manifest and caches it for retries.

nodes.name: FileCleanupStrategy.java
nodes.summary: Abstract base for strategies that delete files left unreachable after snapshot expiration, with shared manifest reading, parallel deletion and statistics-file helpers.

nodes.name: FileCleanupStrategy
nodes.summary: Abstract class providing readManifests, deleteFiles and statistics-file location helpers for expiration cleanup strategies.

nodes.name: cleanFiles
nodes.summary: Abstract hook that deletes files reachable only from expired snapshots according to the cleanup level.

nodes.name: readManifests
nodes.summary: Reads the manifest list of a snapshot through InternalData.read with a narrow projection, or falls back to the snapshot's manifests.

nodes.name: deleteFiles
nodes.summary: Deletes a set of file paths using bulk operations when supported, otherwise in parallel with Tasks and retry.

nodes.name: statsFileLocations
nodes.summary: Collects statistics and partition statistics file locations from table metadata.

nodes.name: FileMetadata.java
nodes.summary: Entry point and fluent Builder for creating DeleteFile instances (position deletes, equality deletes, deletion vectors) with format, partition, metrics and key metadata.

nodes.name: FileMetadata
nodes.summary: Holder of the static deleteFileBuilder entry point and the Builder that assembles GenericDeleteFile instances.

nodes.name: InternalData.java
nodes.summary: Registry of read and write builders for Iceberg internal metadata files, with Avro built in and optional Parquet registered reflectively when available.
nodes.languageNotes: Registers the optional iceberg-parquet format reflectively via DynMethods and tolerates NoClassDefFoundError when the module is absent.

nodes.name: InternalData
nodes.summary: Static registry with write and read entry points plus nested WriteBuilder and ReadBuilder interfaces for metadata file formats.

nodes.name: registerSupportedFormats
nodes.summary: Registers the built-in Avro read and write builders and attempts to register Parquet.

nodes.name: write
nodes.summary: Returns the registered WriteBuilder for a format, or throws if the format is not registered.

nodes.name: read
nodes.summary: Returns the registered ReadBuilder for a format, or throws if the format is not registered.

nodes.name: ManifestFiles.java
nodes.summary: Central API for reading, writing and copying manifest files across format versions, including a FileIO-level Caffeine content cache and parallel manifest writing.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a weak-keyed, soft-valued Caffeine cache of ContentCache per FileIO instance.

nodes.name: ManifestFiles
nodes.summary: Utility class offering read, write and copy operations for data and delete manifests plus manifest content cache management.

nodes.name: newManifestCacheBuilder
nodes.summary: Builds the Caffeine cache that maps each FileIO to its ContentCache with weak keys and soft values.

nodes.name: contentCache
nodes.summary: Returns the ContentCache for a FileIO, creating it from configured limits.

nodes.name: dropCache
nodes.summary: Invalidates and cleans up the cached ContentCache for a FileIO.

nodes.name: contentCacheStats
nodes.summary: Returns cache metrics for a FileIO as a CacheMetricsReport.

nodes.name: readPaths
nodes.summary: Reads the data file paths of a data manifest as a CloseableIterable.

nodes.name: read
nodes.summary: Opens a ManifestReader for a data manifest using the given FileIO and spec map.

nodes.name: readDeleteManifest
nodes.summary: Opens a ManifestReader for a delete manifest, validating that it has delete content.

nodes.name: encode
nodes.summary: Serializes a ManifestFile to bytes using the Avro encoder.

nodes.name: decode
nodes.summary: Deserializes a ManifestFile from Avro-encoded bytes.

nodes.name: open
nodes.summary: Dispatches to read or readDeleteManifest depending on manifest content.

nodes.name: copyAppendManifest
nodes.summary: Copies a manifest for an append, rewriting entries as ADDED with the new snapshot id.

nodes.name: copyRewriteManifest
nodes.summary: Copies a manifest for a rewrite, keeping entry status and snapshot ids as existing entries.

nodes.name: copyManifestInternal
nodes.summary: Shared copy loop that streams entries from a source manifest to a new writer and returns the resulting ManifestFile.

nodes.name: newInputFile
nodes.summary: Creates an InputFile for a manifest, wrapped by the content cache when caching is enabled.

nodes.name: writeParallel
nodes.summary: Writes groups of entries to separate manifests in parallel using Tasks and divides work into target-sized groups.

nodes.name: ManifestListWriter.java
nodes.summary: Abstract FileAppender for manifest list files with per-format-version nested writers (V1 to V4) that handle sequence numbers, first row ids and encryption keys.

nodes.name: ManifestListWriter
nodes.summary: Abstract FileAppender<ManifestFile> that writes manifest lists, with V1 to V4 subclasses setting schema and header metadata.

nodes.name: close
nodes.summary: Closes the underlying appender and releases resources.

nodes.name: encryptionKeys
nodes.summary: Returns the key metadata-to-wrapped-key map when native encryption is used for the manifest list.

nodes.name: ManifestLists.java
nodes.summary: Static helpers for reading a manifest list into ManifestFile objects (optionally through the content cache) and writing manifest lists for a given format version.

nodes.name: ManifestLists
nodes.summary: Utility class with newInputFile, read and write for manifest list files.

nodes.name: newInputFile
nodes.summary: Returns an InputFile for a manifest list, using the ManifestFiles content cache if enabled.

nodes.name: read
nodes.summary: Reads a manifest list through InternalData.read with GenericManifestFile as the root type.

nodes.name: write
nodes.summary: Creates the ManifestListWriter that matches the table format version for the given output file.

nodes.name: ManifestMergeManager.java
nodes.summary: Abstract base that bin-packs small manifests by partition spec into larger ones, rewriting live entries and suppressing stale deletes while caching merge results across commit retries.

nodes.name: ManifestMergeManager
nodes.summary: Generic abstract class that groups manifests by spec, bin-packs them and rewrites each bin into one merged manifest.

nodes.name: mergeManifests
nodes.summary: Groups manifests by spec and merges each group, returning the original manifests when merging is disabled.

nodes.name: cleanUncommitted
nodes.summary: Deletes merged manifests that were produced but not committed.

nodes.name: groupBySpec
nodes.summary: Groups manifests into a multimap by partition spec id, ordered newest spec first.

nodes.name: mergeGroup
nodes.summary: Bin-packs a spec group by target size and merges each bin in parallel, reusing cached results.

nodes.name: createManifest
nodes.summary: Writes the live entries of a bin into one new manifest and records replaced counts.

nodes.name: ManifestWriter.java
nodes.summary: Abstract FileAppender that writes manifest entries for data or delete files, with nested V1 to V4 writers and conversion of the finished file into a ManifestFile.

nodes.name: ManifestWriter
nodes.summary: Generic abstract FileAppender that tracks added/existing/deleted counts and row ranges and emits a ManifestFile on close.

nodes.name: outputFile
nodes.summary: Returns the OutputFile for this writer, unwrapping encryption when present.

nodes.name: addEntry
nodes.summary: Adds a manifest entry, updating counts, min sequence number and row range statistics.

nodes.name: toManifestFile
nodes.summary: Builds the GenericManifestFile describing the written manifest, including partition summaries and key metadata.

nodes.name: keyMetadataBuffer
nodes.summary: Returns the encryption key metadata as a ByteBuffer for the manifest file.

nodes.name: close
nodes.summary: Closes the writer and the underlying appender.

nodes.name: MetricsConfig.java
nodes.summary: Immutable, serializable per-column metrics configuration (none, counts, truncate, full) derived from table properties, the schema and the sort order. It decides which column statistics writers collect.
nodes.languageNotes: Final class implementing Serializable, with immutable maps copied through SerializableMap so the config can ship to distributed workers.

nodes.name: MetricsConfig
nodes.summary: Holds the default metrics mode and per-column overrides, with static factories for tables, position deletes and property maps. Limits default-mode columns to a configurable maximum and always keeps sort-order columns.

nodes.name: validateReferencedColumns
nodes.summary: Walks the schema and checks that every column named in metrics override properties exists, failing validation otherwise.

nodes.name: limitFieldIds
nodes.summary: Traverses the schema in order and selects the field ids that keep the default metrics mode, capping the count at the inferred-column limit.

nodes.name: from
nodes.summary: Builds a MetricsConfig from table properties, schema and sort order, applying default and per-column overrides and forcing sort columns to full-style metrics.

nodes.name: maxInferredColumnDefaults
nodes.summary: Reads the maximum number of columns that get default metrics from properties, with a fallback default.

nodes.name: RewriteTablePathUtil.java
nodes.summary: Static helpers for the rewrite-table-path action. They copy table metadata, manifest lists, manifests, position delete files and deletion vectors while replacing a source path prefix with a target prefix.

nodes.name: RewriteTablePathUtil
nodes.summary: Utility class that rewrites every path reference in table metadata, snapshots, statistics, manifests and delete files for table relocation or replication.

nodes.name: RewriteResult
nodes.summary: Accumulator of rewrite output holding the next files to rewrite, a source-to-target copy plan and rewritten manifest lengths, with an append method to merge results.

nodes.name: PositionDeleteReaderWriter
nodes.summary: Pluggable interface that engines implement to read and write position delete files when rewriting paths.

nodes.name: replacePaths
nodes.summary: Produces a copy of TableMetadata with location, properties, snapshots, statistics files and metadata log entries rewritten from the source prefix to the target prefix.

nodes.name: updateProperties
nodes.summary: Rewrites path-valued table properties such as write data and metadata locations.

nodes.name: updatePathInProperty
nodes.summary: Replaces the source prefix in a single property value when it starts with that prefix.

nodes.name: updatePathInStatisticsFiles
nodes.summary: Returns statistics file entries with their paths moved to the target prefix.

nodes.name: updatePathInPartitionStatisticsFiles
nodes.summary: Returns partition statistics file entries with their paths moved to the target prefix.

nodes.name: updatePathInMetadataLogs
nodes.summary: Rewrites previous metadata file paths in the metadata log.

nodes.name: updatePathInSnapshots
nodes.summary: Rewrites the manifest list location of every snapshot to the target prefix.

nodes.name: rewriteManifestList
nodes.summary: Rewrites a snapshot manifest list into a new file, updating manifest paths and recording which manifests need their own rewrite.

nodes.name: rewriteDataManifest
nodes.summary: Rewrites a data manifest, replacing data file paths and returning the files that must be copied.

nodes.name: rewriteDeleteManifest
nodes.summary: Rewrites a delete manifest, replacing delete file paths and scheduling position delete files for rewrite.

nodes.name: writeDataFileEntry
nodes.summary: Writes a data manifest entry with the rewritten data file location, preserving status and sequence numbers.

nodes.name: writeDeleteFileEntry
nodes.summary: Writes a delete manifest entry, handling position, equality and deletion vector delete files with rewritten paths.

nodes.name: appendEntryWithFile
nodes.summary: Appends a manifest entry according to its status (added, existing or deleted) using a rewritten file.

nodes.name: newEqualityDeleteEntry
nodes.summary: Builds an equality delete file copy with a new location and carries over metrics and key metadata.

nodes.name: newPositionDeleteEntry
nodes.summary: Builds a position delete file copy with a new location and an updated referenced data file.

nodes.name: rewriteReferencedDataFilePathForDV
nodes.summary: Computes the new referenced data file path for a deletion vector delete file, or null otherwise.

nodes.name: rewritePositionDeleteFile
nodes.summary: Rewrites a position delete file through the supplied reader and writer, dispatching deletion vectors to the Puffin path.

nodes.name: rewritePositionDelete
nodes.summary: Reads a position delete file, rewrites the file path column to the target prefix and writes the result, returning the written size.

nodes.name: rewriteDVFile
nodes.summary: Rewrites a Puffin deletion vector file, updating the referenced data file in blob metadata and copying blob payloads.

nodes.name: newPositionDeleteRecord
nodes.summary: Creates a position delete record with a rewritten file path and the original position.

nodes.name: SnapshotParser.java
nodes.summary: JSON serializer and deserializer for Snapshot objects in table metadata, covering v1 manifest lists and v2 sequence numbers, summaries and key ids.

nodes.name: SnapshotParser
nodes.summary: Static parser that converts snapshots to and from JSON and supplies a lazy FileIO to read legacy v1 manifest lists.

nodes.name: DummyFileIO
nodes.summary: Minimal FileIO used to lazily read the manifest list path of a v1 snapshot, rejecting write and delete operations.

nodes.name: toJson
nodes.summary: Writes a Snapshot as JSON including ids, timestamps, operation, summary, manifests or manifest-list and schema id.

nodes.name: fromJson
nodes.summary: Parses snapshot JSON into a BaseSnapshot, validating required fields and handling legacy inline manifests.

nodes.name: SnapshotProducer.java
nodes.summary: Abstract base for every operation that commits a new table snapshot. It builds the manifest list, handles retries, cleanup of uncommitted files and metrics, and notifies listeners.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the self-type pattern (SnapshotProducer<ThisT> with self()) for fluent subclass APIs, and Tasks with retry to reapply operations on commit conflicts.

nodes.name: SnapshotProducer
nodes.summary: Common commit machinery for snapshot-producing operations: validation, applying changes to produce a Snapshot, optimistic commit with retries and cleanup on failure.

nodes.name: SnapshotProducer
nodes.summary: Captures the base metadata from TableOperations, builds a cache that fills in missing manifest metadata, and reads the target manifest size, manifest format and writer properties from table settings.

nodes.name: apply
nodes.summary: Applies pending changes to the current table metadata, writing the manifest list and returning the new Snapshot with sequence number and summary.

nodes.name: runValidations
nodes.summary: Runs subclass validations against the parent snapshot before the snapshot is produced.

nodes.name: summary
nodes.summary: Builds the snapshot summary by merging subclass summary with totals computed from the previous snapshot.

nodes.name: commit
nodes.summary: Commits the update with retries, refreshing metadata between attempts, cleaning uncommitted files on failure and reporting commit metrics.

nodes.name: notifyListeners
nodes.summary: Creates a CreateSnapshotEvent from the committed snapshot and notifies registered listeners and the metrics reporter.

nodes.name: manifestListPath
nodes.summary: Creates the output file for the manifest list named snap-<snapshotId>-<attempt>-<commitUuid>.avro under the table metadata location.

nodes.name: manifestWriterProperties
nodes.summary: Builds the property map for manifest writers, mapping the table manifest compression codec and level onto Avro compression properties.

nodes.name: snapshotId
nodes.summary: Lazily generates a snapshot id from TableOperations, retrying until it does not collide with an existing snapshot.

nodes.name: buildManifestCountSummary
nodes.summary: Builds a snapshot summary containing created, kept and replaced manifest counts.

nodes.name: deleteUncommitted
nodes.summary: Deletes manifest files that are not in the committed set and optionally clears the manifest collection.

nodes.name: writeDataFileGroup
nodes.summary: Writes one group of data manifest entries with a rolling manifest writer, producing manifests for the group.

nodes.name: writeDeleteFileGroup
nodes.summary: Writes one group of delete manifest entries with a rolling manifest writer, producing delete manifests.

nodes.name: addMetadata
nodes.summary: Reads a data manifest to compute added, existing and deleted file and row counts plus partition summaries, returning a ManifestFile with that metadata filled in.

nodes.name: updateTotal
nodes.summary: Updates a running total property in the summary by adding added counts and subtracting deleted counts.

nodes.name: Avro.java
nodes.summary: Entry point for Iceberg Avro file IO. It exposes fluent builders for writing generic, data and delete files and for reading Avro files with schema projection and name mapping.
nodes.languageNotes: Static nested builders use the fluent builder pattern; Codec is a private enum mapping Iceberg codec names to Avro CodecFactory instances.

nodes.name: Avro
nodes.summary: Facade of static factory methods (write, writeData, writeDeletes, read) that return configurable Avro builders.

nodes.name: WriteBuilder
nodes.summary: Builder that configures schema, writer function, metrics, codec and metadata, then builds an AvroFileAppender.

nodes.name: DataWriteBuilder
nodes.summary: Builder for Avro data files that wraps an appender in a DataWriter with partition, sort order and encryption metadata.

nodes.name: DeleteWriteBuilder
nodes.summary: Builder for equality and position delete Avro files, producing EqualityDeleteWriter or PositionDeleteWriter instances.

nodes.name: PositionDatumWriter
nodes.summary: DatumWriter that writes position delete rows (file path and position) and tracks metrics for them.

nodes.name: ReadBuilder
nodes.summary: Builder that configures projection, reader function, name mapping, split range and constants to read Avro files into rows.

nodes.name: AvroEncoderUtil.java
nodes.summary: Helpers that encode a data object to Avro binary bytes with the embedded schema and decode it back, used for compact serialization of values.

nodes.name: AvroEncoderUtil
nodes.summary: Static encode and decode methods for single objects using the Iceberg Avro writer and reader machinery.

nodes.name: encode
nodes.summary: Serializes a datum as magic bytes, the Avro schema string and the Avro binary-encoded datum into a byte array.

nodes.name: decode
nodes.summary: Validates the magic bytes, parses the embedded Avro schema and decodes the datum with a generic Avro reader.

nodes.name: AvroFileAppender.java
nodes.summary: FileAppender implementation that writes Iceberg rows to an Avro data file through a DataFileWriter and reports metrics and length.

nodes.name: AvroFileAppender
nodes.summary: Wraps an Avro DataFileWriter with codec and metadata setup, counts records and exposes Metrics and file length.

nodes.name: AvroFileAppender
nodes.summary: Opens the output stream, creates the datum writer from the schema and initializes the Avro DataFileWriter with codec and metadata.

nodes.name: length
nodes.summary: Returns the stored length of the output stream, or throws if no stream is open.

nodes.name: newAvroWriter
nodes.summary: Creates an Avro DataFileWriter with the codec and metadata entries set, then opens it on the output stream with the schema.

nodes.name: AvroFormatModel.java

nodes.name: ApplyNameMapping.java
nodes.summary: AvroSchemaVisitor that rewrites an Avro schema by looking up each field in a NameMapping and attaching Iceberg field IDs, returning null for parts that have no ID.

nodes.name: ApplyNameMapping
nodes.summary: Visitor producing a new Avro schema with field-id/element-id/key-id/value-id properties derived from the mapping.

nodes.name: record
nodes.summary: Copies a record's fields attaching resolved field ids from the NameMapping when the field result is non-null.

nodes.name: array
nodes.summary: Rebuilds array or map-as-array schemas with element ids from the mapping.

nodes.name: map
nodes.summary: Rebuilds map schemas with key and value ids from the mapping.

nodes.name: AvroSchemaUtil.java
nodes.summary: Central static utility for Avro and Iceberg schema interop: converting between Iceberg and Avro schemas, reading field/key/value/element ids from properties, option-union helpers, name sanitization, and entry points for pruning, projection and name mapping.

nodes.name: AvroSchemaUtil
nodes.summary: Public final-style utility with ID property constants and static helpers; delegates to visitors such as SchemaToType, PruneColumns, BuildAvroProjection and ApplyNameMapping.

nodes.name: convert
nodes.summary: Converts an Avro Schema into an Iceberg Type by visiting it with SchemaToType (other overloads convert Iceberg types and schemas to Avro via TypeToSchema).

nodes.name: pruneColumns
nodes.summary: Prunes an Avro schema to the selected field ids using PruneColumns.

nodes.name: buildAvroProjection
nodes.summary: Builds the Avro read schema for an expected Iceberg schema using BuildAvroProjection.

nodes.name: applyNameMapping
nodes.summary: Adds Iceberg ids to an Avro schema lacking them by visiting it with ApplyNameMapping.

nodes.name: createProjectionMap
nodes.summary: Creates an Avro map-of-array representation used when projecting key/value maps with non-string keys.

nodes.name: getFieldId
nodes.summary: Resolves a field's Iceberg id from its field-id property or from the NameMapping by path.

nodes.name: copyRecord
nodes.summary: Copies a record schema with a new field list, preserving name, namespace, doc and properties.

nodes.name: copyField
nodes.summary: Copies an Avro field with a new schema and optional field-id property.

nodes.name: makeCompatibleName
nodes.summary: Sanitizes an Iceberg field name into a valid Avro name, returning it unchanged when already valid.

nodes.name: isKeyValueSchema
nodes.summary: Returns true for a two-field record carrying key and value ids, the element type of a logical map array.

nodes.name: isOptionSchema
nodes.summary: Returns true when a union has exactly two branches, one of them null.

nodes.name: convertTypes
nodes.summary: Converts an Iceberg struct to Avro and returns the map from each Iceberg type to its generated Avro schema.

nodes.name: toIceberg
nodes.summary: Converts an Avro record schema into an Iceberg Schema.

nodes.name: getKeyId
nodes.summary: Reads the key id of an Avro map schema from its key-id property or from a name mapping.

nodes.name: getValueId
nodes.summary: Reads the value id of an Avro map schema from its value-id property or from a name mapping.

nodes.name: getElementId
nodes.summary: Reads the element id of an Avro array schema from its element-id property or from a name mapping.

nodes.name: validAvroName
nodes.summary: Checks whether a name conforms to Avro identifier rules.

nodes.name: sanitize
nodes.summary: Replaces invalid characters in a name with an escaped form to make a valid Avro name.

nodes.name: isTimestamptz
nodes.summary: Detects whether a long-based timestamp-micros Avro schema carries adjust-to-utc.

nodes.name: AvroSchemaVisitor.java
nodes.summary: Abstract post-order visitor over Avro schemas with callbacks for record, union, array, map, variant and primitive nodes; it detects recursive records and tracks field names on a stack.

nodes.name: AvroSchemaVisitor
nodes.summary: Base class for schema visitors; the static visit method dispatches by Avro type and exposes fieldNames().

nodes.name: visit
nodes.summary: Static traversal that recurses into records (rejecting recursion), unions, arrays, maps, variants and primitives and calls the matching visitor method.

nodes.name: AvroSchemaWithTypeVisitor.java
nodes.summary: Abstract visitor that walks an Avro schema in parallel with an Iceberg Type (which may be null for unprojected parts), invoking callbacks for each node pair.

nodes.name: AvroSchemaWithTypeVisitor
nodes.summary: Abstract base with static visit entry points and hooks for record, union, array, map and primitive.

nodes.name: visit
nodes.summary: Dispatches on the Avro type, pairing it with the corresponding Iceberg type for each node.

nodes.name: visitRecord
nodes.summary: Visits record fields, matching Iceberg struct fields by field id and handling missing ones.

nodes.name: visitArray
nodes.summary: Visits array schemas including key-value logical maps encoded as arrays.

nodes.name: AvroWithPartnerByStructureVisitor.java
nodes.summary: Abstract visitor that traverses an Avro schema together with a partner type assuming both derive from the same Iceberg schema, so structure is matched positionally rather than by field id.

nodes.name: AvroWithPartnerByStructureVisitor
nodes.summary: Abstract generic visitor with abstract partner accessors (isMapType, arrayElementType, fieldNameAndType) and static visit.

nodes.name: visit
nodes.summary: Dispatches on the Avro schema type and visits records, unions, arrays, maps and variants with matching partners.

nodes.name: visitRecord
nodes.summary: Visits each record field with the partner field type obtained positionally.

nodes.name: visitUnion
nodes.summary: Visits non-null union options with the partner type, supporting option and complex unions.

nodes.name: AvroWithPartnerVisitor.java
nodes.summary: Visitor that walks an Avro schema alongside a partner structure (such as an Iceberg Type) located via PartnerAccessors, with a built-in FieldIDAccessors implementation for Iceberg types; used to build readers.

nodes.name: AvroWithPartnerVisitor
nodes.summary: Generic visitor class with default callbacks for record, union, array, map and primitive plus static visit.

nodes.name: FieldIDAccessors
nodes.summary: Singleton PartnerAccessors that finds struct fields by id and map/list partner types from an Iceberg Type.

nodes.name: visit
nodes.summary: Static traversal over schema and partner with accessors, detecting recursive records.

nodes.name: visitRecord
nodes.summary: Visits record fields looking up each partner by field id and name via accessors.

nodes.name: visitArray
nodes.summary: Visits arrays, including key-value arrays that represent logical maps, with partner element types.

nodes.name: AvroWithTypeByStructureVisitor.java
nodes.summary: Concrete bridge from AvroWithPartnerByStructureVisitor to Iceberg Types, implementing the partner accessors by navigating struct, list and map types.

nodes.name: AvroWithTypeByStructureVisitor
nodes.summary: Specializes the partner visitor with Type as the partner, returning field name and type pairs by position.

nodes.name: BuildAvroProjection.java
nodes.summary: Schema visitor that builds an Avro read schema from a file schema and the expected Iceberg schema, reordering and renaming fields, adding optional missing fields and resolving type promotions.

nodes.name: BuildAvroProjection
nodes.summary: Custom-order visitor keeping a current expected Type and rename map while producing the projected Avro schema.

nodes.name: record
nodes.summary: Projects a record to the expected struct: orders fields per expected schema, handles metadata columns and missing optional fields, and updates ids and names.

nodes.name: array
nodes.summary: Projects arrays and logical maps by visiting element or key/value types and rebuilding the Avro schema.

nodes.name: map
nodes.summary: Projects Avro map schemas using the expected map value type.

nodes.name: primitive
nodes.summary: Handles primitive promotion (for example int to long, float to double) according to the expected Iceberg type.

nodes.name: union
nodes.summary: Projects option unions by visiting the non-null branch.

nodes.name: GenericAvroReader.java
nodes.summary: Avro DatumReader that reads data into generic Avro/Iceberg records by building a ValueReader tree from the expected Iceberg schema and the file schema with AvroWithPartnerVisitor, supporting renames and row position.

nodes.name: GenericAvroReader
nodes.summary: Public DatumReader that resolves file schema against expected Iceberg type lazily in setSchema, optionally with custom class loader and record renames.

nodes.name: ResolvingReadBuilder
nodes.summary: Private visitor that creates ValueReaders for each schema node, resolving constants, metadata columns and logical types.

nodes.name: initReader
nodes.summary: Creates the root ValueReader by visiting the expected type and file schema with ResolvingReadBuilder and FieldIDAccessors.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Static factory creating a GenericAvroReader for an expected Iceberg schema.

nodes.name: GenericAvroWriter.java
nodes.summary: Avro DatumWriter for generic records that builds a ValueWriter tree from an Avro schema and exposes per-field metrics.

nodes.name: GenericAvroWriter
nodes.summary: Public writer delegating to a ValueWriter created in setSchema, implementing MetricsAwareDatumWriter.

nodes.name: WriteBuilder
nodes.summary: Private BaseWriteBuilder subclass creating record writers via ValueWriters.record and generic fixed writers.

nodes.name: InternalReader.java
nodes.summary: Avro DatumReader producing Iceberg's internal object model; it builds ValueReaders via AvroWithPartnerVisitor using (id, type) pairs as partners and supports constants, custom struct classes and row position.

nodes.name: InternalReader
nodes.summary: Public reader configurable with constants and custom StructLike types per field id; lazily resolves reader on setSchema.

nodes.name: ResolvingReadBuilder
nodes.summary: Private visitor building ValueReaders for records (planned struct readers with constants), arrays, maps and primitives.

nodes.name: AccessByID
nodes.summary: Singleton PartnerAccessors over Pair<Integer, Type> that resolves partners by field id and carries custom type info.

nodes.name: initReader
nodes.summary: Initializes the root ValueReader using AvroWithPartnerVisitor with the AccessByID accessors.

nodes.name: InternalReaders.java
nodes.summary: Package-private factory for value readers that produce Record or custom StructLike objects from a planned read plan, instantiating structs reflectively.

nodes.name: InternalReaders
nodes.summary: Utility class exposing struct reader factories.

nodes.name: PlannedStructLikeReader
nodes.summary: Reader that creates instances of a StructLike class through DynConstructors and fills them from a read plan.

nodes.name: RecordReader
nodes.summary: Reader that builds GenericRecord instances for a struct type from a read plan.

nodes.name: InternalWriter.java
nodes.summary: Avro DatumWriter consuming Iceberg's internal object model, building a ValueWriter tree with struct writers and exposing metrics.

nodes.name: InternalWriter
nodes.summary: Public writer analogous to GenericAvroWriter but producing struct writers for internal records.

nodes.name: WriteBuilder
nodes.summary: Private BaseWriteBuilder subclass producing ValueWriters.struct record writers.

nodes.name: LogicalMap.java
nodes.summary: Avro LogicalType named map that validates an array of key-value records used to encode Iceberg maps with non-string keys.

nodes.name: LogicalMap
nodes.summary: Singleton logical type whose validate checks that the schema is an array of key-value records.

nodes.name: MetricsAwareDatumWriter.java
nodes.summary: Interface extending Avro's DatumWriter with a metrics method returning a stream of FieldMetrics for written data.

nodes.name: MetricsAwareDatumWriter
nodes.summary: DatumWriter contract adding metrics() to expose per-field statistics.

nodes.name: NameMappingDatumReader.java
nodes.summary: Delegating DatumReader that applies a NameMapping to file schemas lacking field IDs before handing them to the wrapped reader.

nodes.name: NameMappingDatumReader
nodes.summary: Wraps a DatumReader and forwards row position suppliers; setSchema adds ids via AvroSchemaUtil.applyNameMapping when absent.

nodes.name: NameMappingWithAvroSchema.java
nodes.summary: Visitor that derives an Iceberg NameMapping (MappedFields) from an Avro schema and its matching Iceberg type, including naming complex union options.

nodes.name: NameMappingWithAvroSchema
nodes.summary: Extends AvroWithTypeByStructureVisitor to build MappedFields for records, unions, arrays and maps.

nodes.name: union
nodes.summary: Builds mappings for option unions or complex unions by naming each non-null option using type string or record name.

nodes.name: record
nodes.summary: Creates MappedField entries from struct fields and their child mappings.

nodes.name: ProjectionDatumReader.java
nodes.summary: DatumReader that adapts a file schema to an expected Iceberg schema by applying name mapping, pruning columns and building an Avro projection before delegating to a reader created from the read schema.

nodes.name: ProjectionDatumReader
nodes.summary: Holds a reader factory function, expected schema, renames and optional NameMapping; setSchema computes the read schema.

nodes.name: setSchema
nodes.summary: Builds the read schema pipeline: apply name mapping, prune to projected ids, build Avro projection, then create the wrapped reader.

nodes.name: PruneColumns.java
nodes.summary: Schema visitor that prunes an Avro schema to the selected field IDs, retaining required parent structure and handling maps, arrays and option unions.

nodes.name: PruneColumns
nodes.summary: Visitor with selected id set and optional NameMapping returning a pruned schema or null when nothing is selected.

nodes.name: record
nodes.summary: Filters record fields by selected ids, keeping partially projected children.

nodes.name: array
nodes.summary: Prunes array schemas by element id selection.

nodes.name: map
nodes.summary: Prunes map schemas by key/value id selection.

nodes.name: copyField
nodes.summary: Copies a field with a pruned schema preserving properties.

nodes.name: makeEmptyCopy
nodes.summary: Creates an empty copy of a field for structural retention without children.

nodes.name: SchemaToType.java
nodes.summary: Schema visitor converting an Avro schema into an Iceberg Type, reading ids from properties or allocating them, and mapping logical types such as decimal, date, time and timestamp.

nodes.name: SchemaToType
nodes.summary: Visitor that returns Iceberg Types and allocates ids when the Avro schema lacks them.

nodes.name: record
nodes.summary: Builds a StructType from fields with ids and optionality derived from union nullability.

nodes.name: logicalType
nodes.summary: Maps Avro logical types (decimal, date, time, timestamp, uuid) to Iceberg primitives.

nodes.name: primitive
nodes.summary: Maps Avro primitive types and logical types to Iceberg primitive types.

nodes.name: SupportsCustomTypes.java
nodes.summary: Marker interface for Avro readers that can instantiate custom StructLike record classes, keyed by the root type and by field ID.

nodes.name: SupportsCustomTypes
nodes.summary: Interface exposing setCustomTypes so a reader can be told which StructLike classes to build for the root and for nested struct IDs.

nodes.name: SupportsIndexProjection.java
nodes.summary: Abstract StructLike base class that maps projected field positions to base positions, so generated record classes can expose a projection of a wider struct.
nodes.languageNotes: Subclasses implement internalGet and internalSet; the position translation is hidden behind the public get and set.

nodes.name: SupportsIndexProjection
nodes.summary: Holds an int[] projection-to-base position map built from field IDs of a base and projected StructType, and delegates get/set through it.

nodes.name: SupportsRowPosition.java
nodes.summary: Callback interface for Avro readers that need the starting row position of a split, used to populate the _pos metadata column.

nodes.name: SupportsRowPosition
nodes.summary: Interface with setRowPositionSupplier(Supplier<Long>) so readers learn where an Avro split begins.

nodes.name: TypeToSchema.java
nodes.summary: Schema visitor that converts an Iceberg type tree into an Avro Schema, assigning record names, field IDs, logical types and optional unions.
nodes.languageNotes: Package-private abstract visitor with two concrete subclasses that differ only in how generated record schemas are cached (by type or by record name).

nodes.name: TypeToSchema
nodes.summary: Abstract TypeUtil.SchemaVisitor<Schema> holding shared Avro primitive and logical-type schemas plus a field-id stack for naming records.

nodes.name: WithTypeToName
nodes.summary: TypeToSchema variant that names records from a Map<StructType,String> and caches results keyed by Iceberg type.

nodes.name: WithNamesFunction
nodes.summary: TypeToSchema variant that names records via a BiFunction and caches schemas by record name.

nodes.name: struct
nodes.summary: Builds an Avro record schema from a struct and its field schemas, sanitizing invalid names, preserving original names and field IDs as props, and caching by record name.

nodes.name: list
nodes.summary: Converts a list type to an Avro array schema (or a key/value record array for maps with non-string keys) tagged with the element ID and optional-ness.

nodes.name: map
nodes.summary: Converts a map type to an Avro map when keys are strings, otherwise to a LogicalMap-tagged array of key/value records carrying key and value IDs.

nodes.name: variant
nodes.summary: Creates an Avro record with binary metadata and value fields and tags it with the variant logical type.

nodes.name: primitive
nodes.summary: Maps each Iceberg primitive type ID to the matching cached Avro schema, building fixed, decimal and other parameterized schemas on demand.

nodes.name: UUIDConversion.java
nodes.summary: Avro Conversion that turns a 16-byte fixed value tagged with the uuid logical type into java.util.UUID and back.

nodes.name: UUIDConversion
nodes.summary: Conversion<UUID> using UUIDUtil to translate between GenericFixed bytes and UUID values.

nodes.name: ValueReader.java
nodes.summary: Core reader abstraction for the Iceberg Avro stack: reads one value from a Decoder with optional object reuse and can skip a value.

nodes.name: ValueReader
nodes.summary: Generic interface with read(Decoder, reuse) and a default skip that reads and discards.

nodes.name: ValueReaders.java
nodes.summary: Factory and implementation hub for ValueReader instances covering primitives, logical types, unions, arrays, maps, structs, variants and metadata columns such as _pos, _row_id and last-updated sequence number.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses private static nested classes behind static factory methods; planned struct readers build a (position, reader) read plan from field IDs instead of a ResolvingDecoder.

nodes.name: ValueReaders
nodes.summary: Static factory class with ~40 reader factories plus buildReadPlan logic that matches file fields to projected fields, constants and defaults.

nodes.name: PlannedStructReader
nodes.summary: Abstract struct reader that executes a precomputed read plan of (position, reader) pairs, skipping unprojected fields.

nodes.name: StructReader
nodes.summary: Abstract positional struct reader that reads fields in file order, tracks the _pos field for row position and fills _deleted constants.

nodes.name: PositionReader
nodes.summary: Reader that synthesizes the _pos column by incrementing a counter seeded from the row position supplier.

nodes.name: RowIdReader
nodes.summary: Reader for the _row_id column that returns the stored ID or firstRowId plus row position when it is null.

nodes.name: LastUpdatedSeqReader
nodes.summary: Reader for _last_updated_sequence_number that falls back to the file sequence number when the stored value is null.

nodes.name: decimalBytesReader
nodes.summary: Chooses a fixed-size or variable-length bytes reader for the physical representation of a decimal schema.

nodes.name: buildReadPlan
nodes.summary: Builds the (projection position, reader) plan for a record by mapping file fields to expected fields and appending readers for fields missing from the file.

nodes.name: addFileFieldReadersToPlan
nodes.summary: Walks the file's fields and adds one plan entry each, consuming expected positions from the ID-to-position map.

nodes.name: fileFieldReader
nodes.summary: Selects the reader for a file field: skip-only when unprojected, row-id or last-updated wrappers for lineage columns, otherwise a constant-aware field reader.

nodes.name: fieldReader
nodes.summary: Replaces the file reader with a constant reader when an identity-partition constant exists for the field ID.

nodes.name: addMissingFileReadersToPlan
nodes.summary: Adds plan entries for expected fields that are absent from the data file.

nodes.name: createMissingFieldReader
nodes.summary: Creates a reader for a field missing from the file using constants, initial defaults, _deleted, _pos or null for optional fields, else fails.

nodes.name: idToPos
nodes.summary: Maps field IDs of a struct to their positions to drive read-plan construction.

nodes.name: rowIds
nodes.summary: Factory for the _row_id reader, or a null constant when no first row ID is available.

nodes.name: lastUpdated
nodes.summary: Factory for the last-updated sequence number reader, or a null constant when lineage inputs are missing.

nodes.name: positions
nodes.summary: Factory returning a PositionReader for the _pos metadata column.

nodes.name: union
nodes.summary: Factory for a reader that reads the union branch index and delegates to the matching branch reader.

nodes.name: array
nodes.summary: Factory for a reader that decodes an Avro array into a collection using an element reader.

nodes.name: map
nodes.summary: Factory for a reader that decodes an Avro map using key and value readers.

nodes.name: skipStruct
nodes.summary: Factory for a reader that decodes and discards a struct, used when a file record has no matching expected type.

nodes.name: ValueWriter.java
nodes.summary: Core writer abstraction for the Iceberg Avro stack: writes one datum to an Encoder and can expose per-field metrics.

nodes.name: ValueWriter
nodes.summary: Generic interface with write(datum, Encoder) and a default metrics() stream of FieldMetrics.

nodes.name: ValueWriters.java
nodes.summary: Factory and implementation hub for ValueWriter instances covering primitives, decimals, UUIDs, fixed, variants, optionals, arrays, maps and struct writers over IndexedRecord or StructLike.
nodes.languageNotes: Same static-factory-plus-private-nested-class layout as ValueReaders; StructWriter is public so engine-specific writers can extend it.

nodes.name: ValueWriters
nodes.summary: Static factory class returning cached or new writers for each Avro/Iceberg value kind.

nodes.name: StructWriter
nodes.summary: Abstract struct writer that writes each field using a per-position ValueWriter and an abstract field accessor.

nodes.name: OptionWriter
nodes.summary: Writer for nullable union values that emits the union branch index then delegates to the value writer.

nodes.name: option
nodes.summary: Factory for an OptionWriter wrapping a writer with the null branch at a given union index.

nodes.name: array
nodes.summary: Factory for a collection writer that encodes an Avro array using an element writer.

nodes.name: arrayMap
nodes.summary: Factory for a writer that encodes a Map as an Avro array of key/value records.

nodes.name: map
nodes.summary: Factory for a writer that encodes a Map as an Avro map with string keys.

nodes.name: record
nodes.summary: Factory for a StructWriter over Avro IndexedRecord values.

nodes.name: struct
nodes.summary: Factory for a StructWriter over Iceberg StructLike values.

nodes.name: variants
nodes.summary: Factory returning a writer for Variant values with separate metadata and value binary fields.

nodes.name: GenericDataUtil.java
nodes.summary: Utility that converts values from Iceberg's internal representation (days, micros, ByteBuffers) to the generic data model (LocalDate, LocalTime, OffsetDateTime, byte[]).

nodes.name: GenericDataUtil
nodes.summary: Non-instantiable holder of internalToGeneric.

nodes.name: internalToGeneric
nodes.summary: Switches on type ID to convert dates, times, timestamps (with or without UTC adjustment, micros or nanos) and fixed buffers into generic Java objects.

nodes.name: GenericRecord.java
nodes.summary: Default Record implementation backed by an Object[] plus a cached name-to-position map, supporting positional and named access, deep copy and overwrite-copy.

nodes.name: GenericRecord
nodes.summary: Mutable Record/StructLike over a StructType with static create factories, Caffeine-cached field-name lookup and value-based equals/hashCode.

nodes.name: equals
nodes.summary: Compares two GenericRecords by value across all positions, returning false for other types.

nodes.name: IdentityPartitionConverters.java
nodes.summary: Utility that converts identity-partition constant values from engine-internal forms to Iceberg generic values for strings, time, date, timestamps and Avro fixed.

nodes.name: IdentityPartitionConverters
nodes.summary: Static holder of convertConstant for generic reads of identity partition values.

nodes.name: convertConstant
nodes.summary: Converts a constant value by type ID: toString for strings, DateTimeUtil conversions for temporal types, byte[] extraction for GenericData.Fixed.

nodes.name: DataWriter.java
nodes.summary: Avro DatumWriter for Iceberg generic records that builds a ValueWriter tree from the Avro schema and exposes field metrics.
nodes.languageNotes: createStructWriter is a protected hook so engine-specific subclasses can swap the struct writer.

nodes.name: DataWriter
nodes.summary: MetricsAwareDatumWriter that visits the schema with AvroSchemaVisitor to build writers and delegates write and metrics to the root writer.

nodes.name: WriteBuilder
nodes.summary: AvroSchemaVisitor mapping Avro records, unions, arrays, maps, variants and primitives/logical types to ValueWriters and GenericWriters.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Static factory creating a DataWriter for an Avro schema.

nodes.name: DecoderResolver.java
nodes.summary: Caches Avro ResolvingDecoders per (read schema, file schema) pair in a thread-local weak map and uses them to read values with schema evolution.

nodes.name: DecoderResolver
nodes.summary: Static helper with resolveAndRead and clearCache backed by a ThreadLocal weak-key cache of ResolvingDecoders.

nodes.name: resolve
nodes.summary: Looks up or creates the ResolvingDecoder for the schema pair and reconfigures it with the given Decoder.

nodes.name: resolveAndRead
nodes.summary: Resolves a decoder, reads a value through the supplied ValueReader, then drains the resolver.

nodes.name: GenericReaders.java
nodes.summary: Package-private factory of ValueReaders producing Java time objects (LocalDate, LocalTime, LocalDateTime, OffsetDateTime) and generic Record struct readers.

nodes.name: GenericReaders
nodes.summary: Static factories for date, time and timestamp (micros, nanos, millis, with and without tz) readers and struct readers.

nodes.name: PlannedRecordReader
nodes.summary: PlannedStructReader that creates or reuses GenericRecord instances for read-plan based reads.

nodes.name: GenericRecordReader
nodes.summary: StructReader that creates or reuses GenericRecord instances for positional reads.

nodes.name: struct
nodes.summary: Overloaded factories returning a PlannedRecordReader from a read plan or a GenericRecordReader from field readers and constants.

nodes.name: GenericWriters.java
nodes.summary: Package-private factory of ValueWriters for Java time objects (LocalDate, LocalTime, LocalDateTime, OffsetDateTime) and generic Record struct writers.

nodes.name: GenericWriters
nodes.summary: Static factories for date, time and timestamp writers and the generic record struct writer.

nodes.name: GenericRecordWriter
nodes.summary: StructWriter<Record> that reads field values by position from a generic Record.

nodes.name: struct
nodes.summary: Factory returning a GenericRecordWriter for a list of field writers.

nodes.summary: Reads the 2-byte header and 8-byte fingerprint, finds or loads the matching RawDecoder and decodes the payload.

nodes.summary: Registers a write schema by Avro parsing fingerprint with a RawDecoder built over PlannedDataReader.

nodes.summary: Converts the Iceberg schema to Avro, precomputes the header, and encodes datums with a DataWriter using thread-local buffers.

nodes.summary: Writes the header then the datum into a reusable thread-local buffer and returns it with or without copying.

nodes.name: PlannedDataReader

nodes.name: ReadBuilder
nodes.summary: AvroWithPartnerVisitor that turns Avro nodes plus expected Iceberg types into ValueReaders and GenericReaders, including logical type handling.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Static factories creating a PlannedDataReader for an expected schema with an optional identity-constant map.

nodes.name: setSchema

nodes.name: RawDecoder
nodes.summary: BaseDecoder wrapping a DatumReader and a reused thread-local BinaryDecoder.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Builds a RawDecoder by applying the reader function to the read schema and setting the Avro write schema.

nodes.name: decode
nodes.summary: Decodes one datum from the stream with a direct binary decoder, converting IOException to UncheckedIOException.

nodes.name: Deletes.java
nodes.summary: Static helpers for applying delete files: filtering rows by equality sets, marking or counting deleted rows, and building position delete indexes or sorted position streams per data file.

nodes.name: Deletes
nodes.summary: Non-instantiable utility using accessors on the position-delete schema to read file path and position columns.

nodes.summary: Filter that drops rows whose projected key is contained in a StructLikeSet of equality deletes.

nodes.name: DataFileFilter
nodes.summary: Filter that keeps position-delete rows whose file path equals a given data file location.
