nodes.summary: Collects equality delete rows into a StructLikeSet and closes the source iterable.

nodes.name: toPositionIndexes
nodes.summary: Reads sorted position deletes into a CharSequenceMap of per-data-file bitmap position delete indexes.

nodes.name: toPositionIndex
nodes.summary: Builds a single PositionDeleteIndex from delete positions, closing the source iterable.

nodes.name: deletePositions
nodes.summary: Filters delete files to one data file and merges their positions in sorted order using SortedMerge.

nodes.name: writeDVs
nodes.summary: Creates a DVFileWriter (BaseDVFileWriter) that writes deletion vectors, loading previous deletes through a callback.

nodes.name: BaseEncryptedKey.java
nodes.summary: Immutable EncryptedKey carrying a key ID, encrypted key metadata bytes, the ID of the key that encrypted it, and serializable properties.

nodes.name: BaseEncryptedKey
nodes.summary: Validates non-null key ID and metadata in the constructor, copies metadata to a byte[] and properties to a SerializableMap.

nodes.name: BaseEncryptionKeyMetadata.java
nodes.summary: Package-private EncryptionKeyMetadata wrapper around a ByteBuffer, returning the shared empty instance for null input.

nodes.name: BaseEncryptionKeyMetadata
nodes.summary: Wraps raw key metadata with fromKeyMetadata and fromByteArray factories and a deep-copy copy().

nodes.name: KeyMetadataDecoder.java
nodes.summary: Avro MessageDecoder that reads a version byte and decodes StandardKeyMetadata from the matching write schema into the read schema version.

nodes.name: KeyMetadataDecoder
nodes.summary: Caches per-version RawDecoders built with GenericAvroReader and resolves write schemas from StandardKeyMetadata.

nodes.name: decode
nodes.summary: Reads the version byte, finds or creates a RawDecoder for that write schema version and decodes the key metadata; fails on unknown versions.

nodes.name: KeyMetadataEncoder.java
nodes.summary: Avro MessageEncoder that writes a schema version byte followed by the binary-encoded StandardKeyMetadata.

nodes.name: KeyMetadataEncoder
nodes.summary: Builds a GenericAvroWriter for the versioned write schema and encodes using thread-local reusable buffers.

nodes.name: encode
nodes.summary: Writes the version byte and datum into a thread-local buffer, returning a copy or a shared view.

nodes.name: StandardKeyMetadata.java
nodes.summary: Standard envelope-encryption key metadata (encryption key, AAD prefix, optional file length) implemented as an Avro IndexedRecord with versioned schema and ByteBuffer serialization.
nodes.languageNotes: Schema versions live in static maps keyed by a version byte so newer layouts can be added while old metadata remains readable.

nodes.name: StandardKeyMetadata
nodes.summary: NativeEncryptionKeyMetadata and IndexedRecord holding key bytes, AAD prefix and file length, serialized through KeyMetadataEncoder/Decoder.

nodes.name: castOrParse
nodes.summary: Returns the metadata if it is already StandardKeyMetadata, otherwise parses its buffer.

nodes.name: put
nodes.summary: IndexedRecord setter mapping Avro positions 0, 1 and 2 to key, AAD prefix and file length.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: IndexedRecord getter mapping Avro positions to the key fields.

nodes.name: ReadBuilder.java
nodes.summary: Format-agnostic fluent builder interface for reading files: split, projection, engine projection, filter, case sensitivity, name mapping, constants and batch tuning, ending in build() returning a CloseableIterable.

nodes.name: ReadBuilder
nodes.summary: Generic builder interface over record type D and engine schema type S implemented by each file format module.

nodes.name: BasePositionDeltaWriter.java
nodes.summary: PositionDeltaWriter that routes inserts, updates and position deletes to separate PartitioningWriters and merges their results into a single WriteResult once closed.

nodes.name: BasePositionDeltaWriter
nodes.summary: Delegates insert/update to data PartitioningWriters and deletes to a position delete writer, closing all on close().

nodes.name: result
nodes.summary: Requires a closed writer and builds a WriteResult with data files, delete files, referenced data files and rewritten delete files.

nodes.name: dataFiles
nodes.summary: Returns data files from the insert writer, or the concatenation of insert and update results when they differ.

nodes.name: close
nodes.summary: Idempotently closes insert, update and delete writers and marks the writer closed.

nodes.name: BaseTaskWriter.java
nodes.summary: Abstract TaskWriter base managing completed data/delete files, failure state, optional deletion vector writer, abort cleanup, plus an equality-delta writer and rolling file writers.
nodes.languageNotes: Inner (non-static) classes share the outer writer's state such as file factories and completed file lists.

nodes.name: BaseTaskWriter
nodes.summary: Collects completed DataFile and DeleteFile results, supports abort deleting written files in parallel, and builds the final WriteResult.

nodes.name: BaseEqualityDeltaWriter
nodes.summary: Writer of rows, equality deletes and key deletes that tracks inserted rows to emit position deletes for same-file duplicate keys.

nodes.name: BaseRollingWriter
nodes.summary: Abstract closeable that opens a new output file when the target size is reached and records completed files.

nodes.name: RollingFileWriter
nodes.summary: Rolling writer for data files using the writer factory's DataWriter.

nodes.name: RollingEqDeleteWriter
nodes.summary: Rolling writer for equality delete files using EqualityDeleteWriter.

nodes.name: abort
nodes.summary: Closes the writer and deletes all completed data and delete files in parallel via Tasks and the worker pool.

nodes.name: complete
nodes.summary: Closes the writer, checks no failure was recorded and returns a WriteResult of data, delete and referenced files.

nodes.name: close
nodes.summary: Closes the deletion vector writer, collecting its delete files and referenced data files.

nodes.name: ClusteredDataWriter.java
nodes.summary: ClusteredWriter for data files that rolls files per partition and aggregates the produced DataFiles into a DataWriteResult.

nodes.name: ClusteredDataWriter
nodes.summary: Supplies RollingDataWriter instances per spec and partition and accumulates their data files.

nodes.name: ClusteredWriter.java
nodes.summary: Abstract PartitioningWriter that expects rows clustered by spec and partition, closing the previous file writer on each partition change and failing if a closed partition reappears.

nodes.name: ClusteredWriter
nodes.summary: Tracks the current spec, partition and writer plus sets of completed specs and partitions to enforce clustering; subclasses provide newWriter, addResult and aggregatedResult.

nodes.name: write
nodes.summary: Starts a new writer when the spec or partition changes, throws IllegalStateException when a completed spec or partition is revisited, then writes the row.

nodes.name: closeCurrentWriter
nodes.summary: Closes the current FileWriter and passes its result to addResult.

nodes.name: DataWriteResult.java
nodes.summary: Simple immutable-style result holder wrapping the list of DataFiles produced by a data writer.

nodes.name: DataWriteResult
nodes.summary: Holds a List<DataFile> built from a single file or a list.

nodes.name: FanoutDataWriter.java
nodes.summary: FanoutWriter for data files that keeps one rolling data writer per partition open and aggregates the produced DataFiles into a DataWriteResult.

nodes.name: FanoutDataWriter
nodes.summary: Supplies RollingDataWriter instances per spec and partition and accumulates their data files.

nodes.name: BatchScan.java
nodes.summary: Public API for configuring a batch scan of a table, adding time travel (snapshot id, ref, as-of-time) refinements on top of the generic Scan contract; its default fileIO() reads from the table.

nodes.name: BatchScanAdapter.java
nodes.summary: Adapter that wraps a TableScan and exposes it as a BatchScan by delegating every call and re-wrapping each refined scan in a new adapter; used as the default Table.newBatchScan() implementation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses unchecked casts of CloseableIterable<? extends ScanTask> to widen the task type, safe because the iterables are read-only.

nodes.name: IncrementalAppendScan.java
nodes.summary: Marker interface for configuring an incremental scan that reads only data appended between two snapshots; adds no methods beyond IncrementalScan.

nodes.name: LockManager.java
nodes.summary: Interface for acquiring and releasing named locks used to guarantee commit isolation, initialized from catalog properties and closeable.

nodes.name: ManifestListFile.java
nodes.summary: Describes a manifest list file by location and encryption key id, and can decrypt its key metadata using an EncryptionManager.

nodes.name: PendingUpdate.java
nodes.summary: Base contract for table metadata changes: apply() previews the uncommitted result, commit() applies and persists it, and updateEvent() optionally exposes a change event.

nodes.name: RewriteFiles.java
nodes.summary: API for atomically replacing data and delete files in a table (compaction style rewrites), with default methods that throw until implemented plus deprecated rewriteFiles overloads and snapshot validation.

nodes.name: Scan.java
nodes.summary: Generic immutable scan contract parameterized by scan, task and task-group types; defines refinement methods (select, filter, project, planWith), planning of file tasks and balanced task groups, and split settings.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a self-referential generic parameter (ThisT) so refinement methods return the concrete scan type, a fluent-builder pattern.

nodes.name: SnapshotRef.java
nodes.summary: Serializable immutable reference (branch or tag) to a snapshot with optional retention settings, plus a validating Builder that forbids retention fields on tags.

nodes.name: Table.java
nodes.summary: Central public interface representing an Iceberg table: exposes metadata (schemas, specs, sort orders, snapshots, refs), scan factories, update/commit builders, transactions, and IO, encryption and location providers.

nodes.name: TableScan.java
nodes.summary: Interface for configuring a file-based table scan with snapshot, ref and time travel refinements and deprecated incremental append helpers that throw by default.

nodes.name: Tables.java
nodes.summary: Generic interface for creating, loading and checking existence of tables by an implementation-defined string identifier, with convenience create overloads that default to unpartitioned, unsorted tables.

nodes.name: Transaction.java
nodes.summary: Interface for batching several table updates (schema, spec, properties, appends, rewrites, deletes and more) into one atomic commitTransaction call.

nodes.name: UpdateLocation.java
nodes.summary: PendingUpdate for setting a table or view base location.

nodes.name: ActionsProvider.java
nodes.summary: Interface that query engine integrations implement to supply maintenance actions (snapshot, migrate, rewrite, expire, delete orphan files and more); every method throws UnsupportedOperationException by default.

nodes.name: Catalog.java
nodes.summary: Core catalog interface for table create, load, drop, rename, register and transaction operations, with many default convenience overloads built on the nested TableBuilder.
nodes.languageNotes: Default methods layer overloads on a small abstract core (listTables, dropTable, renameTable, loadTable), and implementations override only what they support.

nodes.name: BatchScan
nodes.summary: Interface for batch scans extending Scan, adding table(), useSnapshot, useRef, asOfTime and snapshot, with a default fileIO() that returns the table's io.

nodes.name: BatchScanAdapter
nodes.summary: Class implementing BatchScan by holding a TableScan and delegating each method, wrapping refined scans in new adapters.

nodes.name: planFiles
nodes.summary: Delegates to TableScan.planFiles and widens the generic task type with an unchecked cast.

nodes.name: planTasks
nodes.summary: Delegates to TableScan.planTasks and widens the task group type with an unchecked cast.

nodes.name: IncrementalAppendScan
nodes.summary: Empty interface binding IncrementalScan to FileScanTask and CombinedScanTask for append-only incremental scans.

nodes.name: LockManager
nodes.summary: AutoCloseable interface with acquire, release and initialize methods for entity locks keyed by entity and owner ids.

nodes.name: ManifestListFile
nodes.summary: Interface exposing location(), encryptionKeyID() and decryptKeyMetadata(EncryptionManager) for a manifest list.

nodes.name: PendingUpdate
nodes.summary: Generic interface with apply() for previewing changes, commit() to persist them, and a default updateEvent() returning null.

nodes.name: RewriteFiles
nodes.summary: SnapshotUpdate for replacing files: default deleteFile/addFile/dataSequenceNumber that throw, deprecated rewriteFiles overloads, and validateFromSnapshot.

nodes.name: Scan
nodes.summary: Generic scan interface declaring option, project, filter, select, caseSensitive, planFiles, planTasks and split-size accessors, with unsupported defaults for newer features.

nodes.name: SnapshotRef
nodes.summary: Final-field value class holding snapshot id, ref type and retention limits, with static builder factories, equals, hashCode and toString.

nodes.name: equals
nodes.summary: Compares snapshot id, type and the three retention settings for equality.

nodes.name: tagBuilder
nodes.summary: Creates a Builder for a TAG ref pointing at the given snapshot id via builderFor.

nodes.name: branchBuilder
nodes.summary: Creates a Builder for a BRANCH ref pointing at the given snapshot id via builderFor.

nodes.name: builderFrom
nodes.summary: Overloaded factories that copy an existing ref (optionally retargeted to a new snapshot id) into a Builder.

nodes.name: builderFor
nodes.summary: Creates a Builder for a given snapshot id and ref type.

nodes.name: Builder
nodes.summary: Nested builder that validates retention settings (positive values, no min snapshots or max snapshot age on tags) and builds the SnapshotRef.

nodes.name: Table
nodes.summary: Large interface representing a table: metadata getters, scan factories, update and commit APIs, snapshot and ref lookup, transactions, and FileIO, EncryptionManager and LocationProvider accessors.

nodes.name: TableScan
nodes.summary: Scan interface over FileScanTask and CombinedScanTask with useSnapshot, useRef, asOfTime and deprecated appendsBetween/appendsAfter.

nodes.name: Tables
nodes.summary: Interface with create overloads (delegating down to the sort-order variant that throws by default), load and exists keyed by a string table identifier.

nodes.name: Transaction
nodes.summary: Interface returning update builders bound to one transaction (schema, spec, properties, appends, rewrites, overwrites, deletes, statistics, snapshots) and committing them together.

nodes.name: UpdateLocation
nodes.summary: PendingUpdate<String> with a setLocation method for changing the base location.

nodes.name: ActionsProvider
nodes.summary: Factory-style interface returning action objects (SnapshotTable, MigrateTable, RewriteDataFiles, ExpireSnapshots, etc.), each defaulting to UnsupportedOperationException.

nodes.name: Catalog
nodes.summary: Interface for table lifecycle operations with default overloads for createTable, newCreateTableTransaction, newReplaceTableTransaction, tableExists, registerTable and buildTable.

nodes.name: TableBuilder
nodes.summary: Nested builder interface configuring partition spec, sort order, location and properties, then creating the table or a create/replace transaction.

nodes.name: LoadContext.java
nodes.summary: Immutable value object carrying caller-supplied load details, namely the chain of referencing views, which catalogs may use for authorization, credential scoping and auditing.

nodes.name: Namespace.java
nodes.summary: Immutable multi-level namespace within a catalog, validating levels (non-null, no null byte) and providing equality, hashing and dotted string output.

nodes.name: SessionCatalog.java
nodes.summary: Catalog interface where every table and namespace operation takes a SessionContext (session id, identity, credentials, properties), enabling per-user catalogs such as REST.

nodes.name: SupportsNamespaces.java
nodes.summary: Mixin interface for catalogs that manage namespaces: create, list (hierarchically), load metadata, drop, set and remove properties, and an existence check.

nodes.name: TableIdentifier.java
nodes.summary: Immutable identifier of a table made of a Namespace and a name, with factories (of, parse), lower-casing, equality and dotted string form.

nodes.name: ViewCatalog.java
nodes.summary: Catalog interface for SQL views: list, load, check existence, build, drop, rename, invalidate and register, with an initialize hook for engine-created catalogs.

nodes.name: ViewSessionCatalog.java
nodes.summary: Session-aware counterpart of ViewCatalog where each view operation receives a SessionCatalog.SessionContext.

nodes.name: EncryptedKey.java
nodes.summary: Serializable description of an encrypted key (id, encrypted key metadata, id of the encrypting key, properties) stored in table metadata.

nodes.name: EncryptionManager.java
nodes.summary: Serializable module that decrypts input files and encrypts output files, with default bulk variants that map the single-file methods and may be overridden for key batching.

nodes.name: AlreadyExistsException.java
nodes.summary: Unchecked exception raised when creating a table or similar object that already exists; supports format-string messages and a cause.

nodes.name: CleanableFailure.java
nodes.summary: Marker interface for commit exceptions whose failure state is known so uncommitted metadata can be cleaned up.

nodes.name: CommitFailedException.java
nodes.summary: Unchecked cleanable exception raised when a commit fails because the table metadata is out of date.

nodes.name: CommitStateUnknownException.java
nodes.summary: Unchecked exception signalling that it is unknown whether a commit was applied; its message warns against retry or cleanup and mentions Remove Orphan Files.

nodes.name: NamespaceNotEmptyException.java
nodes.summary: Unchecked exception raised when dropping a namespace that still contains objects.

nodes.name: NoSuchNamespaceException.java
nodes.summary: Unchecked cleanable exception raised when a requested namespace does not exist.

nodes.name: NoSuchTableException.java
nodes.summary: Unchecked cleanable exception raised when a requested table does not exist.

nodes.name: LoadContext
nodes.summary: Final immutable class holding the list of referencing views, with a shared EMPTY instance, builder() and empty() factories.

nodes.name: referencedBy
nodes.summary: Returns the view reference chain, outermost first.

nodes.name: builder
nodes.summary: Creates a new LoadContext.Builder.

nodes.name: empty
nodes.summary: Returns the shared empty LoadContext singleton.

nodes.name: Builder
nodes.summary: Nested builder with referencedBy(List) and build() producing a LoadContext.

nodes.name: Namespace
nodes.summary: Value class wrapping an array of levels with a shared empty instance, null-safe factory, accessors, equals, hashCode and dotted toString.

nodes.name: empty
nodes.summary: Returns the shared empty namespace.

nodes.name: of
nodes.summary: Creates a Namespace from levels after checking for a null array, null levels and null-byte characters; returns empty() for no levels.

nodes.name: equals
nodes.summary: Equality based on the levels array.

nodes.name: SessionCatalog
nodes.summary: Interface mirroring Catalog and SupportsNamespaces operations with a SessionContext first parameter, plus initialize, name, properties, purgeTable and buildTable.

nodes.name: SessionContext
nodes.summary: Final nested class carrying session id, identity, credentials, properties and an opaque wrapped identity; createEmpty() generates a random session id.

nodes.name: createEmpty
nodes.summary: Creates an anonymous SessionContext with a random UUID session id and empty credentials and properties.

nodes.name: SupportsNamespaces
nodes.summary: Interface declaring namespace create, hierarchical listing, metadata load, drop, property set and remove, with namespaceExists implemented via loadNamespaceMetadata.

nodes.name: TableIdentifier
nodes.summary: Value class pairing a Namespace with a non-empty table name, with of/parse factories, hasNamespace, toLowerCase, equals, hashCode and toString.

nodes.name: of
nodes.summary: Factories building an identifier from varargs names (last is the table name) or from a Namespace and name.

nodes.name: parse
nodes.summary: Splits a dotted string on '.' and delegates to of(String...).

nodes.name: toLowerCase
nodes.summary: Returns a new identifier with every namespace level and the name lower-cased.

nodes.name: equals
nodes.summary: Equality on namespace and name.

nodes.name: ViewCatalog
nodes.summary: Interface for view operations with a default loadView(context), viewExists via loadView, unsupported registerView, and an empty initialize hook.

nodes.name: ViewSessionCatalog
nodes.summary: Interface of view operations taking a SessionContext, with viewExists via loadView and unsupported registerView by default.

nodes.name: EncryptedKey
nodes.summary: Serializable interface with keyId, encryptedKeyMetadata, encryptedById and properties.

nodes.name: EncryptionManager
nodes.summary: Interface with decrypt and encrypt methods for single files and iterables, the latter defaulting to Iterables.transform over the single-file methods.

nodes.name: AlreadyExistsException
nodes.summary: RuntimeException with formatted-message constructors with and without a cause.

nodes.name: CleanableFailure
nodes.summary: Empty marker interface for cleanable commit failures.

nodes.name: CommitFailedException
nodes.summary: RuntimeException implementing CleanableFailure with formatted-message, cause and cause-only constructors.

nodes.name: CommitStateUnknownException
nodes.summary: RuntimeException whose message appends guidance about unknown commit state; deliberately not a CleanableFailure.

nodes.name: NamespaceNotEmptyException
nodes.summary: RuntimeException with formatted-message constructors with and without a cause.

nodes.name: NoSuchNamespaceException
nodes.summary: RuntimeException implementing CleanableFailure for a missing namespace.

nodes.name: NoSuchTableException
nodes.summary: RuntimeException implementing CleanableFailure for a missing table.

nodes.name: NoSuchViewException.java
nodes.summary: Unchecked exception thrown when a requested view does not exist in a catalog. Marked CleanableFailure so callers know that cleanup of uncommitted files is safe after it is raised.

nodes.name: NoSuchViewException
nodes.summary: RuntimeException implementing CleanableFailure with printf-style message and optional cause constructors (annotated with @FormatMethod).

nodes.name: UnprocessableEntityException.java
nodes.summary: REST-layer exception that represents an HTTP 422 style "unprocessable entity" failure returned by a catalog server.

nodes.name: UnprocessableEntityException
nodes.summary: RESTException subclass with a printf-style message constructor.

nodes.name: FileIO.java
nodes.summary: Core pluggable I/O abstraction used to create input and output files and delete files. Provides default overloads for data, delete, manifest and manifest list files that refuse encrypted content unless wrapped by an encrypting FileIO.
nodes.languageNotes: Java interface with many default methods; implementations are loaded reflectively by CatalogUtil.loadFileIO.

nodes.name: FileIO
nodes.summary: Serializable, Closeable interface for newInputFile/newOutputFile/deleteFile with default helpers that derive paths and lengths from DataFile, DeleteFile, ManifestFile and ManifestListFile and reject encrypted keyMetadata.

nodes.name: LocationProvider.java
nodes.summary: Interface for producing the locations of new data files, optionally based on partition data. Implemented by the default and object-store providers and by user-supplied plugins.

nodes.name: LocationProvider
nodes.summary: Serializable interface with newDataLocation(filename) and newDataLocation(spec, partitionData, filename).

nodes.name: LoggingMetricsReporter.java
nodes.summary: Default MetricsReporter that logs every received MetricsReport at INFO level through SLF4J, exposed as a singleton.

nodes.name: LoggingMetricsReporter
nodes.summary: Singleton MetricsReporter whose report() logs the report with SLF4J.

nodes.name: instance
nodes.summary: Returns the shared LoggingMetricsReporter singleton.

nodes.name: MetricsReporter.java
nodes.summary: Functional interface for receiving metrics reports (for example scan reports and commit reports) produced by Iceberg operations.

nodes.name: MetricsReporter
nodes.summary: Closeable functional interface with default initialize(properties) and close() hooks and an abstract report(MetricsReport).

nodes.name: ReplaceViewVersion.java
nodes.summary: Pending-update API for replacing the current version of a view, combining PendingUpdate semantics with the shared VersionBuilder fluent setters.

nodes.name: ReplaceViewVersion
nodes.summary: Marker interface extending PendingUpdate<ViewVersion> and VersionBuilder<ReplaceViewVersion>.

nodes.name: SQLViewRepresentation.java
nodes.summary: View representation holding SQL text and its dialect; its type() is fixed to the "sql" representation type.

nodes.name: SQLViewRepresentation
nodes.summary: Interface extending ViewRepresentation with sql() and dialect() accessors and a default type() of Type.SQL.

nodes.name: UpdateViewProperties.java
nodes.summary: Pending-update API for setting and removing view properties; commits return the resulting property map.

nodes.name: UpdateViewProperties
nodes.summary: PendingUpdate<Map<String,String>> with fluent set(key,value) and remove(key).

nodes.name: View.java
nodes.summary: Public read interface of an Iceberg view: name, schemas, versions, history, properties and update entry points. Optional operations such as location, uuid and sqlFor default to UnsupportedOperationException.

nodes.name: View
nodes.summary: Interface exposing current/historical ViewVersions, schemas, properties and factory methods for UpdateViewProperties, ReplaceViewVersion and UpdateLocation.

nodes.name: ViewBuilder.java
nodes.summary: Fluent builder API for creating, replacing or create-or-replacing a view, extending the shared VersionBuilder setters with properties and location.

nodes.name: ViewBuilder
nodes.summary: Interface with withProperties/withProperty/withLocation plus create(), replace() and createOrReplace() terminal operations.

nodes.name: ViewRepresentation.java
nodes.summary: Root interface for the different ways a view can be represented (currently only SQL), carrying a type discriminator and a Type constants holder.

nodes.name: ViewRepresentation
nodes.summary: Interface exposing type() with a nested constants class Type defining SQL = "sql".

nodes.name: ViewVersion.java
nodes.summary: Immutable description of a single view version: id, timestamp, summary, representations, schema id, default catalog and namespace.

nodes.name: ViewVersion
nodes.summary: Interface with versionId, timestampMillis, summary, representations, schemaId and defaultNamespace; operation() derives "create" or "replace" from the version id.

nodes.name: BaseManifestListFile.java
nodes.summary: Package-private serializable ManifestListFile implementation holding a manifest list location and optional encryption key id, and decrypting key metadata through EncryptionUtil.

nodes.name: BaseManifestListFile
nodes.summary: Value class implementing ManifestListFile with location, encryptionKeyID and decryptKeyMetadata(EncryptionManager).

nodes.name: BaseMetadataTable.java
nodes.summary: Abstract base for Iceberg metadata tables (entries, files, snapshots, ...). Wraps a BaseTable and delegates IO, location, snapshots and history to it while exposing an unpartitioned, unsorted, read-only table view.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses writeReplace() to serialize as a SerializableTable copy rather than the live object.

nodes.name: BaseMetadataTable
nodes.summary: Abstract BaseReadOnlyTable that proxies the underlying BaseTable, tracks which metadata table types support time travel, and provides helpers to remap partition specs onto a metadata table schema.

nodes.name: transformSpec
nodes.summary: Rebuilds a PartitionSpec against a metadata table schema, remapping source field ids and using identity transforms.

nodes.name: BaseMetadataTableScan.java
nodes.summary: Abstract table scan for metadata tables that disables incremental append scans and reads the split size from the metadata split-size table property.

nodes.name: BaseMetadataTableScan
nodes.summary: BaseTableScan subclass carrying a MetadataTableType; appendsBetween/appendsAfter throw UnsupportedOperationException.

nodes.name: targetSplitSize
nodes.summary: Resolves target split size from scan options falling back to the table metadata split size property.

nodes.name: BaseMetastoreCatalog.java
nodes.summary: Abstract Catalog base class for metastore-backed catalogs. Implements table loading (including metadata tables), registration, and a TableBuilder supporting create and replace transactions, leaving TableOperations and warehouse location to subclasses.
nodes.languageNotes: Template-method pattern: subclasses provide newTableOps and defaultWarehouseLocation; the inner TableBuilder is a non-static protected class.

nodes.name: BaseMetastoreCatalog
nodes.summary: Abstract Catalog and Closeable that builds BaseTable instances from TableOperations, lazily loads a MetricsReporter, and applies catalog-level table default and override properties.

nodes.name: BaseMetastoreCatalogTableBuilder
nodes.summary: Inner TableBuilder that accumulates schema, spec, sort order, location and properties, then creates a table or starts create/replace transactions.

nodes.name: loadTable
nodes.summary: Loads a table by identifier via newTableOps, falling back to metadata table loading when the identifier names a metadata table.

nodes.name: registerTable
nodes.summary: Registers an existing metadata file as a table by reading its TableMetadata and committing it through new TableOperations.

nodes.name: loadMetadataTable
nodes.summary: Creates a metadata table instance for identifiers like db.table.snapshots by resolving the base table and MetadataTableType.

nodes.name: BaseMetastoreOperations.java
nodes.summary: Abstract helper shared by metastore table and view operations that determines whether an ambiguous commit actually succeeded by polling with exponential backoff.

nodes.name: BaseMetastoreOperations
nodes.summary: Provides checkCommitStatus and checkCommitStatusStrict, which retry a supplied check using Tasks and configured wait properties.

nodes.name: CommitStatus
nodes.summary: Public enum with FAILURE, SUCCESS and UNKNOWN outcomes of a commit status check.

nodes.name: checkCommitStatus
nodes.summary: Runs the strict check and downgrades a FAILURE result to UNKNOWN because the new metadata location may not be visible yet.

nodes.name: checkCommitStatusStrict
nodes.summary: Polls a supplier with retry and exponential backoff configured by table properties to decide SUCCESS, FAILURE or UNKNOWN for a commit.

nodes.name: BaseMetastoreTableOperations.java
nodes.summary: Abstract TableOperations base for catalogs that store a pointer to the current metadata file. Handles refresh, optimistic commit checks, metadata file writing and versioning, and offers a read-only temp() view.
nodes.languageNotes: Subclasses implement doRefresh and doCommit; shouldRefresh flag drives lazy refresh in current().

nodes.name: BaseMetastoreTableOperations
nodes.summary: Extends BaseMetastoreOperations and implements TableOperations with refreshFromMetadataLocation (retrying reads), writeNewMetadata, and checkCommitStatus helpers.

nodes.name: refresh
nodes.summary: Calls doRefresh and resets cached metadata state if the table disappeared.

nodes.name: commit
nodes.summary: Validates the base metadata is current, delegates to doCommit, then cleans removed metadata files and requests a refresh.

nodes.name: writeNewMetadata
nodes.summary: Serializes TableMetadata to a new versioned metadata file and returns its location.

nodes.name: refreshFromMetadataLocation
nodes.summary: Reads table metadata from a new location with retries, verifies the table UUID is unchanged and updates cached state and version.

nodes.name: temp
nodes.summary: Returns an anonymous TableOperations over uncommitted metadata that forbids refresh and commit.

nodes.name: checkCurrentMetadataLocation
nodes.summary: Refreshes and checks if the given metadata location is current or present in the metadata log.

nodes.name: parseVersion
nodes.summary: Extracts the numeric version prefix from a metadata file name, returning -1 if absent or unparseable.

nodes.name: BaseReplaceSortOrder.java
nodes.summary: Implementation of ReplaceSortOrder that builds a new SortOrder and commits it to table metadata with retry on CommitFailedException.

nodes.name: BaseReplaceSortOrder
nodes.summary: ReplaceSortOrder builder with asc/desc/caseSensitive and a commit() that refreshes, replaces the sort order and commits with exponential backoff.

nodes.name: commit
nodes.summary: Retries refresh, replaceSortOrder and commit using Tasks with table-configured backoff, only on CommitFailedException.

nodes.name: BaseTable.java
nodes.summary: Standard Table implementation backed by TableOperations. Creates scans, update operations (append, rewrite, delete, schema, spec) and transactions, wiring a MetricsReporter into each.
nodes.languageNotes: writeReplace() makes serialization produce a SerializableTable snapshot instead of the live operations object.

nodes.name: BaseTable
nodes.summary: Table facade that delegates reads to ops.current() and returns configured update, scan and transaction objects; supports labels and combined metrics reporters.

nodes.name: BaseTransaction.java
nodes.summary: Transaction implementation that collects pending updates against in-memory metadata and commits them atomically as create, replace, create-or-replace or simple transactions, with retries and cleanup of uncommitted files.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains inner classes TransactionTableOperations and TransactionTable that route all updates back into the enclosing transaction.

nodes.name: BaseTransaction
nodes.summary: Tracks base and current TableMetadata, appends PendingUpdates through transaction-scoped operations and commits by transaction type.

nodes.name: TransactionType
nodes.summary: Enum of transaction kinds: CREATE_TABLE, REPLACE_TABLE, CREATE_OR_REPLACE_TABLE and SIMPLE.

nodes.name: TransactionTableOperations
nodes.summary: TableOperations whose current/refresh return the transaction metadata and whose commit only updates in-memory state.

nodes.name: TransactionTable
nodes.summary: Table view over the transaction state; update methods delegate to the enclosing transaction while scans and nested transactions are unsupported.

nodes.name: PendingUpdateFailedException
nodes.summary: Private RuntimeException wrapper that carries a CommitFailedException raised while re-applying updates.

nodes.name: appendUpdate
nodes.summary: Registers a PendingUpdate, wiring delete callbacks and metrics reporting for snapshot updates.

nodes.name: checkLastOperationCommitted
nodes.summary: Ensures the previous update was committed before another is created.

nodes.name: commitTransaction
nodes.summary: Dispatches to the commit routine matching the TransactionType.

nodes.name: commitCreateTransaction
nodes.summary: Commits new table metadata and cleans up uncommitted files on failure.

nodes.name: commitReplaceTransaction
nodes.summary: Retries refresh and commit of replacement metadata, optionally creating the table.

nodes.name: commitSimpleTransaction
nodes.summary: Retries reapplying all pending updates on fresh metadata, commits, and deletes files not referenced by committed snapshots.

nodes.name: cleanAllUpdates
nodes.summary: Invokes cleanAll on every SnapshotProducer update, suppressing failures.

nodes.name: applyUpdates
nodes.summary: Refreshes the base and re-commits each pending update when the underlying table changed.

nodes.name: committedFiles
nodes.summary: Collects manifest list and manifest paths from the given snapshots.

nodes.name: CachingCatalog.java
nodes.summary: Catalog decorator that caches loaded tables in a Caffeine cache with optional expiration, invalidating related metadata tables on eviction, drop, rename and register.

nodes.name: CachingCatalog
nodes.summary: Catalog wrapper with static wrap() factories and a table cache keyed by (optionally lower-cased) TableIdentifier.

nodes.name: MetadataTableInvalidatingRemovalListener
nodes.summary: Caffeine RemovalListener that invalidates cached metadata tables when their base table expires.

nodes.name: CachingTableBuilder
nodes.summary: TableBuilder that creates through the cache and invalidates the table after replace transactions commit.

nodes.name: wrap
nodes.summary: Creates a CachingCatalog with given case sensitivity and expiration interval (overloads default these values).

nodes.name: createTableCache
nodes.summary: Builds the Caffeine cache with soft values and, if expiration is positive, an expireAfterAccess policy and removal listener.

nodes.name: loadTable
nodes.summary: Loads a table through the cache and rebuilds metadata tables from the cached base table operations.

nodes.name: metadataTableIdentifiers
nodes.summary: Enumerates every metadata table identifier (upper and lower case) for a base table identifier.

nodes.name: CatalogProperties.java
nodes.summary: Holder of string constants for catalog configuration keys and defaults, such as catalog implementation, warehouse, cache, file IO, metrics reporter, commit retry and REST-related properties.

nodes.name: CatalogProperties
nodes.summary: Non-instantiable class containing public static final property names and default values for catalogs.

nodes.name: CatalogUtil.java
nodes.summary: Static utilities for catalogs: reflective loading of Catalog, FileIO and MetricsReporter implementations, Hadoop conf injection, dropping table and view data files, and removing old metadata files.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses DynConstructors for reflective instantiation and sets Hadoop Configuration via reflection so Hadoop stays an optional dependency.

nodes.name: CatalogUtil
nodes.summary: Utility class with catalog type constants and static helpers for loading plugins and cleaning up table files.

nodes.name: dropTableData
nodes.summary: Deletes manifests, manifest lists, previous metadata, statistics and (when GC is enabled) data files for a dropped table.

nodes.name: dropViewMetadata
nodes.summary: Deletes metadata files of a dropped view when GC is enabled.

nodes.name: deleteFiles
nodes.summary: Deletes a set of paths (bulk or concurrently, optionally suppressing failures); overloads cover manifest-based data file deletion.

nodes.name: loadCatalog
nodes.summary: Instantiates a Catalog by class name, applies Hadoop conf and calls initialize.

nodes.name: buildIcebergCatalog
nodes.summary: Builds a Catalog from properties, resolving a type alias or implementation class.

nodes.name: loadFileIO
nodes.summary: Reflectively creates and initializes a FileIO, injecting Hadoop conf and storage credentials when supported.

nodes.name: configureHadoopConf
nodes.summary: Calls setConf on a Hadoop Configurable object via reflection without a compile-time Hadoop dependency.

nodes.name: loadMetricsReporter
nodes.summary: Loads a custom MetricsReporter from catalog properties or falls back to LoggingMetricsReporter.

nodes.name: fullTableName
nodes.summary: Formats a catalog-qualified table name using / for URI-like names and . otherwise.

nodes.name: deleteRemovedMetadataFiles
nodes.summary: Deletes metadata log entries removed by a commit when delete-after-commit is enabled.

nodes.name: ClientPoolImpl.java
nodes.summary: Generic blocking pool of reusable clients with optional reconnect-and-retry on connection exceptions, used by metastore catalogs such as JDBC and Hive.

nodes.name: ClientPoolImpl
nodes.summary: Abstract pool of C clients; run() borrows a client, reconnects on connection errors and returns it; close() waits for outstanding clients.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Executes an action with a pooled client, reconnecting up to maxRetries when a connection exception occurs.

nodes.name: close
nodes.summary: Marks the pool closed and drains and closes all clients, waiting for borrowed ones to return.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Blocks until an idle client is available or a new one can be created within pool size.

nodes.name: DataTableScan.java
nodes.summary: TableScan over a table data files that plans file scan tasks by grouping data and delete manifests through ManifestGroup, and supports incremental append scans.

nodes.name: DataTableScan
nodes.summary: BaseTableScan implementation whose doPlanFiles builds a ManifestGroup with filters, projections and metrics.

nodes.name: appendsBetween
nodes.summary: Returns an incremental scan restricted to snapshots in the given range.

nodes.name: doPlanFiles
nodes.summary: Plans FileScanTasks from current snapshot manifests with optional residual-ignoring and parallel planning.

nodes.name: EnvironmentContext.java
nodes.summary: Global thread-safe registry of key/value properties (such as iceberg-version, engine-name and engine-version) describing the runtime environment, attached to commit summaries.

nodes.name: EnvironmentContext
nodes.summary: Static concurrent map seeded with iceberg-version, with get/put/remove accessors.

nodes.name: Labels.java
nodes.summary: Immutables-generated value interface describing object-level and field-level labels attached to a table, with an EMPTY constant.
nodes.languageNotes: Annotated with @Value.Immutable; ImmutableLabels is generated at compile time.

nodes.name: Labels
nodes.summary: Interface with objectLabels(), fields() and a derived isEmpty().

nodes.name: LocationProviders.java
nodes.summary: Factory and implementations of LocationProvider: it loads a custom provider by class name or chooses between the default layout and a hash-prefixed object-store layout based on table properties.

nodes.name: LocationProviders
nodes.summary: Utility with locationsFor() selecting the LocationProvider implementation.

nodes.name: DefaultLocationProvider
nodes.summary: Places data files under <table>/data with partition path segments.

nodes.name: ObjectStoreLocationProvider
nodes.summary: Spreads files across hashed directory prefixes (murmur3) to avoid object store hot spots.

nodes.name: locationsFor
nodes.summary: Returns a custom, object-store or default LocationProvider based on table properties.

nodes.name: getAndCheckLegacyLocation
nodes.summary: Reads a location property and rejects deprecated keys.

nodes.name: MetadataTableType.java
nodes.summary: Enum of the supported metadata table kinds (entries, files, snapshots, manifests, partitions, all_* variants and position_deletes) with a case-insensitive lookup.

nodes.name: MetadataTableType
nodes.summary: Enum with from(String) returning null for unknown names.

nodes.name: from
nodes.summary: Maps a table name to a MetadataTableType case-insensitively, or null.

nodes.name: MetadataTableUtils.java
nodes.summary: Static factory for metadata table instances (entries, files, snapshots, partitions, ...) from a base table, table operations or catalog identifiers.

nodes.name: MetadataTableUtils
nodes.summary: Utility class that switches on MetadataTableType to instantiate the right metadata table implementation.

nodes.name: hasMetadataTableName
nodes.summary: Checks whether an identifier name is a known metadata table type.

nodes.name: createMetadataTableInstance
nodes.summary: Switches on MetadataTableType to instantiate the matching metadata table for a base table (overloads accept ops or catalog identifiers).

nodes.name: MetadataUpdate.java
nodes.summary: Serializable change-log vocabulary for table and view metadata: one nested class per mutation (AssignUUID, AddSchema, AddSnapshot, SetSnapshotRef, SetProperties, SetLocation, encryption keys and more), each applying itself to a TableMetadata.Builder or ViewMetadata.Builder.
nodes.languageNotes: Interface with default applyTo methods that throw UnsupportedOperationException, so each nested update class overrides only the target (table or view) it supports.

nodes.name: PropertiesUpdate.java
nodes.summary: Package-private UpdateProperties implementation that collects property sets and removals, validates metrics settings against the schema, and commits via TableMetadata.replaceProperties with retries.

nodes.name: RemoveSnapshots.java
nodes.summary: ExpireSnapshots implementation that decides which snapshots and refs to expire by age, retain-last and ref retention rules, commits the metadata change, then deletes unreachable files via incremental or reachable-file cleanup strategies.

nodes.name: SerializableTable.java
nodes.summary: Serializable read-only Table copy that stores schema, specs and sort orders as JSON and lazily rebuilds a real table, so tables can be shipped to engine workers; mutating operations throw UnsupportedOperationException.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses transient volatile lazy fields and a Try wrapper so deserialization never fails eagerly on optional parts such as the LocationProvider.

nodes.name: SetLocation.java
nodes.summary: UpdateLocation implementation that changes the table base location and commits it through TableOperations with exponential-backoff retries.

nodes.name: SetSnapshotOperation.java
nodes.summary: Package-private PendingUpdate that sets the main branch to a given snapshot or rolls back to a snapshot or timestamp, validating that the target is an ancestor of the current state.

nodes.name: SetStatistics.java
nodes.summary: UpdateStatistics implementation that sets or removes table statistics files per snapshot and commits the resulting metadata with retries.

nodes.name: MetadataUpdate
nodes.summary: Public interface for a single change to table or view metadata; it is Serializable and defines default applyTo hooks for TableMetadata.Builder and ViewMetadata.Builder that nested update classes override.

nodes.name: AddSchema
nodes.summary: Update that adds a schema (with its last column id) to table metadata, or to view metadata when applied to a ViewMetadata.Builder.

nodes.name: AddSnapshot
nodes.summary: Update that appends a new Snapshot to the table metadata via addSnapshot.

nodes.name: SetSnapshotRef
nodes.summary: Update that creates or moves a named branch or tag to a snapshot, carrying optional retention settings (min snapshots, max snapshot age, max ref age).

nodes.name: SetProperties
nodes.summary: Update that sets a map of properties on table or view metadata.

nodes.name: PropertiesUpdate
nodes.summary: Package-private UpdateProperties implementation holding pending property updates and removals, applied to the base metadata on commit.

nodes.name: RemoveSnapshots
nodes.summary: ExpireSnapshots implementation configured by snapshot ids, age cutoffs, retain-last, custom delete functions and an executor, which builds the expired metadata and then runs file cleanup.

nodes.name: SerializableTable
nodes.summary: Serializable Table snapshot of an existing table with eagerly captured name, location, properties, refs and serialized schema, specs and sort orders, and lazily rebuilt transient objects.

nodes.name: SerializableMetadataTable
nodes.summary: SerializableTable subclass for metadata tables that keeps the metadata table type and base table name and recreates the metadata table through MetadataTableUtils.

nodes.name: SetLocation
nodes.summary: UpdateLocation implementation that stores a new location and commits it with retries.

nodes.name: SetSnapshotOperation
nodes.summary: PendingUpdate that targets either a specific snapshot or a rollback point and produces the snapshot to set as current on main.

nodes.name: SetStatistics
nodes.summary: UpdateStatistics implementation tracking per-snapshot statistics files to set or remove.

nodes.name: apply
nodes.summary: Refreshes base metadata, drops removed keys, overlays the pending updates and validates metrics column settings against the schema, returning the merged property map.

nodes.name: commit
nodes.summary: Retries on CommitFailedException with backoff settings read tolerantly via propertyTryAsInt, then commits base.replaceProperties of the merged map.

nodes.name: internalApply
nodes.summary: Computes the expired metadata: determines retained refs and snapshots, removes expired refs and snapshots, and optionally prunes unreachable specs and schemas.

nodes.name: computeRetainedRefs
nodes.summary: Keeps main and any ref whose snapshot exists and is younger than its max ref age; drops refs whose snapshot is missing.

nodes.name: computeAllBranchSnapshotsToRetain
nodes.summary: Aggregates snapshot ids to keep for every retained branch.

nodes.name: unreferencedSnapshotsToRetain
nodes.summary: Finds snapshots not reachable from any retained ref that are still newer than the expire-older-than cutoff and so must be kept.

nodes.name: commit
nodes.summary: Commits the expired metadata with exponential-backoff retries and then triggers file cleanup when a cleanup level is set.

nodes.name: cleanExpiredSnapshots
nodes.summary: Chooses between incremental and reachable file cleanup strategies and deletes files that only expired snapshots referenced.

nodes.name: validateCleanupCanBeIncremental
nodes.summary: Throws UnsupportedOperationException when incremental cleanup was requested but snapshot ids were specified, non-main ancestors were removed, or non-main snapshots exist.

nodes.name: lazyTable
nodes.summary: Double-checked lazy reconstruction of a real Table over StaticTableOperations built from the metadata file location, FileIO and location provider.

nodes.name: specs
nodes.summary: Lazily parses the serialized partition spec JSON map into PartitionSpec objects against the table schema.

nodes.name: copyOf
nodes.summary: Static factory that returns a SerializableMetadataTable for metadata tables and a SerializableTable otherwise.

nodes.name: commit
nodes.summary: Refreshes metadata and commits base.updateLocation(newLocation) with exponential-backoff retries.

nodes.name: apply
nodes.summary: Refreshes base metadata and returns the target snapshot after checking rollback targets are ancestors of the current snapshot.

nodes.name: commit
nodes.summary: Commits main branch pointing to the target snapshot with retries, always committing so transaction state advances.

nodes.name: internalApply
nodes.summary: Builds new metadata from the base, setting or removing the pending statistics files per snapshot.

nodes.name: findLatestAncestorOlderThan
nodes.summary: Scans current ancestors to find the newest snapshot older than a timestamp for rollbackToTime.

nodes.name: commit
nodes.summary: Retries on CommitFailedException, applying internalApply to refreshed metadata and committing the result.

nodes.name: SnapshotManager.java
nodes.summary: ManageSnapshots implementation that records cherry-pick, rollback, branch and tag operations inside a single transaction, delegating ref changes to UpdateSnapshotReferencesOperation.

nodes.name: StaticTableOperations.java
nodes.summary: Read-only TableOperations pinned to a single metadata file location; it loads the metadata once and throws on commit, which makes it suitable for browsing a table without a catalog.

nodes.name: SupportsDistributedScanPlanning.java
nodes.summary: Marker-style interface with a default allowDistributedPlanning method that tables implement to say whether scan planning may be distributed.

nodes.name: TableMetadata.java
nodes.summary: Core immutable model of an Iceberg table's metadata (schemas, specs, sort orders, snapshots, refs, properties, logs, encryption keys) with lazy snapshot loading, a large mutable Builder that records MetadataUpdate changes, and factory methods for new, replaced and upgraded tables.
nodes.languageNotes: Large Builder tracks every mutation as a MetadataUpdate in a change list, which later drives REST commits and UpdateRequirements.

nodes.name: TableMetadataParser.java
nodes.summary: JSON reader and writer for TableMetadata, handling gzip codecs, metadata file naming, per-version field layout for v1 to v3, refs, statistics and encryption keys.

nodes.name: TableOperations.java
nodes.summary: Central SPI that a catalog implements to give a table its current metadata, refresh and atomic commit, plus its FileIO, EncryptionManager, LocationProvider and temp-operations helpers.

nodes.name: TableProperties.java
nodes.summary: Holds the string constants and defaults for every table property: reserved metadata keys, commit retries, manifest merge, Parquet, Avro and ORC write tuning, split planning, metrics, snapshot expiration, row-level operation modes and encryption.

nodes.name: SnapshotManager
nodes.summary: ManageSnapshots implementation that wraps a Transaction and lazily creates a snapshot references update for branch and tag operations.

nodes.name: StaticTableOperations
nodes.summary: Read-only TableOperations that lazily loads one metadata file and rejects commits.

nodes.name: SupportsDistributedScanPlanning
nodes.summary: Interface whose default allowDistributedPlanning returns true; tables override it to opt out of distributed scan planning.

nodes.name: TableMetadata
nodes.summary: Serializable immutable table metadata with accessors for schemas, specs, sort orders, snapshots, refs and properties, lazy snapshot loading, and fluent helpers that return new metadata via Builder.

nodes.name: SnapshotLogEntry
nodes.summary: Immutable timestamp and snapshot id pair recorded in the snapshot log.

nodes.name: MetadataLogEntry
nodes.summary: Immutable timestamp and file location pair recorded in the previous-metadata log.

nodes.name: Builder
nodes.summary: Large mutable builder for TableMetadata that applies schema, spec, sort order, snapshot, ref, property, statistics and encryption key changes while validating them and recording each as a MetadataUpdate.

nodes.name: TableMetadataParser
nodes.summary: Static JSON serializer and deserializer for TableMetadata, with codec-aware file reading and writing.

nodes.name: Codec
nodes.summary: Enum of metadata file compression codecs (NONE and GZIP) with file extension lookup and name or file-name parsing.

nodes.name: TableOperations
nodes.summary: Interface for reading current table metadata, refreshing, atomically committing changes, and obtaining IO, encryption and location services.

nodes.name: TableProperties
nodes.summary: Final holder class of public property-name and default-value constants for tables.

nodes.name: createBranch
nodes.summary: Creates a branch at the current snapshot, or for an empty table creates an empty snapshot on the new branch via a fast append.

nodes.name: newTableMetadata
nodes.summary: Creates fresh metadata for a new table: assigns ids to schema and partition spec, reconciles properties and format version, and starts the change log.

nodes.name: persistedProperties
nodes.summary: Adds defaults that apply only to newly created tables (such as Parquet compression) to the supplied properties.

nodes.name: ensureSnapshotsLoaded
nodes.summary: Synchronized lazy load of snapshots from the supplier, filtering by last sequence number and validating refs and current snapshot.

nodes.name: replaceProperties
nodes.summary: Splits property updates into sets and removals, extracts the format-version property and returns new metadata through the Builder.

nodes.name: reassignPartitionIds
nodes.summary: Rebuilds a PartitionSpec with fresh partition field ids, using void transforms for dropped fields in v1.

nodes.name: buildReplacement
nodes.summary: Builds replacement metadata for a replace-table operation, reassigning schema, spec and sort order ids while keeping the table identity.

nodes.name: freshSpec
nodes.summary: Maps a partition spec onto a fresh schema by source column name and reassigns ids.

nodes.name: freshSortOrder
nodes.summary: Maps a sort order onto a fresh schema by column name.

nodes.name: validateRefs
nodes.summary: Verifies that every ref targets an existing snapshot and that the main branch matches the current snapshot id.

nodes.name: buildFrom
nodes.summary: Starts a Builder from existing metadata.

nodes.name: internalWrite
nodes.summary: Writes metadata JSON to an OutputFile, gzip-compressing when the file name asks for it and choosing create or overwrite.

nodes.name: toJson
nodes.summary: Generates the JSON for TableMetadata fields including schemas, specs, sort orders, snapshots, refs, logs, statistics and encryption keys.

nodes.name: fromJson
nodes.summary: Parses table metadata JSON into TableMetadata, handling v1 to v3 differences, legacy schema and spec layouts, snapshots and refs.

nodes.name: refsFromJson
nodes.summary: Parses the refs JSON object into a map of SnapshotRef values.

nodes.name: current
nodes.summary: Lazily loads the static metadata via TableMetadataParser.read and caches it.

nodes.name: Transactions.java
nodes.summary: Static factory for BaseTransaction instances covering create, replace, create-or-replace and plain table transactions.

nodes.name: UpdateRequirement.java
nodes.summary: Interface for preconditions (asserts) a REST commit sends with metadata updates, with nested implementations such as AssertTableUUID, AssertRefSnapshotID and AssertCurrentSchemaID that validate against base table or view metadata.

nodes.name: UpdateRequirements.java
nodes.summary: Derives the list of UpdateRequirement asserts needed for creating, replacing or updating a table or replacing a view by inspecting the MetadataUpdates through an internal builder.

nodes.name: BaseAction.java
nodes.summary: Package-private abstract base for table actions that adds a helper to build metadata table names correctly for path, Hadoop and Hive style table names.

nodes.name: BaseCommitService.java
nodes.summary: Abstract asynchronous commit service for rewrite actions: completed file groups are queued and committed in batches by a single-thread executor, enabling partial progress, with timeout handling and abort of uncommitted groups on close.

nodes.name: BaseRewriteDataFilesAction.java
nodes.summary: Legacy abstract compaction action that plans scan tasks per partition, bin-packs them to a target size, delegates the physical rewrite to engines, and swaps old files for new ones via RewriteFiles with retries.

nodes.name: RewriteDataFilesCommitManager.java
nodes.summary: Commits groups of rewritten data files in one RewriteFiles snapshot, cleans up written files on cleanable failures, and exposes a CommitService for partial-progress commits.

nodes.name: Transactions
nodes.summary: Utility class with static factories creating BaseTransaction objects for each transaction kind.

nodes.name: UpdateRequirement
nodes.summary: Interface with validate for a table or view base metadata and nested requirement classes that fail the commit with CommitFailedException or ValidationException when preconditions do not hold.

nodes.name: AssertTableUUID
nodes.summary: Requirement that the table UUID in base metadata equals the expected UUID.

nodes.name: AssertRefSnapshotID
nodes.summary: Requirement that a named ref still points to the expected snapshot id (or does not exist when the id is null).

nodes.name: AssertTableDoesNotExist
nodes.summary: Requirement that fails when base table metadata is present, used for create-table commits.

nodes.name: UpdateRequirements
nodes.summary: Utility class generating requirement lists for create, replace and update of tables and replace of views.

nodes.name: Builder
nodes.summary: Private visitor that inspects each MetadataUpdate and adds the matching UpdateRequirement (UUID, current schema, default spec, sort order, last assigned ids, ref snapshot) once per kind.

nodes.name: BaseAction
nodes.summary: Package-private abstract Action base requiring a table() and providing metadataTableName helpers.

nodes.name: BaseCommitService
nodes.summary: Abstract Closeable service that queues rewritten file groups, commits them in batches on a background thread and aborts leftovers when closing.

nodes.name: BaseRewriteDataFilesAction
nodes.summary: Abstract bin-pack compaction action with options for filter, target size, split lookback, open file cost and starting sequence number.

nodes.name: RewriteDataFilesCommitManager
nodes.summary: Commit coordinator for rewritten data file groups with starting snapshot validation and optional branch targeting.

nodes.name: CommitService
nodes.summary: BaseCommitService specialization that commits RewriteFileGroup batches via commitOrClean and aborts via abortFileGroup.

nodes.name: forCreateTable
nodes.summary: Creates requirements for a new table: asserts the table does not exist, then adds requirements derived from the updates.

nodes.name: forReplaceTable
nodes.summary: Creates requirements for replacing a table, starting with a table UUID assertion.

nodes.name: forUpdateTable
nodes.summary: Creates requirements for updating a table, starting with a table UUID assertion.

nodes.name: forReplaceView
nodes.summary: Creates requirements for replacing a view, starting with a view UUID assertion.

nodes.name: createTableTransaction
nodes.summary: Creates a BaseTransaction of type CREATE_TABLE after checking that the table does not already exist.

nodes.name: replaceTableTransaction
nodes.summary: Creates a BaseTransaction of type REPLACE_TABLE for the given table name, operations and replacement metadata.

nodes.name: createOrReplaceTableTransaction
nodes.summary: Creates a BaseTransaction for create-or-replace semantics.

nodes.name: metadataTableName
nodes.summary: Builds a loadable metadata table name for path, Hadoop, Hive or plain names.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Starts the single-thread committer loop that drains completed groups and commits batches until closed.

nodes.name: close
nodes.summary: Stops the service, waits for pending commits up to the timeout, aborts uncommitted groups and validates that nothing remains.

nodes.name: commitReadyCommitGroups
nodes.summary: Pulls a batch of completed groups under a lock and commits it with commitOrClean, tolerating failures in partial-progress mode.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Plans a scan of the current snapshot, groups tasks by partition, bin-packs them, rewrites them and replaces the old data files.

nodes.name: replaceDataFiles
nodes.summary: Calls doReplace and, on a cleanable commit failure, deletes the newly written files; rethrows without cleanup when commit state is unknown.

nodes.name: doReplace
nodes.summary: Builds a RewriteFiles validated from the starting snapshot, deleting old and adding new data files, optionally pinning the starting data sequence number, and commits it.

nodes.name: commitFileGroups
nodes.summary: Gathers rewritten, added and dangling delete files from groups and commits them in one RewriteFiles operation.

nodes.name: abortFileGroup
nodes.summary: Deletes data files added for a group, ignoring and logging failures.

nodes.name: commitOrClean
nodes.summary: Commits groups and cleans up written files on cleanable failures but not when the commit state is unknown.

nodes.name: RewritePositionDeletesCommitManager.java
nodes.summary: Commits rewritten position delete files through RewriteFiles, aborts by deleting newly written delete files, and provides a CommitService for batched partial-progress commits.

nodes.name: BaseSessionCatalog.java
nodes.summary: Abstract SessionCatalog base that exposes a context-bound Catalog adapter (AsCatalog) so session-scoped catalogs can be used through the plain Catalog and SupportsNamespaces APIs.

nodes.name: BaseViewSessionCatalog.java
nodes.summary: Extension of BaseSessionCatalog implementing ViewSessionCatalog, adding an AsViewCatalog adapter that binds a session context to the view API.

nodes.name: TableCommit.java
nodes.summary: Immutables-backed value describing one table's commit (identifier, requirements and updates), with a factory that derives requirements and updates from base and updated TableMetadata.

nodes.name: EncryptionUtil.java
nodes.summary: Static helpers for table encryption: instantiate a KeyManagementClient from catalog properties, build an EncryptionManager from table properties, wrap and unwrap manifest-list key metadata with AES-GCM, and validate encryption properties against the format version.

nodes.name: Configurable.java
nodes.summary: Tiny generic interface with setConf that lets Iceberg classes receive a Hadoop-style configuration without a compile-time dependency on Hadoop's Configurable.

nodes.name: HadoopCatalog.java
nodes.summary: Filesystem-based Catalog that treats directories under a warehouse path as namespaces and tables, using HadoopTableOperations and optional lock managers; no external metastore is needed.

nodes.name: RewritePositionDeletesCommitManager
nodes.summary: Commit coordinator that replaces position delete files for a set of rewrite groups.

nodes.name: CommitService
nodes.summary: BaseCommitService specialization that commits RewritePositionDeletesGroup batches and aborts by deleting added delete files.

nodes.name: BaseSessionCatalog
nodes.summary: Abstract SessionCatalog storing the catalog name and properties and caching per-context Catalog adapters for ten minutes after last access.

nodes.name: AsCatalog
nodes.summary: Inner adapter that forwards Catalog and SupportsNamespaces calls to the outer session catalog using a fixed SessionContext.

nodes.name: BaseViewSessionCatalog
nodes.summary: Abstract session catalog that adds view support and the asViewCatalog adapter.

nodes.name: AsViewCatalog
nodes.summary: Inner adapter that forwards ViewCatalog calls to the outer session catalog with a fixed SessionContext.

nodes.name: TableCommit
nodes.summary: Immutables-annotated interface describing a single table commit with identifier, requirements and updates.

nodes.name: EncryptionUtil
nodes.summary: Utility class for KMS client creation, encryption manager creation and manifest-list key metadata protection.

nodes.name: Configurable
nodes.summary: Generic interface with a single setConf method for injecting configuration objects.

nodes.name: HadoopCatalog
nodes.summary: Catalog backed by a warehouse directory; listing, namespace and drop operations are implemented with direct FileSystem calls.

nodes.name: HadoopCatalogTableBuilder
nodes.summary: Private table builder that rejects any location other than the default warehouse location of the table identifier.

nodes.name: abort
nodes.summary: Deletes the position delete files added for a group via CatalogUtil.deleteFiles.

nodes.name: commit
nodes.summary: Builds a RewriteFiles that removes old position delete files and adds the new ones, then commits.

nodes.name: commitOrClean
nodes.summary: Commits groups and aborts written delete files on cleanable failures but not on unknown commit state.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Validates arguments and builds a TableCommit whose requirements come from UpdateRequirements.forUpdateTable and whose updates are the changes of the updated metadata.

nodes.name: createKmsClient
nodes.summary: Resolves a KMS implementation class from type or impl properties, loads it dynamically and initializes it with the catalog properties.

nodes.name: createEncryptionManager
nodes.summary: Returns a plaintext manager for tables without an encryption key, otherwise a StandardEncryptionManager with a validated data key length.

nodes.name: decryptManifestListKeyMetadata
nodes.summary: Looks up the manifest-list key and its key-encryption key and decrypts the key metadata with AES-GCM using the key timestamp as AAD.

nodes.name: encryptManifestListKeyMetadata
nodes.summary: Encrypts manifest-list key metadata with AES-GCM and the key timestamp as AAD.

nodes.name: checkCompatibility
nodes.summary: Rejects encryption properties on table format versions below 3.

nodes.name: initialize
nodes.summary: Validates the warehouse path, resolves the filesystem, FileIO and lock manager, and registers closeables.

nodes.name: listTables
nodes.summary: Lists subdirectories of the namespace directory that contain table metadata.

nodes.name: dropTable
nodes.summary: Deletes the table directory recursively and, when purging, drops data files via CatalogUtil.dropTableData first.

nodes.name: createNamespace
