nodes.name: BaseTableScan.java
nodes.summary: Abstract base for TableScan implementations that rejects incremental append APIs and plans combined tasks by splitting files and bin-packing them via TableScanUtil.

nodes.name: PartitionData.java
nodes.summary: Mutable StructLike and Avro IndexedRecord that holds partition tuple values for a manifest entry, backed by an Object[] and a partition struct type that must contain only primitives.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements Avro SpecificData.SchemaConstructable so Avro reflection can instantiate it while reading manifests; the Avro Schema is transient and re-parsed from a string after deserialization.

nodes.name: ReachableFileUtil.java
nodes.summary: Static helpers that enumerate files reachable from a table: version hint file, JSON metadata files (optionally recursive through the metadata log), manifest lists and statistics files.

nodes.name: Try.java
nodes.summary: Package-private serializable container capturing either the result or the exception of a SerializableSupplier, rethrowing the original throwable via a sneaky throw.
nodes.languageNotes: sneakyThrow uses a generic exception type parameter to bypass checked-exception declaration.

nodes.name: FileRewritePlan.java
nodes.summary: Immutable result of a FileRewritePlanner.plan() call holding the stream of rewrite groups plus total and per-partition group counts for engines to execute.

nodes.name: FileRewritePlanner.java
nodes.summary: Interface for the planning phase of file rewrites, which selects and groups files, with a validOptions, init and plan lifecycle producing a FileRewritePlan.
nodes.languageNotes: Four type parameters (plan info, scan task, content file, group) tie planner, plan, group and runner together.

nodes.name: FileRewriteRunner.java
nodes.summary: Interface for the engine-specific execution phase of file rewrites, which initializes from options and rewrites each RewriteGroupBase into a set of new files.

nodes.name: RewriteGroupBase.java
nodes.summary: Abstract container for a group of input scan tasks to rewrite together, carrying plan info, task list, max output file size, input split size and expected number of output files.

nodes.name: SizeBasedFileRewritePlanner.java
nodes.summary: Abstract FileRewritePlanner that selects files outside a size range, bin-packs them into groups, and computes split sizes and expected output file counts from configurable thresholds.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines the public option-name constants (target, min, max file size, min input files, rewrite-all, max group size) shared by concrete planners; subclasses plug in via template hooks.

nodes.name: BaseIncrementalChangelogScan
nodes.summary: Concrete incremental changelog scan that plans ChangelogScanTasks and task groups between two snapshots.

nodes.name: doPlanFiles
nodes.summary: Builds a ManifestGroup over data manifests added in the changelog snapshots (ignoring existing entries), applies filters, optional residual skipping and executor, and plans changelog tasks.

nodes.name: planTasks
nodes.summary: Plans changelog task groups by delegating to TableScanUtil.planTaskGroups with the scan's split size, lookback and open file cost.

nodes.name: orderedChangelogSnapshots
nodes.summary: Collects snapshots between two ids from oldest to newest, skipping REPLACE operations and throwing if a snapshot has delete manifests.

nodes.name: computeSnapshotOrdinals
nodes.summary: Maps each snapshot id to its position in the ordered changelog, used as the change ordinal.

nodes.name: CreateDataFileChangeTasks
nodes.summary: Static CreateTasksFunction that turns ADDED and DELETED manifest entries into BaseAddedRowsScanTask and BaseDeletedDataFileScanTask with their change ordinals.

nodes.name: BaseTableScan
nodes.summary: Abstract TableScan base extending SnapshotScan; incremental appendsBetween and appendsAfter are unsupported and planTasks produces CombinedScanTasks.

nodes.name: planTasks
nodes.summary: Plans files, splits them to the target split size, and bin-packs the splits into CombinedScanTasks using TableScanUtil.

nodes.name: PartitionData
nodes.summary: Partition tuple record implementing Avro IndexedRecord and StructLike; stores values in an Object[] and supports copy, copyFor, equals/hashCode and type conversion of internal values.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Returns the value at a position, returning null when out of range and wrapping byte[] values in a defensive ByteBuffer copy.

nodes.name: copyData
nodes.summary: Deep-copies partition values from an array according to the partition type, converting each primitive to its internal representation.

nodes.name: toInternalValue
nodes.summary: Converts a partition value to the internal representation expected by the field's primitive type.

nodes.name: toString
nodes.summary: Renders the partition as a brace-delimited list of field name and value pairs, printing binary values as hex.

nodes.name: ReachableFileUtil
nodes.summary: Utility class of static methods that list the metadata, manifest list and statistics files reachable from a table.

nodes.name: versionHintLocation
nodes.summary: Builds the path of the version-hint file under the table's metadata folder (Hadoop table layout).

nodes.name: metadataFileLocations
nodes.summary: Returns current and previous JSON metadata file locations, optionally following the metadata log recursively.

nodes.name: findFirstExistentPreviousMetadata
nodes.summary: Returns the first previous TableMetadata that can be read, logging errors for unreadable entries.

nodes.name: manifestListLocations
nodes.summary: Returns manifest list locations for the table's snapshots, optionally limited to a set of snapshot ids.

nodes.name: statisticsFilesLocationsForSnapshots
nodes.summary: Returns statistics and partition statistics file paths, filtered by snapshot ids when provided.

nodes.name: Try
nodes.summary: Holds a value or a Throwable from running a SerializableSupplier; getOrThrow rethrows the original exception unchanged.

nodes.name: of
nodes.summary: Runs the supplier and wraps its result or any thrown Throwable in a Try.

nodes.name: getOrThrow
nodes.summary: Returns the stored value or sneakily rethrows the captured throwable.

nodes.name: FileRewritePlan
nodes.summary: Plan output with groups, per-partition group counts and total group count for use by engines.

nodes.name: FileRewritePlanner
nodes.summary: Planner contract: description, validOptions, init(options) and plan() returning a FileRewritePlan.

nodes.name: FileRewriteRunner
nodes.summary: Runner contract: description, validOptions, init(options) and rewrite(group) returning newly written files.

nodes.name: RewriteGroupBase
nodes.summary: Base group of scan tasks to rewrite; derives input size from task lengths and carries output sizing hints.

nodes.name: SizeBasedFileRewritePlanner
nodes.summary: Abstract planner with abstract hooks defaultTargetFileSize, filterFiles and filterFileGroups, and helpers for size thresholds, group-level checks and output file count estimation.

nodes.name: validOptions
nodes.summary: Returns the set of option keys accepted by this planner (target/min/max size, min input files, rewrite-all, max group size and count).

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Parses options into target, min and max file sizes, min input files, rewrite-all, group limits and output spec id.

nodes.name: planFileGroups
nodes.summary: Filters tasks (unless rewrite-all), bin-packs them by length with ListPacker into groups and filters groups.

nodes.name: inputSplitSize
nodes.summary: Computes the input split size as input size over expected output files plus overhead, clamped between target and write max file size.

nodes.name: expectedOutputFiles
nodes.summary: Decides whether to round the number of output files up or down depending on the remainder size and average file size.

nodes.name: writeMaxFileSize
nodes.summary: Returns target size plus half the distance to the max file size to avoid tiny remainder files.

nodes.name: sizeThresholds
nodes.summary: Reads and validates target, min and max file sizes from options using default ratios of the target.

nodes.name: InputFilesDecryptor.java
nodes.summary: Decrypts every data and delete file referenced by a CombinedScanTask in one batched EncryptionManager call and serves decrypted InputFile instances by task or location.

nodes.name: HadoopConfigurable.java
nodes.summary: Interface extending Hadoop Configurable so objects such as FileIO can swap their non-serializable Configuration for a serializable supplier before being serialized.

nodes.name: SerializableConfiguration.java
nodes.summary: Serializable wrapper that copies a Hadoop Configuration into a Map and lazily rebuilds it on demand, implementing SerializableSupplier of Configuration.

nodes.name: Util.java
nodes.summary: Hadoop-specific helpers: FileSystem lookup, HDFS block location (data locality) discovery for scan task groups, and the version hint filename constant.

nodes.name: EagerInputFile.java
nodes.summary: InputFile decorator that reads the whole file in a single request on first newStream to reduce object-store round trips, with a Hadoop-configurable variant.
nodes.languageNotes: Nested EagerInputFileConfigurable is selected by a static factory when the delegate is HadoopConfigurable, and refuses Java serialization.

nodes.name: ResolvingFileIO.java
nodes.summary: FileIO that routes each operation to a delegate FileIO chosen by the location scheme (S3, GCS, ADLS, else Hadoop), lazily loading delegates and batching bulk deletes.
nodes.languageNotes: Caches delegates in a ConcurrentMap, re-applies Hadoop conf and storage credentials after Kryo deserialization, and warns from finalize() if close was not called.

nodes.name: BinPacking.java
nodes.summary: Bin-packing utilities: ListPacker and a lazy PackingIterable that group weighted items into bins up to a target weight with lookback, optional largest-bin-first and max items per bin.

nodes.name: SerializableSupplier.java
nodes.summary: Single-method marker interface combining java.util.function.Supplier with Serializable, used to ship lazy values such as Hadoop configuration across processes.

nodes.name: SerializationUtil.java
nodes.summary: Java-serialization helpers to convert objects to and from bytes or Base64, giving HadoopConfigurable objects a chance to swap in a serializable configuration first.

nodes.name: TableScanUtil.java
nodes.summary: Core scan planning utilities that split file tasks, bin-pack them into combined tasks or task groups (optionally by partition grouping key), merge adjacent tasks and adjust split size for parallelism.

nodes.name: InputFilesDecryptor
nodes.summary: Builds a location-to-InputFile map for all data and delete files of a combined task by decrypting them with one batch call.

nodes.name: InputFilesDecryptor
nodes.summary: Constructor collecting key metadata for each file location, wrapping inputs as EncryptedInputFile and bulk-decrypting through the EncryptionManager.

nodes.name: getInputFile
nodes.summary: Returns the decrypted InputFile for a FileScanTask, rejecting data tasks.

nodes.name: HadoopConfigurable
nodes.summary: Interface adding serializeConfWith to Hadoop Configurable, with default setConf/getConf that throw UnsupportedOperationException.

nodes.name: SerializableConfiguration
nodes.summary: Serializable holder of Hadoop configuration entries that recreates a non-defaults Configuration lazily in get().

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Lazily builds a Configuration from the stored map using double-checked locking.

nodes.name: Util
nodes.summary: Static Hadoop helpers for FileSystem access and block-location based locality hints.

nodes.name: blockLocations
nodes.summary: Collects the HDFS hosts holding blocks for all file tasks in a group; overloads support a Hadoop Configuration or a FileIO.

nodes.name: mayHaveBlockLocations
nodes.summary: Returns true only when the FileIO resolves to Hadoop and the file system scheme is HDFS.

nodes.name: usesHadoopFileIO
nodes.summary: Checks whether a FileIO, or the one a ResolvingFileIO picks for a location, is a HadoopFileIO.

nodes.name: EagerInputFile
nodes.summary: InputFile decorator that exposes a pre-supplied length and reads the full file with a single stream request.

nodes.name: of
nodes.summary: Factory that returns a Hadoop-configurable eager file when the delegate implements HadoopConfigurable.

nodes.name: newStream
nodes.summary: Reads the whole delegate stream into a byte array, verifies the declared length, and returns an in-memory stream.

nodes.name: EagerInputFileConfigurable
nodes.summary: EagerInputFile subclass that also implements HadoopConfigurable by forwarding configuration calls to the delegate.

nodes.name: ResolvingFileIO
nodes.summary: FileIO that dispatches to scheme-specific DelegateFileIO instances and supports Hadoop conf and storage credentials.

nodes.name: deleteFiles
nodes.summary: Deletes paths in 100,000-sized batches, grouping each batch by the delegate FileIO that owns the path.

nodes.name: initialize
nodes.summary: Stores properties and rebuilds the Hadoop configuration supplier after closing existing delegates.

nodes.name: close
nodes.summary: Closes all cached delegate FileIO instances once and clears the cache.

nodes.name: io
nodes.summary: Returns the cached delegate for a location or loads it via CatalogUtil.loadFileIO with fallback to HadoopFileIO, re-applying conf and credentials.

nodes.name: ioClass
nodes.summary: Resolves the delegate FileIO class for a location, used for locality checks.

nodes.name: finalize
nodes.summary: Logs a warning with the creation stack trace if the instance was garbage collected without being closed.

nodes.name: BinPacking
nodes.summary: Holder for bin-packing helpers: ListPacker for eager packing and PackingIterable for lazy streaming packing.

nodes.name: ListPacker
nodes.summary: Packs items into lists of bins eagerly, with pack and packEnd (packing from the end).

nodes.name: PackingIterable
nodes.summary: Iterable that lazily packs items into bins by weight, honoring lookback, largest-bin-first and max items per bin.

nodes.name: PackingIterator
nodes.summary: Iterator performing the bin-filling algorithm, keeping up to lookback open bins and emitting the best one.

nodes.name: Bin
nodes.summary: Mutable accumulator of items and total weight for one bin.

nodes.name: SerializableSupplier
nodes.summary: Supplier that is also Serializable.

nodes.name: SerializationUtil
nodes.summary: Static helpers for Java object serialization to bytes and Base64.

nodes.name: serializeToBytes
nodes.summary: Serializes an object with ObjectOutputStream, first calling serializeConfWith if it is HadoopConfigurable.

nodes.name: deserializeFromBytes
nodes.summary: Deserializes an object from bytes with ObjectInputStream, mapping failures to unchecked exceptions and returning null for null input.

nodes.name: TableScanUtil
nodes.summary: Static utilities for splitting, merging and bin-packing scan tasks into combined tasks and task groups.

nodes.name: splitFiles
nodes.summary: Splits each FileScanTask to the given split size and combines the result with the source iterable so it closes together.

nodes.name: planTasks
nodes.summary: Bin-packs split file tasks into BaseCombinedScanTasks, weighting by file length plus delete size and open cost.

nodes.name: planTaskGroups
nodes.summary: Splits splittable tasks and bin-packs them into BaseScanTaskGroups by size or file-count cost; overloads cover lists and partition grouping keys.

nodes.name: toTaskGroupIterable
nodes.summary: Bin-packs tasks sharing a grouping key into task groups carrying that key.

nodes.name: mergeTasks
nodes.summary: Walks the list and merges each MergeableScanTask with its successor when canMerge returns true.

nodes.name: adjustSplitSize
nodes.summary: Lowers the split size so a scan yields at least one split per parallelism slot, with a 16 MB floor.

nodes.name: DataTask.java
nodes.summary: Public interface for a FileScanTask whose rows are held in memory rather than read from a data file, exposing them via rows() as a CloseableIterable of StructLike.
nodes.languageNotes: Java interface using default methods to override isDataTask() and asDataTask() from FileScanTask.

nodes.name: DeleteFiles.java
nodes.summary: API for deleting files from a table in a single snapshot update, by exact path, by DataFile, or by an expression evaluated against partition data. Row-filter deletes only drop whole files whose partitions match.
nodes.languageNotes: Fluent interface returning itself; validateFilesExist() defaults to throwing UnsupportedOperationException.

nodes.name: HistoryEntry.java
nodes.summary: Serializable interface describing one table history entry as a pair of timestamp in milliseconds and the snapshot id that became current at that time.

nodes.name: OverwriteFiles.java
nodes.summary: API for overwriting files in a table: add new data files, delete files or rows matching a filter, and optionally validate for conflicting concurrent changes. Includes conflict detection options such as validateNoConflictingData and conflictDetectionFilter.
nodes.languageNotes: Extends the generic SnapshotUpdate<T> interface with a self-referential type parameter to enable fluent chaining.

nodes.name: PartitionStatisticsScan.java
nodes.summary: Scan API for reading partition statistics of a table snapshot, with snapshot selection, expression filtering, case sensitivity and schema projection, returning a CloseableIterable of PartitionStatistics.

nodes.name: RowDelta.java
nodes.summary: API for row-level changes in one atomic commit: adds data files and delete files (and optionally removes them), with validation hooks for conflicting data files, delete files and referenced files.
nodes.languageNotes: Default methods removeRows and removeDeletes throw UnsupportedOperationException so older implementations remain source compatible.

nodes.name: ConvertEqualityDeleteFiles.java
nodes.summary: Action interface for converting equality delete files into position delete files, optionally restricted by a filter expression, with a Result reporting converted and added file counts.

nodes.name: IncrementalScanEvent.java
nodes.summary: Immutable event object describing an incremental table scan: table name, from and to snapshot ids, filter expression, projection schema and whether the from snapshot is inclusive.

nodes.name: Listeners.java
nodes.summary: Static registry of event listeners keyed by event class, backed by a concurrent map of queues. register() adds a listener and notifyAll() dispatches an event to all listeners registered for its exact class.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses an unchecked cast from Listener<?> to Listener<E>, safe because listeners are stored per event class.

nodes.name: ScanEvent.java
nodes.summary: Immutable event object describing a table scan: table name, snapshot id, filter expression and projection schema, published to registered Listeners when a scan is planned.

nodes.name: CherrypickAncestorCommitException.java
nodes.summary: Validation exception raised when a cherry-pick targets a snapshot that is already an ancestor of the current table state or was already picked into an ancestor.

nodes.name: ValidationException.java
nodes.summary: Runtime exception thrown when an operation fails a validation check (for example conflicting concurrent changes). Provides a check(test, message, args) helper and is marked CleanableFailure so uncommitted files can be cleaned up.
nodes.languageNotes: Constructors are annotated with @FormatMethod so Error Prone checks the format string and argument list.

nodes.name: Binder.java
nodes.summary: Binds unbound expressions to a schema struct, resolving named references to field ids and types, and provides helpers to collect bound field ids and test whether an expression is bound. Implemented with ExpressionVisitor subclasses.
nodes.languageNotes: Private static nested visitors (BindVisitor, ReferenceVisitor, IsBoundVisitor) extend ExpressionVisitor<R> with different result types.

nodes.name: Evaluator.java
nodes.summary: Evaluates a row-level expression against a StructLike row, binding the expression to a struct type first and then walking it with a BoundVisitor that applies comparisons, null, NaN and IN checks to each value.
nodes.languageNotes: Inner EvalVisitor extends BoundVisitor<Boolean> and uses literal comparators for ordering.

nodes.name: DataTask
nodes.summary: Interface for in-memory file scan tasks that return rows directly.

nodes.name: DeleteFiles
nodes.summary: Snapshot update interface for deleting files by path, DataFile or row filter.

nodes.name: HistoryEntry
nodes.summary: Pair of timestamp and snapshot id describing a table history entry.

nodes.name: OverwriteFiles
nodes.summary: Snapshot update interface for overwrite operations with conflict validation.

nodes.name: PartitionStatisticsScan
nodes.summary: Scan interface over partition statistics for a snapshot.

nodes.name: RowDelta
nodes.summary: Snapshot update interface for row-level inserts and deletes in one commit.

nodes.name: ConvertEqualityDeleteFiles
nodes.summary: Action converting equality delete files into position delete files.

nodes.name: IncrementalScanEvent
nodes.summary: Immutable event for an incremental scan between two snapshots.

nodes.name: Listeners
nodes.summary: Static listener registry and event dispatcher.

nodes.name: ScanEvent
nodes.summary: Immutable event for a table scan on a snapshot.

nodes.name: CherrypickAncestorCommitException
nodes.summary: ValidationException subtype for cherry-picking an already-ancestor snapshot.

nodes.name: ValidationException
nodes.summary: Cleanable runtime exception for failed validations, with a check() helper.

nodes.name: Binder
nodes.summary: Utility that binds expressions to schemas and inspects bound references.

nodes.name: BindVisitor
nodes.summary: Visitor that rebuilds an expression tree with every predicate bound to the struct.

nodes.name: ReferenceVisitor
nodes.summary: Visitor collecting the field ids of all bound references.

nodes.name: IsBoundVisitor
nodes.summary: Visitor checking that an expression is fully bound (or fully unbound).

nodes.name: Evaluator
nodes.summary: Row-level expression evaluator over StructLike data.

nodes.name: EvalVisitor
nodes.summary: BoundVisitor that returns true or false for each predicate on a row.

nodes.name: Result
nodes.summary: Result of converting equality deletes: converted and added file counts.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers a listener for an event class in the concurrent listener map.

nodes.name: notifyAll
nodes.summary: Dispatches an event to every listener registered for its runtime class.

nodes.name: boundReferences
nodes.summary: Returns the set of field ids referenced by a bound expression via ReferenceVisitor.

nodes.name: Expression.java
nodes.summary: Core expression interface for Iceberg filter predicates, carrying an Operation enum (TRUE, FALSE, comparisons, IN, AND, OR, NOT, aggregates) with fromString, negate and flipLR helpers plus op() and negate() on expressions.
nodes.languageNotes: Nested enum with behavior (switch-based negate and flipLR) used throughout predicate rewriting.

nodes.name: ExpressionVisitors.java
nodes.summary: Visitor infrastructure for expression trees: abstract ExpressionVisitor, BoundExpressionVisitor, BoundVisitor and CustomOrderExpressionVisitor, plus static visit, visitEvaluator and visitExpr drivers that dispatch on the expression operation.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of generic abstract static nested classes, with the visitor result type R threaded through all callbacks.

nodes.name: Expressions.java
nodes.summary: Static factory for building expressions: and, or, not, comparison and null/NaN predicates, in/notIn, startsWith, aggregates, references and transform references such as bucket, year, month, day, hour and truncate.
nodes.languageNotes: Fluent static-factory DSL with many overloads; relies on Transforms for transform terms.

nodes.name: InclusiveMetricsEvaluator.java
nodes.summary: Evaluates an expression against data file metrics (counts, bounds, NaN counts, variant bounds) to decide whether the file may contain matching rows, so files that cannot match can be skipped during planning.
nodes.languageNotes: Returns true unless the file is provably free of matches (inclusive semantics); NOT is rewritten away before binding.

nodes.name: Literals.java
nodes.summary: Package-private factory and implementations of Literal values, with typed literal classes (boolean, integer, long, float, double, date, time, timestamp, decimal, string, UUID, fixed, binary, variant) and conversion rules between types including AboveMax and BelowMin sentinels.
nodes.languageNotes: A large hierarchy of package-private static classes extending BaseLiteral and ComparableLiteral, with to(Type) conversions implementing Iceberg literal promotion rules.

nodes.name: ManifestEvaluator.java
nodes.summary: Evaluates an expression against the partition field summaries of a manifest file to decide whether the manifest may contain matching data files, enabling manifest pruning in scan planning. Offers forRowFilter and forPartitionFilter factories.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses inclusive partition projection for row filters and caps IN-predicate evaluation at 200 values.

nodes.name: Projections.java
nodes.summary: Projects row-filter expressions onto partition data using partition transforms, producing inclusive projections (may match) and strict projections (must match) through ProjectionEvaluator visitors.
nodes.languageNotes: Inclusive and strict projections are subclasses of a shared BaseProjectionEvaluator and differ in how transforms project predicates.

nodes.name: ResidualEvaluator.java
nodes.summary: Computes the residual expression left over after partition values already satisfy part of a filter, so readers only evaluate the unresolved portion. Includes a no-op unpartitioned variant.

nodes.name: StrictMetricsEvaluator.java
nodes.summary: Evaluates an expression against data file metrics with strict semantics to decide whether all rows in a file must match, used for safe whole-file deletes and similar optimizations.
nodes.languageNotes: Strict counterpart to InclusiveMetricsEvaluator: returns true only when every row is guaranteed to match.

nodes.name: CloseableGroup.java
nodes.summary: Base class that collects Closeable and AutoCloseable resources and closes them all in order on close(), optionally suppressing and logging close failures instead of rethrowing.

nodes.name: CloseableIterable.java
nodes.summary: Iterable that is also Closeable, with static helpers to wrap, combine, filter (with optional skip counters), count, transform, concat and run a callback on completion. Includes ConcatCloseableIterable for chained iteration.
nodes.languageNotes: Interface with many static factory methods and anonymous implementations, a common Iceberg idiom for lazy, closeable pipelines.

nodes.name: CloseableIterator.java
nodes.summary: Iterator that is also Closeable, with static helpers to wrap a plain iterator, create an empty one, transform elements and count elements into a metrics Counter.

nodes.name: FileIOMetricsContext.java
nodes.summary: Extends MetricsContext with string constants naming FileIO read and write byte and operation counters.

nodes.name: Counter.java
nodes.summary: Metrics counter interface with increment overloads, value(), a unit defaulting to COUNT and an isNoop() check against DefaultCounter.NOOP.

nodes.name: Expression
nodes.summary: Base expression interface with an Operation enum.

nodes.name: Operation
nodes.summary: Enum of expression operations with fromString, negate and flipLR helpers.

nodes.name: ExpressionVisitors
nodes.summary: Holder of expression visitor base classes and visit drivers.

nodes.name: ExpressionVisitor
nodes.summary: Generic base visitor with callbacks for each expression kind.

nodes.name: BoundExpressionVisitor
nodes.summary: Visitor base for bound expressions with per-operation predicate callbacks.

nodes.name: BoundVisitor
nodes.summary: Visitor base that dispatches bound predicates to typed callbacks, including literal and set predicates.

nodes.name: CustomOrderExpressionVisitor
nodes.summary: Visitor base where the implementation controls child evaluation order via suppliers.

nodes.name: Expressions
nodes.summary: Static factory DSL for building expressions and predicates.

nodes.name: InclusiveMetricsEvaluator
nodes.summary: Evaluates whether a data file may contain rows matching a filter, using file metrics.

nodes.name: MetricsEvalVisitor
nodes.summary: Visitor applying inclusive metrics rules (counts and bounds) per predicate.

nodes.name: Literals
nodes.summary: Factory and conversion rules for typed literals.

nodes.name: BaseLiteral
nodes.summary: Abstract base holding the literal value with equality and string behavior.

nodes.name: ComparableLiteral
nodes.summary: Base literal for Comparable values providing a natural-order comparator.

nodes.name: StringLiteral
nodes.summary: String literal converting to dates, times, timestamps, UUIDs, decimals and other types.

nodes.name: DecimalLiteral
nodes.summary: Decimal literal that converts to decimals with matching scale.

nodes.name: ManifestEvaluator
nodes.summary: Evaluates expressions against manifest partition summaries for pruning.

nodes.name: ManifestEvalVisitor
nodes.summary: Visitor applying partition field summary rules (nulls, NaN, bounds) to each predicate.

nodes.name: Projections
nodes.summary: Factory for inclusive and strict partition projections.

nodes.name: ProjectionEvaluator
nodes.summary: Public abstract visitor projecting row expressions onto partition expressions.

nodes.name: BaseProjectionEvaluator
nodes.summary: Shared projection logic mapping predicates to partition fields via transforms.

nodes.name: InclusiveProjection
nodes.summary: Projection that yields partition predicates satisfied by any matching row.

nodes.name: StrictProjection
nodes.summary: Projection that yields partition predicates implying every row matches.

nodes.name: ResidualEvaluator
nodes.summary: Computes the residual filter remaining after partition values are applied.

nodes.name: ResidualVisitor
nodes.summary: Visitor that resolves predicates against partition data and keeps unresolved ones.

nodes.name: StrictMetricsEvaluator
nodes.summary: Evaluates whether all rows of a data file must match a filter, using file metrics.

nodes.name: MetricsEvalVisitor
nodes.summary: Visitor applying strict metrics rules (counts and bounds) per predicate.

nodes.name: CloseableGroup
nodes.summary: Collects closeable resources and closes them together.

nodes.name: CloseableIterable
nodes.summary: Closeable Iterable with static composition helpers.

nodes.name: ConcatCloseableIterable
nodes.summary: Iterable that lazily concatenates several closeable iterables and closes each as it finishes.

nodes.name: CloseableIterator
nodes.summary: Closeable Iterator with static wrapping, transform and count helpers.

nodes.name: FileIOMetricsContext
nodes.summary: MetricsContext with FileIO read and write counter names.

nodes.name: Counter
nodes.summary: Counter metric interface with increment, value and unit.

nodes.name: visit
nodes.summary: Walks an expression tree dispatching to a visitor based on each node's operation.

nodes.name: visitEvaluator
nodes.summary: Drives a BoundExpressionVisitor over a tree, evaluating AND, OR and NOT with short-circuiting.

nodes.name: visitExpr
nodes.summary: Drives a CustomOrderExpressionVisitor, passing suppliers so the visitor controls evaluation order.

nodes.name: from
nodes.summary: Creates a typed Literal from a Java value by runtime class (Integer, Long, String, UUID, BigDecimal, ByteBuffer, Variant and others).

nodes.name: close
nodes.summary: Closes all registered resources in order, rethrowing as IOException or logging when failures are suppressed.

nodes.name: IcebergBuild.java
nodes.summary: Static holder for build metadata (git commit id, branch, tags, version) loaded lazily from the bundled iceberg-build.properties resource.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses double-checked lazy loading guarded by a volatile flag; every accessor calls ensureLoaded() so missing resources degrade to "unknown" values.

nodes.name: IcebergBuild
nodes.summary: Static utility class exposing build metadata (commit ids, branch, tags, version) with lazy resource loading.

nodes.name: loadBuildInfo
nodes.summary: Reads iceberg-build.properties and populates commit id, branch, tags, and version fields, falling back to "unknown" on failure.

nodes.name: ensureLoaded
nodes.summary: Double-checked locking guard that triggers loadBuildInfo exactly once.

nodes.name: fullVersion
nodes.summary: Returns the full version string (version plus commit information) of this Iceberg build.

nodes.name: gitCommitShortId
nodes.summary: Returns the abbreviated git commit hash of the build.

nodes.name: BadRequestException.java
nodes.summary: REST exception for HTTP 400 responses (malformed requests); marked as a CleanableFailure so commit cleanup can proceed.

nodes.name: BadRequestException
nodes.summary: REST exception for HTTP 400 responses (malformed requests); marked as a CleanableFailure so commit cleanup can proceed.

nodes.name: ForbiddenException.java
nodes.summary: REST exception for HTTP 403 responses when the caller is authenticated but not permitted to perform the operation.

nodes.name: ForbiddenException
nodes.summary: REST exception for HTTP 403 responses when the caller is authenticated but not permitted to perform the operation.

nodes.name: NoSuchPlanIdException.java

nodes.summary: Incremental append scan that plans files added by APPEND snapshots between two snapshots using a ManifestGroup restricted to ADDED entries of those snapshots.

nodes.name: BaseIncrementalScan
nodes.summary: Abstract BaseScan implementing IncrementalScan bounds handling with immutable refinement via TableScanContext.

nodes.name: useBranch
nodes.summary: Selects a branch ref after verifying it exists and is a branch, returning a refined scan.

nodes.name: planFiles
nodes.summary: Resolves the end and exclusive start snapshots, notifies listeners with an IncrementalScanEvent and calls doPlanFiles.

nodes.name: toSnapshotIdInclusive
nodes.summary: Determines the end snapshot id from the explicit setting, branch head or current snapshot, validating branch ancestry.

nodes.name: fromSnapshotIdExclusive
nodes.summary: Converts the configured start snapshot into an exclusive id, validating ancestry and using the parent id for inclusive starts.

nodes.name: BaseIncrementalAppendScan
nodes.summary: BaseIncrementalScan specialization producing FileScanTasks for files added by append snapshots.

nodes.name: planTasks
nodes.summary: Splits planned file tasks by target size and bin-packs them into CombinedScanTasks.

nodes.name: appendFilesFromSnapshots
nodes.summary: Collects data manifests created by the given append snapshots and plans ADDED entries via a configured ManifestGroup.

nodes.name: appendsBetween
nodes.summary: Walks snapshot ancestors between two ids and keeps those whose operation is APPEND.

nodes.name: BaseOverwriteFiles.java
nodes.summary: Snapshot producer for OverwriteFiles operations: adds and deletes data or delete files, optionally validates added files against the overwrite filter, and checks conflicting concurrent data or deletes.

nodes.name: BasePartitionStatisticsScan.java
nodes.summary: PartitionStatisticsScan implementation that locates the statistics file for a snapshot, reads it via InternalData with a projected schema and filters rows by an expression.

nodes.name: BaseOverwriteFiles
nodes.summary: MergingSnapshotProducer implementing OverwriteFiles with row-filter deletes, explicit file adds/deletes and optional validations.

nodes.name: operation
nodes.summary: Infers the snapshot operation as DELETE, APPEND or OVERWRITE from whether data files are added or deleted.

nodes.name: deleteFiles
nodes.summary: Deletes the given data and delete files, tracking deleted data files for later conflict validation.

nodes.name: validate
nodes.summary: Validates added files match the overwrite filter via inclusive, strict or metrics evaluators and checks for conflicting concurrent data files and deletes.

nodes.name: dataConflictDetectionFilter
nodes.summary: Chooses the filter for conflicting data detection: explicit filter, the row filter when no files were deleted, otherwise alwaysTrue.

nodes.name: BasePartitionStatisticsScan
nodes.summary: Fluent scan implementation holding table, snapshot, projection, filter and case-sensitivity state to read partition statistics.

nodes.name: useSnapshot
nodes.summary: Sets the snapshot to scan after verifying it exists.

nodes.name: scan
nodes.summary: Finds the snapshot's partition statistics file, reads it in the right format with the projected schema and applies the filter evaluator.

nodes.name: readSchema
nodes.summary: Computes the schema to read, adding filter-referenced columns to the projected field ids.

nodes.name: BasePositionDeletesScanTask.java
nodes.summary: Concrete scan task for a single position delete file, adding self-typed splitting on top of BaseContentScanTask so that large delete files can be split into SplitPositionDeletesScanTask ranges.

nodes.name: BasePositionDeletesScanTask
nodes.summary: Package-private PositionDeletesScanTask over a DeleteFile that carries schema, spec and residual evaluator and creates SplitPositionDeletesScanTask instances when split by offset and length.

nodes.name: BaseReplacePartitions.java
nodes.summary: Implements the ReplacePartitions (dynamic overwrite) operation: every partition touched by an added file has its existing data dropped, with optional validation of concurrent data and delete conflicts.

nodes.name: BaseReplacePartitions
nodes.summary: Snapshot producer that replaces whole partitions: tracks replaced partitions in a PartitionSet, marks the snapshot summary as a replace-partitions overwrite and converts delete conflicts into ValidationException.

nodes.name: addFile
nodes.summary: Registers the file partition as replaced by dropping that partition from existing manifests and then adding the new file.

nodes.name: validate
nodes.summary: Optionally checks that no conflicting data files or delete files were added to the replaced partitions since the starting snapshot, falling back to a table-wide filter for unpartitioned tables.

nodes.name: apply
nodes.summary: Deletes all rows by filter when the table is unpartitioned, then delegates to the parent apply and rewraps partition delete failures as ValidationException.

nodes.name: BaseRewriteFiles.java
nodes.summary: Implements RewriteFiles, which atomically replaces a set of data and delete files with new ones (compaction style), validating that replaced files are non-empty and that no new deletes appeared for the replaced data files.

nodes.name: BaseRewriteFiles
nodes.summary: Snapshot producer for file rewrites that tracks replaced data files and a starting snapshot for conflict validation.

nodes.name: rewriteFiles
nodes.summary: Four-set rewrite entry point that deletes every replaced data and delete file and adds every new data and delete file after null checks.

nodes.name: validate
nodes.summary: Validates replaced and added file sets and, when data files are replaced, rejects commits where new row-level deletes now apply to them.

nodes.name: validateReplacedAndAddedFiles
nodes.summary: Argument checks ensuring something is deleted and that added data or delete files only exist when matching files are being replaced.

nodes.name: BaseRowDelta.java
nodes.summary: Implements RowDelta, a snapshot operation that adds data files and row-level delete files (position deletes, DVs, equality deletes) in one commit with configurable conflict validation.

nodes.name: BaseRowDelta
nodes.summary: Snapshot producer for row-level changes that tracks referenced and removed data files, a conflict detection filter and flags selecting which concurrent changes must be rejected.

nodes.name: validate
nodes.summary: Runs the enabled conflict checks against the starting snapshot: referenced data files still exist, no conflicting data files, no new delete files, no conflicting file and position deletes, and no conflicting DVs.

nodes.name: validateNoConflictingFileAndPositionDeletes
nodes.summary: Fails when a data file removed in this commit is also referenced by newly added delete files.

nodes.name: BaseScan.java
nodes.summary: Abstract immutable base for table scans: each configuration method returns a refined scan built from an updated TableScanContext, and it resolves split size, lookback, column projection and metrics settings.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the self-typed generic ThisT so every fluent method returns the concrete scan subtype via newRefinedScan.

nodes.name: BaseScan
nodes.summary: Abstract Scan implementation holding the table, schema and TableScanContext; defines the metadata column lists used when planning file scans and the fluent refinement API.

nodes.name: includeColumnStats
nodes.summary: Enables returning column stats for the requested columns by mapping column names to field ids in the scan context.

nodes.name: targetSplitSize
nodes.summary: Reads the split size from scan options, falling back to the table property and its default.

nodes.name: lazyColumnProjection
nodes.summary: Computes the schema to project: selected columns plus every column referenced by the row filter, else the context projected schema or the full schema.

nodes.name: scanColumns
nodes.summary: Returns the static scan column list for data or delete manifests and rejects unknown manifest content.

nodes.name: BaseSnapshot.java
nodes.summary: Default Snapshot implementation that stores snapshot metadata and lazily loads manifests and file-level added or removed changes from the manifest list using a supplied FileIO.

nodes.name: BaseSnapshot
nodes.summary: Immutable snapshot record (id, parent, sequence number, summary, row lineage fields) with transient caches for manifests and per-snapshot data and delete file changes.

nodes.name: cacheManifests
nodes.summary: Loads all manifests from legacy v1 manifest locations or the manifest list file and splits them into data and delete manifest lists.

nodes.name: cacheDeleteFileChanges
nodes.summary: Reads delete manifests written by this snapshot and collects ADDED and DELETED delete file entries.

nodes.name: cacheDataFileChanges
nodes.summary: Reads data manifests written by this snapshot and collects ADDED and DELETED data file entries.

nodes.name: CherryPickOperation.java
nodes.summary: Package-private operation that cherry-picks an append or dynamic overwrite snapshot onto the current branch, or fast-forwards to it, validating ancestry, WAP ids and replaced partitions.

nodes.name: CherryPickOperation
nodes.summary: Snapshot producer used by ManageSnapshots that re-applies the file changes of a picked snapshot and links it through the source-snapshot-id summary property.

nodes.name: cherrypick
nodes.summary: Loads the target snapshot, then for appends or replace-partitions overwrites copies its added and removed files and records published WAP and source snapshot ids; otherwise rejects the pick.

nodes.name: validate
nodes.summary: When not a fast-forward, rejects ancestors, validates replaced partitions and publishes the WAP id.

nodes.name: apply
nodes.summary: Returns the picked snapshot directly for fast-forwards, enforcing the fast-forward requirement, otherwise defers to the parent apply.

nodes.name: validateNonAncestor
nodes.summary: Throws CherrypickAncestorCommitException if the snapshot is already an ancestor or was already cherry-picked.

nodes.name: validateReplacedPartitions
nodes.summary: Scans snapshots since the picked parent in parallel and fails if new files landed in a replaced partition.

nodes.name: ContentStats.java
nodes.summary: Public interface for a container of per-field FieldStats within a content file, with lookup by field id, struct type, and full or filtered deep copies.

nodes.name: ContentStats
nodes.summary: Contract exposing field-level stats, the struct type describing them and copy operations (all or selected field ids).

nodes.name: DataFilesTable.java

nodes.name: DataFilesTable
nodes.summary: Metadata table named data_files that creates DataFilesTableScan and reports MetadataTableType.DATA_FILES.

nodes.name: DataFilesTable.DataFilesTableScan
nodes.summary: Scan that restricts the planned manifests to data manifests of the snapshot.

nodes.name: DeleteFileIndex.java

nodes.name: DeleteFileIndex
nodes.summary: Holds global and per-partition equality deletes, per-partition and per-path position deletes and DVs, and answers forDataFile lookups with sequence number and partition validation.

nodes.name: DeleteFileIndex.Builder
nodes.summary: Builder that loads delete manifests (in parallel) or takes delete files directly, applies filters and a minimum sequence number, and builds the index.

nodes.name: DeleteFileIndex.PositionDeletes
nodes.summary: Group of position delete files lazily sorted by data sequence number and filtered by binary search.

nodes.name: DeleteFileIndex.EqualityDeletes

nodes.name: DeleteFileIndex.EqualityDeleteFile
nodes.summary: Wrapper around an equality delete file that caches converted lower and upper bounds for faster overlap checks.

nodes.name: forEntry
nodes.summary: Looks up the delete files for a manifest entry using its data sequence number and data file.

nodes.name: builderFor

nodes.name: referencedDeleteFiles

nodes.name: forDataFile

nodes.name: findPathDeletes
nodes.summary: Looks up position deletes keyed by the data file location and validates that partitions match.

nodes.name: findDV
nodes.summary: Looks up the deletion vector for a data file and checks its sequence number and partition match.

nodes.name: validatePartitionMatch
nodes.summary: Throws ValidationException if the delete file and data file have different spec ids or partition tuples, signalling corrupt metadata.

nodes.name: canContainEqDeletesForFile
nodes.summary: Uses column bounds, null counts and value counts to decide whether an equality delete could match rows in a data file.

nodes.name: Builder.build
nodes.summary: Indexes the loaded delete files into global, partition, path and DV groups and records scan metrics for each indexed file.

nodes.name: Builder.loadDeleteFiles
nodes.summary: Reads delete manifests in parallel and copies entries above the minimum sequence number with the minimal stats needed.

nodes.name: DeleteFilesTable.java
nodes.summary: Metadata table exposing a table delete files (delete manifests only) as rows.

nodes.name: DeleteFilesTable
nodes.summary: Metadata table named delete_files that creates DeleteFilesTableScan and reports MetadataTableType.DELETE_FILES.

nodes.name: DeleteFilesTable.DeleteFilesTableScan
nodes.summary: Scan that restricts the planned manifests to delete manifests of the snapshot.

nodes.name: FieldStats.java

nodes.name: FieldStats
nodes.summary: Generic per-field stats contract with lowerBound, upperBound, tightBounds, optional counts guarded by hasXxx methods, and copy.

nodes.name: FileScanTaskParser
nodes.summary: Static utility holding the JSON field names and toJson and fromJson conversions for file scan tasks.

nodes.name: toJson
nodes.summary: Writes a FileScanTask to a JsonGenerator including schema, spec, data file, start, length, delete files and residual expression.

nodes.name: fromJson
nodes.summary: Parses a JSON node into a SplitScanTask over a BaseFileScanTask, rebuilding the schema, spec, delete files and residual evaluator.

nodes.name: FilesTable.java
nodes.summary: Metadata table exposing all data and delete files of a table as rows, scanning every manifest of the snapshot.

nodes.name: FilesTable
nodes.summary: Metadata table named files that creates FilesTableScan and reports MetadataTableType.FILES.

nodes.name: FilesTable.FilesTableScan
nodes.summary: Scan over all manifests (data and delete) of the snapshot.

nodes.name: FindFiles.java
nodes.summary: Fluent public helper for finding data files in a table by snapshot, time, partition, row or file path filters, returning a CloseableIterable of DataFile.

nodes.name: FindFiles
nodes.summary: Static entry point whose in(table) returns a Builder.

nodes.name: FindFiles.Builder
nodes.summary: Builder collecting case sensitivity, snapshot, time and filter options and executing the file scan.

nodes.name: in
nodes.summary: Creates a Builder for the given table.

nodes.name: Builder.collect
nodes.summary: Plans a scan with the configured snapshot, filters, case sensitivity and executor and returns the matching data files.

nodes.name: HistoryTable.java

nodes.name: HistoryTable

nodes.name: HistoryTable.HistoryScan
nodes.summary: Static scan that overrides planFiles to skip the current snapshot check, since history spans all snapshots.

nodes.name: convertHistoryEntryFunc

nodes.name: IncrementalDataTableScan
nodes.summary: DataTableScan variant that rejects time travel refinements and carries from and to snapshot ids in the scan context.

nodes.summary: Selects manifests created by snapshots in the range, builds a ManifestGroup that keeps only ADDED entries from those snapshots, notifies listeners and plans file tasks.

nodes.name: validateSnapshotIdsRefinement
nodes.summary: Checks that a refined scan stays within or equals the existing incremental snapshot range.

nodes.name: IncrementalFileCleanup.java

nodes.name: IncrementalFileCleanup
nodes.summary: FileCleanupStrategy that incrementally computes deletions between table states by comparing expired snapshots with their neighbours.

nodes.name: cleanFiles
nodes.summary: Identifies expired snapshots, finds manifests and manifest lists to delete, then deletes data files, manifests, manifest lists and statistics files according to the cleanup level.

nodes.name: findFilesToDelete
nodes.summary: Reads manifests of expired snapshots to find files deleted by them that no longer belong to the table.

nodes.name: ManifestEntriesTable.java
nodes.summary: Metadata table exposing the raw manifest entries (status, snapshot id, data file) of the current snapshot manifests as rows.

nodes.name: ManifestEntriesTable
nodes.summary: Metadata table named entries that creates EntriesTableScan and reports MetadataTableType.ENTRIES.

nodes.name: ManifestEntriesTable.EntriesTableScan
nodes.summary: Scan that plans entry tasks over all manifests of the snapshot via BaseEntriesTable.planFiles.

nodes.name: ManifestFilterManager.java

nodes.name: ManifestFilterManager
nodes.summary: Collects delete criteria (files, paths, expression, partitions, minimum sequence number) and filters manifests in parallel, producing rewritten manifests and a snapshot summary.

nodes.name: ManifestFilterManager.DeleteException
nodes.summary: ValidationException raised when a delete would remove existing data in a partition that must not be deleted.

nodes.name: ManifestFilterManager.PartitionAndMetricsEvaluator
nodes.summary: Inner helper that evaluates a delete expression against file partition tuples and column metrics, with strict and inclusive checks.

nodes.name: filterManifests
nodes.summary: Filters all manifests in parallel preserving order, accumulates deleted files and validates that every required delete was found.

nodes.name: filterManifest
nodes.summary: Returns a cached or untouched manifest when nothing to delete, otherwise rewrites it without the deleted files and counts the replacement.

nodes.name: canContainDeletedFiles

nodes.name: validateRequiredDeletes

nodes.name: cleanUncommitted
nodes.summary: Deletes rewritten manifests that were not part of the committed manifest list.

nodes.name: ManifestGroup.java

nodes.name: ManifestGroup
nodes.summary: Configurable group of manifests (filters, projection, case sensitivity, metrics, executor) that exposes plan, planFiles, entries and fileGroups.

nodes.name: ManifestGroup.CreateTasksFunction
nodes.summary: Functional interface that creates scan tasks from manifest entries and a TaskContext.

nodes.name: ManifestGroup.TaskContext
nodes.summary: Per-spec bundle of partition spec, delete index, residual evaluator, stats-dropping flags and metrics used when creating tasks.

nodes.name: plan

nodes.name: entries
nodes.summary: Applies manifest, partition and file filters, opens manifest readers lazily and yields filtered entry iterables per manifest.

nodes.name: createFileScanTasks
nodes.summary: Converts manifest entries into BaseFileScanTask instances by copying each data file with the requested stats, looking up applicable delete files in the index and recording scan metrics.

nodes.name: planFiles
nodes.summary: Plans FileScanTasks via plan with createFileScanTasks.

nodes.name: ManifestReader.java
nodes.summary: Reads data or delete manifest files into ManifestEntry or ContentFile iterables with column projection, partition and row filter evaluation, live-entry filtering, inherited metadata and first-row-id assignment.

nodes.name: ManifestReader
nodes.summary: Closeable iterable of files from a manifest that lazily builds partition and metrics evaluators and exposes entries and liveEntries.

nodes.name: ManifestReader.FileType
nodes.summary: Enum selecting DATA_FILES or DELETE_FILES and the matching generic file class for deserialization.

nodes.name: readPartitionSpec
nodes.summary: Reads the Avro manifest header metadata (partition-spec-id, schema and partition-spec JSON) and rebuilds the PartitionSpec.

nodes.name: entries
nodes.summary: Returns manifest entries, filtering by partition, metrics and partition set when filters are present and projecting stats columns as required.

nodes.name: open
nodes.summary: Opens the manifest with a projection, handles the unpartitioned partition field, appends record count and row position, and wraps entries with inherited metadata and id assignment.

nodes.name: dropStats
nodes.summary: Decides whether all stats columns should be dropped based on the projected columns.

nodes.name: projection
nodes.summary: Computes the projected file schema for the requested columns and case sensitivity.

nodes.name: idAssigner
nodes.summary: Returns a transform that assigns first row ids to data file entries for row lineage.

nodes.name: ManifestsTable.java
nodes.summary: Metadata table listing the manifests of the current snapshot with their content type, path, length, spec id, file counts and partition summaries.

nodes.name: ManifestsTable
nodes.summary: Metadata table named manifests that reads the snapshot manifest list into StaticDataTask rows.

nodes.name: ManifestsTable.ManifestsTableScan
nodes.summary: Static scan that supplies the manifests task to the metadata scan machinery.

nodes.name: manifestFileToRow
nodes.summary: Maps a ManifestFile to a row, splitting added, existing and deleted counts by data versus delete content.

nodes.name: partitionSummariesToRows
nodes.summary: Converts partition field summaries into nested rows with human readable lower and upper bounds.

nodes.name: MergingSnapshotProducer.java

nodes.name: MergingSnapshotProducer

nodes.name: MergingSnapshotProducer.DataFileMergeManager
nodes.summary: ManifestMergeManager for data manifests that merges small manifests using the enclosing producer writers and readers.

nodes.name: MergingSnapshotProducer.DeleteFileFilterManager
nodes.summary: ManifestFilterManager for delete files that writes delete manifests and can drop orphaned DVs.

nodes.name: MergingSnapshotProducer.DeleteFileMergeManager
nodes.summary: ManifestMergeManager for delete manifests using delete manifest writers and readers.

nodes.name: deleteByRowFilter

nodes.name: dropPartition
nodes.summary: Drops all data files in a partition of a given spec.

nodes.name: validateDeleteFileForVersion

nodes.name: validateAddedDataFiles

nodes.name: validateNoNewDeletesForDataFiles
nodes.summary: Checks no new delete files apply to the given data files since the starting snapshot using a delete file index.

nodes.name: validateNoNewDeleteFiles
nodes.summary: Fails if concurrent commits added delete files matching a filter.

nodes.name: addedDeleteFilesIndexedPerSnapshot
nodes.summary: Builds per-snapshot delete file indexes from delete manifests committed after the starting snapshot.

nodes.name: validateDeletedDataFiles
nodes.summary: Throws if data files matching a filter or partition set were deleted by concurrent commits.

nodes.name: validateDataFilesExist
nodes.summary: Verifies that required data files were not removed by concurrent overwrite, replace or delete operations.

nodes.name: validateAddedDVs
nodes.summary: Rejects commits where a concurrent snapshot added a DV for a data file this commit also references.

nodes.name: buildDeleteFileIndex
nodes.summary: Creates a DeleteFileIndex over delete manifests with the given minimum sequence number, data filter or partition set, case sensitivity and specs.

nodes.name: validationHistory
nodes.summary: Walks ancestors between the starting snapshot and parent, collecting manifests and snapshot ids for matching operations.

nodes.name: apply
nodes.summary: Filters existing data and delete manifests, adds new manifests, merges them, builds the snapshot summary and returns the resulting manifest list.

nodes.name: updateEvent
nodes.summary: Builds a CreateSnapshotEvent describing the committed snapshot for listeners.

nodes.name: cleanUncommitted
nodes.summary: Deletes manifests created for a failed commit that are not in the committed manifest set.

nodes.summary: Writes the pending new data files, grouped by spec, to new data manifests and caches them across retries.

nodes.summary: Writes pending delete files and merged DVs to delete manifests, grouped by spec.

nodes.name: MetadataLogEntriesTable.java

nodes.name: RefsTable.RefsTableScan
nodes.summary: Static scan that supplies the refs task.
