nodes.summary: Looks up or lazily creates the FileWriter for a spec/partition pair, copying the partition key because the caller may reuse the object.

nodes.name: closeWriters
nodes.summary: Closes every open per-partition writer, collects each writer's result through addResult, then clears all writer maps.

nodes.name: RollingDataWriter.java
nodes.summary: Rolling data writer that splits incoming records into multiple data files within a single spec and partition once a target file size is reached.

nodes.name: RollingDataWriter
nodes.summary: Concrete RollingFileWriter producing DataWriter instances via a FileWriterFactory and aggregating the resulting DataFile list into a DataWriteResult.

nodes.name: TaskWriter.java
nodes.summary: Public interface for task-level writers that accept records and, on completion, return the generated data (and optionally delete) files.

nodes.name: TaskWriter
nodes.summary: Closeable writer interface with write, abort and complete operations plus a default dataFiles() helper that rejects results containing delete files.

nodes.name: MappedField.java
nodes.summary: Immutable value object mapping an optional field ID to a set of external names, with an optional nested MappedFields for child fields.

nodes.name: MappedField
nodes.summary: Serializable immutable mapping entry with static of(...) factories, equality based on id, names and nested mapping, and a readable toString.

nodes.name: MappedFields.java
nodes.summary: Immutable list of MappedField entries with lazily built indexes from name to field ID and from field ID to MappedField.

nodes.name: MappedFields
nodes.summary: Serializable container of MappedField objects exposing lookup by ID or name through transient, lazily computed immutable maps.

nodes.name: indexIds
nodes.summary: Builds an immutable map from every field name to its field ID, skipping fields whose ID is null.

nodes.name: MappingUtil.java
nodes.summary: Utility for creating a NameMapping from a Schema, evolving a mapping when the schema changes, and indexing mappings by ID or by dotted name using a private visitor framework.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines private Visitor, CreateMapping, UpdateMapping, IndexByName and IndexById nested types that traverse the mapping tree, mirroring the schema visitor pattern.

nodes.name: MappingUtil
nodes.summary: Static helper class whose create and update methods drive nested visitors over schemas and name mappings.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Creates a NameMapping from a Schema by visiting it with the CreateMapping visitor so each field maps its own name to its ID.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Produces an updated NameMapping that adds new names for renamed fields and extends the mapping with newly added nested fields.

nodes.name: visit
nodes.summary: Recursively walks a MappedFields tree with a Visitor, visiting each field's nested mapping before combining results.

nodes.name: NameMapping.java
nodes.summary: Represents a mapping from external schema names (such as Avro or Parquet column names) to Iceberg field IDs, with lookup by ID or dotted name path.

nodes.name: NameMapping
nodes.summary: Serializable top-level name mapping that wraps MappedFields and lazily indexes them via MappingUtil for find(id) and find(names...) lookups.

nodes.name: NameMappingParser.java
nodes.summary: Serializes NameMapping objects to JSON and parses them back, using the field-id, names and fields keys.

nodes.name: NameMappingParser
nodes.summary: Static JSON parser and writer for NameMapping with recursive handling of nested field mappings.

nodes.name: fieldFromJson
nodes.summary: Parses one JSON object into a MappedField, reading the optional field-id, names array and recursively parsed nested fields.

nodes.name: BitPacking.java
nodes.summary: Package-private bit packing and unpacking routines for values of 1 to 7 bits, with unrolled per-width implementations operating on ByteBuffers.
nodes.languageNotes: Per-width methods (packBits1..7, unpackBits1..7) are manually unrolled so the JIT can optimize fixed shifts and masks, which explains the large file size.

nodes.name: BitPacking
nodes.summary: Static utility that packs the low bits of int values into a ByteBuffer most-significant-bit first and unpacks them again, dispatching on bit width.

nodes.name: packBits
nodes.summary: Packs the least-significant width bits of count values into a ByteBuffer, dispatching to width-specific routines and returning the bytes written.

nodes.name: unpackBits
nodes.summary: Unpacks count values of the given bit width from a ByteBuffer into an int array and returns the number of bytes read.

nodes.name: unpackRemainder
nodes.summary: Unpacks the trailing values that do not fill a whole unrolled block using per-value shift and mask arithmetic.

nodes.name: MumblingBitmap.java
nodes.summary: Read-only, lazily decoded view of a Mumbling compressed bitmap stored in a ByteBuffer, supporting cardinality and per-position membership checks over sparse and dense containers.

nodes.name: MumblingBitmap
nodes.summary: Implements ManifestBitmap by parsing a 6-byte header, decoding PFOR-encoded container descriptors on first use and building an offsets table for container lookup.

nodes.name: isSet
nodes.summary: Tests whether a bit position is set by locating its 256-bit container and scanning a sparse list or indexing into a dense 32-byte bitset.

nodes.name: decodeDescriptors
nodes.summary: Decodes the PFOR-encoded descriptor array into container descriptors using PFOREncoding.decode.

nodes.name: descriptorsToOffsets
nodes.summary: Converts container descriptors into absolute byte offsets by accumulating sparse and dense container sizes.

nodes.name: MumblingBitmaps.java
nodes.summary: Public factory entry point that deserializes a ByteBuffer into a ManifestBitmap backed by the package-private MumblingBitmap.

nodes.name: MumblingBitmaps
nodes.summary: Static factory holder exposing read(ByteBuffer) that returns a MumblingBitmap as a ManifestBitmap.

nodes.name: read
nodes.summary: Wraps a serialized Mumbling bitmap buffer in a MumblingBitmap and returns it as a ManifestBitmap.

nodes.name: PFOREncoding.java
nodes.summary: Patched Frame of Reference encoder and decoder for arrays of unsigned byte values, splitting data into 256-value chunks with per-chunk minimum, bit widths and exception lists.

nodes.name: PFOREncoding
nodes.summary: Static codec implementing the Mumbling bitmap specification's PFOR appendix, delegating bit-level work to BitPacking.

nodes.name: encode
nodes.summary: Encodes unsigned byte values into a caller-supplied buffer chunk by chunk and returns the number of bytes written.

nodes.name: decode
nodes.summary: Decodes PFOR chunks from a buffer into an int array and returns the number of bytes consumed.

nodes.name: encodeChunk
nodes.summary: Encodes one chunk by normalizing against its minimum, choosing bit widths, packing the primary array and appending exception offsets and values.

nodes.name: decodeChunk
nodes.summary: Decodes a single chunk by unpacking the primary values, patching exceptions and adding back the chunk minimum.

nodes.name: chooseBitWidth
nodes.summary: Searches candidate primary bit widths and returns the pair of best width and exception count that minimizes the encoded size.

nodes.name: PuffinFormat.java
nodes.summary: Package-private constants and helpers describing the Puffin file footer layout, magic bytes, flag bits and compression and decompression of footer payloads.
nodes.languageNotes: LZ4 handling is left as a TODO that throws UnsupportedOperationException; only NONE and ZSTD codecs are implemented.

nodes.name: PuffinFormat
nodes.summary: Final static holder of Puffin format constants, a Flag enum mapped by byte and bit, little-endian integer I/O and codec dispatch.

nodes.name: compress
nodes.summary: Compresses a ByteBuffer with the given Puffin codec, returning a duplicate for NONE, using Zstd for ZSTD and rejecting unsupported codecs.

nodes.name: decompress
nodes.summary: Decompresses a ByteBuffer according to the Puffin codec, supporting NONE and ZSTD and throwing for other codecs.

nodes.name: decompressZstd
nodes.summary: Decompresses a Zstd frame into a freshly allocated array sized from the frame header, copying direct buffers when needed and validating the output length.

nodes.name: UnionByNameVisitor.java
nodes.summary: Schema visitor that compares a new schema against an existing one by field name and records the add, optional, type, doc and default changes on an UpdateSchema to produce their union.

nodes.name: UnionByNameVisitor
nodes.summary: Extends SchemaWithPartnerVisitor, pairing new-schema fields with existing-schema field IDs by name and issuing UpdateSchema operations for missing or changed columns.

nodes.name: visit
nodes.summary: Public entry point that visits the new schema against the existing schema, with optional case-insensitive name matching, accumulating changes into an UpdateSchema.

nodes.name: struct
nodes.summary: For each field of a struct, adds missing columns to the partner struct or updates existing columns that differ.

nodes.name: updateColumn
nodes.summary: Compares a new field with its existing counterpart and applies makeColumnOptional, type, doc and default updates to the UpdateSchema as needed.

nodes.name: isIgnorableTypeUpdate
nodes.summary: Decides whether a type difference can be ignored, treating narrower new primitive types and any complex-to-complex change as no-ops.

nodes.name: ArrayUtil.java
nodes.summary: Static helpers for converting between primitive arrays, boxed arrays and lists, appending to arrays and concatenating them, with several methods adapted from commons-lang3.

nodes.name: ArrayUtil
nodes.summary: Final-style utility class with empty array constants, int and long list conversions, toPrimitive overloads, add, isStrictlyAscending and concat.

nodes.name: add
nodes.summary: Returns a new array that is the input array with a single element appended, growing by one.

nodes.name: concat
nodes.summary: Concatenates several arrays of the same type into a single new array sized by their total length.

nodes.name: DecimalUtil.java
nodes.summary: Utility for writing a BigDecimal into a reusable fixed-length big-endian byte array, sign-extending the leading bytes.

nodes.name: DecimalUtil
nodes.summary: Static utility class exposing toReusedFixLengthBytes for fixed-width decimal serialization.

nodes.name: toReusedFixLengthBytes
nodes.summary: Validates scale and precision, then writes the decimal's unscaled bytes into a reused buffer padded with 0x00 or 0xFF according to its sign.

nodes.name: Filter.java
nodes.summary: Abstract generic filter whose subclasses implement shouldKeep and which can filter plain Iterables or CloseableIterables lazily.

nodes.name: Filter
nodes.summary: Abstract base class adapting a shouldKeep predicate into lazy iterables through an inner FilterIterator subclass, preserving closeability.

nodes.name: ManifestFileUtil.java
nodes.summary: Utility that uses a manifest's partition field summaries (bounds, null and NaN flags) to decide whether the manifest could contain given partition tuples.

nodes.name: ManifestFileUtil
nodes.summary: Static helper with a nested FieldSummary type that checks values against per-field lower and upper bounds for partition pruning.

nodes.name: canContainAny
nodes.summary: Returns true if the manifest has no summaries or any given partition tuple falls within the manifest's partition field bounds.

nodes.name: canContain
nodes.summary: Checks every field of a partition struct against its FieldSummary and returns false as soon as one value is outside the bounds.

nodes.name: summaries
nodes.summary: Builds typed FieldSummary objects for a manifest by pairing its partition field summaries with the partition spec's primitive field types.

nodes.name: Pair.java
nodes.summary: Generic immutable-style pair of two values that doubles as an Avro IndexedRecord, deriving its Avro schema reflectively with a cache.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements Avro's IndexedRecord and SchemaConstructable so Pairs can be read and written by Avro; the schema is computed from the component classes and cached in a Caffeine LoadingCache.

nodes.name: Pair
nodes.summary: Serializable Pair<X, Y> with first and second accessors, equals and hashCode, and Avro record support.

nodes.name: put
nodes.summary: Avro IndexedRecord setter that assigns the first or second value by position and rejects other positions.

nodes.name: PartitionMap.java
nodes.summary: Map keyed by (spec ID, partition tuple) pairs that stores partitions in per-spec StructLikeMaps for consistent equals and hashing across StructLike implementations.

nodes.name: PartitionMap
nodes.summary: AbstractMap implementation that lazily creates one StructLikeMap per partition spec and exposes Pair-keyed views for keySet, values and entrySet.

nodes.name: keySet
nodes.summary: Builds a set of (spec ID, partition) pairs by flattening the keys of every per-spec partition map.

nodes.name: entrySet
nodes.summary: Builds the entry set by flattening each per-spec map into PartitionEntry objects keyed by spec ID and partition.

nodes.name: StructLikeMap.java
nodes.summary: Map with StructLike keys that wraps each key in a StructLikeWrapper so structs of different implementations compare and hash consistently by type.

nodes.name: StructLikeMap
nodes.summary: AbstractMap backed by a HashMap of StructLikeWrapper keys, using thread-local reusable wrappers for lookups to avoid allocation.

nodes.name: containsKey
nodes.summary: Checks key membership by setting a thread-local wrapper on the struct, guarding against non-StructLike keys.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Looks up a value for a StructLike key through the reusable thread-local wrapper and returns null for foreign key types.

nodes.name: remove
nodes.summary: Removes the entry for a StructLike key using the thread-local wrapper and returns the previous value.

nodes.name: StructLikeSet.java
nodes.summary: Set of StructLike values that stores StructLikeWrappers so that structs of different implementations are treated as equal when their contents match.

nodes.name: StructLikeSet
nodes.summary: AbstractSet delegating to a HashSet of StructLikeWrapper with thread-local wrappers for membership checks and bulk operations.

nodes.name: contains
nodes.summary: Tests membership of a StructLike by wrapping it in a thread-local wrapper and checking the wrapper set.

nodes.name: removeAll
nodes.summary: Removes every element of a collection from the set, wrapping each StructLike before removal.

nodes.name: equals
nodes.summary: Compares with another set by size and element-wise containment, handling StructLikeSet and generic sets.

nodes.name: StructLikeUtil.java
nodes.summary: Utility that makes a deep value copy of a StructLike, copying nested StructLike values, so a reused row object can be safely retained.

nodes.name: StructLikeUtil
nodes.summary: Static helper with a private StructCopy implementation that snapshots all positions of a StructLike into an array.

nodes.name: copy
nodes.summary: Returns a StructCopy of the given StructLike or null when the input is null.

nodes.name: StructLikeWrapper.java
nodes.summary: Wrapper that gives StructLike values type-aware equals and hashCode via a comparator and JavaHash so they can be used in hash-based collections.

nodes.name: StructLikeWrapper
nodes.summary: Mutable wrapper whose set method swaps the wrapped struct, with lazily cached hash code and comparator-based equals.

nodes.name: equals
nodes.summary: Compares two wrappers by delegating to the type comparator, handling null structs and identity.

nodes.name: PrimitiveWrapper.java
nodes.summary: Package-private VariantPrimitive implementation wrapping a Java value with its PhysicalType and serializing it to the Variant binary encoding.

nodes.name: PrimitiveWrapper
nodes.summary: Generic wrapper that computes the serialized size of a primitive variant value and writes its header and payload into a ByteBuffer.

nodes.name: sizeInBytes
nodes.summary: Computes the encoded size of the primitive by switching on its physical type, including variable-length strings, binary and decimals.

nodes.name: writeTo
nodes.summary: Writes the type header and payload of the primitive value into a ByteBuffer at the given offset using little-endian layouts.

nodes.name: ShreddedObject.java
nodes.summary: Mutable Variant object that overlays shredded fields and removals on an optional unshredded object while sharing a single metadata dictionary, and serializes the merged result.

nodes.name: ShreddedObject
nodes.summary: VariantObject that combines shredded and unshredded fields, with a SerializationState computing field ordering, offsets and sizes before writeTo.

nodes.name: put
nodes.summary: Adds or replaces a shredded field, validating the name against the metadata dictionary and invalidating cached serialization state.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Returns a field's value from the shredded fields first, falling back to the unshredded object unless the field was removed.

nodes.name: writeTo
nodes.summary: Serializes the merged object into a ByteBuffer using lazily built SerializationState.

nodes.name: ValueArray.java
nodes.summary: Mutable Variant array holding a list of VariantValues and serializing them with a header, offsets and concatenated element data.

nodes.name: ValueArray
nodes.summary: VariantArray implementation whose SerializationState computes element offsets and sizes, resetting when elements are added.

nodes.name: writeTo
nodes.summary: Writes the array header, offset table and element payloads into a ByteBuffer using the cached serialization state.

nodes.name: Variants.java
nodes.summary: Public factory facade for building Variant metadata, objects, arrays and primitive values, including ISO date and time string conversions.

nodes.name: Variants
nodes.summary: Static factory class with metadata, object and array creators and numerous of(...) helpers for primitive variants returning PrimitiveWrapper instances.

nodes.name: metadata
nodes.summary: Builds serialized VariantMetadata from a collection of field names by sorting them and encoding the dictionary offsets.

nodes.name: object
nodes.summary: Creates a ShreddedObject over an existing object, recovering metadata from a ShreddedObject or SerializedObject and failing otherwise.

nodes.name: array
nodes.summary: Creates an empty mutable ValueArray.

nodes.name: of
nodes.summary: Wraps a typed Java value as a VariantPrimitive in a PrimitiveWrapper.

nodes.name: RegisterTableRequest.java
nodes.summary: Immutables-generated REST request body for registering an existing table by name and metadata location, with an optional overwrite flag.
nodes.languageNotes: Interface annotated with @Value.Immutable so Immutables generates ImmutableRegisterTableRequest at compile time.

nodes.name: RegisterTableRequest
nodes.summary: REST request interface carrying table name, metadata location and an overwrite flag (default false); validate() is a no-op because instances cannot be invalid.

nodes.name: RegisterViewRequest.java
nodes.summary: Immutables-generated REST request body for registering an existing view from a name and a metadata file location.
nodes.languageNotes: Interface annotated with @Value.Immutable; the builder implementation is generated.

nodes.name: RegisterViewRequest
nodes.summary: REST request interface holding the view name and metadata location; validation is a no-op.

nodes.name: RenameTableRequest.java
nodes.summary: Jackson-deserializable REST request describing a table rename from a source identifier to a destination identifier, with a validating builder.
nodes.languageNotes: Private validating constructor plus a public no-arg constructor kept only for Jackson deserialization.

nodes.name: RenameTableRequest
nodes.summary: Request POJO holding source and destination TableIdentifiers; validate() rejects null identifiers and a nested Builder constructs validated instances.

nodes.name: UpdateNamespacePropertiesRequest.java
nodes.summary: REST request carrying namespace property removals and updates, rejecting any key that is both set and removed.

nodes.name: UpdateNamespacePropertiesRequest
nodes.summary: Request POJO with lists of removals and key/value updates; null fields are exposed as empty collections and a Builder accumulates entries immutably.

nodes.name: validate
nodes.summary: Computes the intersection of update keys and removal keys and throws UnprocessableEntityException if any key appears in both.

nodes.name: UpdateTableRequest.java
nodes.summary: REST request bundling a table identifier, update requirements and MetadataUpdate changes for a table commit.

nodes.name: UpdateTableRequest
nodes.summary: Request POJO with requirements (optimistic-concurrency assertions) and metadata updates; accessors never return null and a static create() attaches the table identifier.

nodes.name: ConfigResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response to the REST catalog config call, carrying server default and override properties, supported endpoints and an idempotency key lifetime.

nodes.name: ConfigResponse
nodes.summary: Response POJO with defaults, overrides, endpoints and idempotencyKeyLifetime, plus a Builder; null collections are returned as empty.

nodes.name: merge
nodes.summary: Merges server defaults, client properties and server overrides in that precedence order and drops null values, returning an immutable map.

nodes.name: CreateNamespaceResponse.java
nodes.summary: REST response returned after creating a namespace, holding the namespace and its stored properties.

nodes.name: CreateNamespaceResponse
nodes.summary: Response POJO with a required Namespace and properties map; validate() rejects a null namespace and a Builder validates property maps.

nodes.name: GetNamespaceResponse.java
nodes.summary: REST response for loading a namespace, returning the namespace and its properties.

nodes.name: GetNamespaceResponse
nodes.summary: Response POJO with a required Namespace and property map, validated on construction and built through a Builder.

nodes.name: ListNamespacesResponse.java
nodes.summary: REST response listing child namespaces with an optional next-page token for pagination.

nodes.name: ListNamespacesResponse
nodes.summary: Response POJO holding a list of Namespace values and a nextPageToken; validate() requires a non-null list.

nodes.name: ListTablesResponse.java
nodes.summary: REST response listing table identifiers in a namespace with an optional next-page token.

nodes.name: ListTablesResponse
nodes.summary: Response POJO holding table identifiers and a pagination token; its Builder rejects null identifiers.

nodes.name: LoadTableResponse.java
nodes.summary: REST response for loading or creating a table, bundling table metadata, metadata location, client config, storage credentials, remote signing config and labels.

nodes.name: LoadTableResponse
nodes.summary: Response POJO whose accessors default to empty collections or EMPTY constants; its Builder derives the metadata location from the supplied TableMetadata.

nodes.name: tableMetadata
nodes.summary: Lazily rebuilds the TableMetadata with the response's metadata location applied and caches the result.

nodes.name: LoadViewResponse.java
nodes.summary: Immutables-generated REST response for loading a view, carrying metadata location, ViewMetadata, config and labels.
nodes.languageNotes: Interface with @Value.Immutable; labels() uses @Value.Default to fall back to Labels.EMPTY.

nodes.name: LoadViewResponse
nodes.summary: Response interface exposing metadataLocation, ViewMetadata, config map and labels; validation is a no-op.

nodes.name: OAuthTokenResponse.java
nodes.summary: OAuth2 token endpoint response model with access token, token type, expiry and scopes, plus a builder that validates scope tokens.

nodes.name: OAuthTokenResponse
nodes.summary: Immutable token response; scopes are stored as one space-delimited string and parsed through OAuth2Util on access.

nodes.name: validate
nodes.summary: Requires a non-null access token and a token type of bearer or N_A (case-insensitive).

nodes.name: scopes
nodes.summary: Parses the stored scope string into a list using OAuth2Util.parseScope, or returns an empty list.

nodes.name: UpdateNamespacePropertiesResponse.java
nodes.summary: REST response reporting which namespace property keys were removed, updated or requested for removal but missing.

nodes.name: UpdateNamespacePropertiesResponse
nodes.summary: Response POJO with removed, updated and missing key lists, built via ordered de-duplicating builders.

nodes.name: EnvironmentUtil.java
nodes.summary: Utility that resolves property values of the form env:NAME from process environment variables.

nodes.name: EnvironmentUtil
nodes.summary: Static helper with resolveAll() overloads that substitute env: prefixed values and drop entries whose variable is unset.

nodes.name: resolveAll
nodes.summary: Iterates properties, replacing env:VAR values with the environment value (omitting unresolved ones) and passing other values through.

nodes.name: LocationUtil.java
nodes.summary: String helpers for table and metadata locations: trailing-slash stripping, unique table path components, URI scheme detection, resolution and relativization against a table location.

nodes.name: LocationUtil
nodes.summary: Static utility class for manipulating storage location strings per RFC 3986 scheme rules.

nodes.name: stripTrailingSlash
nodes.summary: Removes trailing slashes from a path while preserving a scheme separator such as s3://.

nodes.name: tableLocation
nodes.summary: Returns the table name path component, optionally suffixed with a random UUID for unique locations.

nodes.name: hasScheme
nodes.summary: Checks whether a location starts with a valid RFC 3986 URI scheme followed by a colon.

nodes.name: resolveLocation
nodes.summary: Returns absolute locations unchanged and joins relative ones onto the table location with a slash.

nodes.name: relativizeLocation
nodes.summary: Strips the table location prefix from a location when it matches, otherwise returns the location as is.

nodes.name: LockManagers.java
nodes.summary: Factory and base implementations for LockManager, including a default in-JVM lock manager with heartbeat scheduling and dynamic loading of custom implementations.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a double-checked locking singleton for the shared daemon scheduler and DynConstructors for reflective loading.

nodes.name: LockManagers
nodes.summary: Holder class exposing the default lock manager and a factory that loads a configured LockManager implementation.

nodes.name: from
nodes.summary: Chooses the configured lock.impl if present, else the shared default lock manager.

nodes.name: loadLockManager
nodes.summary: Reflectively instantiates a LockManager through its no-arg constructor and initializes it with the given properties.

nodes.name: BaseLockManager
nodes.summary: Abstract LockManager that reads timeout and heartbeat settings from properties and lazily creates one shared daemon scheduler.

nodes.name: initialize
nodes.summary: Loads acquire and heartbeat timing configuration via PropertyUtil with CatalogProperties defaults.

nodes.name: InMemoryLockManager
nodes.summary: In-memory LockManager using a concurrent map of lock content plus scheduled heartbeats; only suited for tests or single-JVM commits.

nodes.name: acquire
nodes.summary: Acquires a lock with exponential-backoff retries using Tasks, returning false if acquisition times out.

nodes.name: PropertyUtil.java
nodes.summary: Static helpers for reading typed values from string property maps and for filtering, prefixing, merging and schema-adjusting property sets.

nodes.name: PropertyUtil
nodes.summary: Utility class with typed property getters (boolean, int, long, double, string) and map manipulation helpers.

nodes.name: propertyAsBoolean
nodes.summary: Reads a boolean property or returns the supplied default when absent.

nodes.name: propertyAsInt
nodes.summary: Reads an integer property or returns the supplied default when absent.

nodes.name: propertyTryAsInt
nodes.summary: Reads an integer property, logging a warning and returning the default when the value is not parseable.

nodes.name: propertyAsLong
nodes.summary: Reads a long property or returns the supplied default when absent.

nodes.name: validateCommitProperties
nodes.summary: Validates that table commit retry properties are non-negative integers, throwing ValidationException otherwise.

nodes.name: propertiesWithPrefix
nodes.summary: Returns the subset of properties whose keys start with a prefix, with the prefix removed from keys.

nodes.name: filterProperties
nodes.summary: Filters a property map by a key predicate.

nodes.name: mergeProperties
nodes.summary: Merges override properties over base properties, short-circuiting when either side is empty.

nodes.name: applySchemaChanges
nodes.summary: Rewrites column-scoped property keys to reflect renamed and dropped columns after a schema change.

nodes.name: Tasks.java
nodes.summary: Fluent task runner that applies a task to a collection of items serially or in parallel with retry, exponential backoff, revert and abort handling, and aggregated failure reporting.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of generic functional interfaces with checked-exception type parameters (Task<I, E extends Exception>) and a fluent Builder.

nodes.name: Tasks
nodes.summary: Entry-point holder exposing foreach and range factories and the nested Builder, Task and FailureTask types.

nodes.name: Builder
nodes.summary: Fluent builder configuring executor, retry policy, backoff, failure, revert and abort callbacks, then running tasks serially or in parallel.

nodes.name: UnrecoverableException
nodes.summary: RuntimeException that marks a failure as non-retryable.

nodes.name: foreach
nodes.summary: Overloaded factories that create a Builder over an iterator, iterable, varargs array or stream.

nodes.name: range
nodes.summary: Creates a Builder over the integer range [0, upTo).

nodes.name: waitFor
nodes.summary: Blocks until all futures complete and returns the uncaught throwables, handling interruption by cancelling futures.

nodes.name: throwOne
nodes.summary: Rethrows the first collected exception as the expected type, wrapping others in RuntimeException.

nodes.name: BaseMetastoreViewCatalog.java
nodes.summary: Abstract catalog base that adds view support to BaseMetastoreCatalog: loading views, a builder for creating or replacing views with optimistic commits, and registering views from metadata files.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses non-static inner classes (protected class BaseViewBuilder) that access the outer catalog's methods and properties.

nodes.name: BaseMetastoreViewCatalog
nodes.summary: Abstract class extending BaseMetastoreCatalog and implementing ViewCatalog; subclasses supply newViewOps().

nodes.name: BaseViewBuilder
nodes.summary: Inner ViewBuilder that collects schema, SQL representations, namespace and properties, then creates or replaces a view by committing new ViewMetadata.

nodes.name: BaseMetastoreViewCatalogTableBuilder
nodes.summary: Table builder override that rejects replaceTransaction when a view with the same name exists.

nodes.name: loadView
nodes.summary: Loads a view by creating ViewOperations and wrapping the current metadata in a BaseView, failing if the view does not exist.

nodes.name: registerView
nodes.summary: Registers a view from an existing metadata file after checking identifier validity and name conflicts with views and tables.

nodes.name: BaseView.java
nodes.summary: Concrete View implementation that delegates reads to the current ViewMetadata from ViewOperations and returns update builders for properties, version and location.

nodes.name: BaseView
nodes.summary: Serializable View wrapper around ViewOperations and a fully qualified name; every accessor reads ops.current().

nodes.name: sqlFor
nodes.summary: Returns the SQL representation for a dialect (case-insensitive), falling back to the first SQL representation found.

nodes.name: BaseViewOperations.java
nodes.summary: Abstract ViewOperations base that tracks current metadata and version, guards commits against stale bases, writes new metadata files and refreshes metadata from a location with retries.

nodes.name: BaseViewOperations
nodes.summary: Abstract base extending BaseMetastoreOperations; subclasses implement doRefresh, doCommit, viewName and io().

nodes.name: commit
nodes.summary: Rejects stale or conflicting bases, skips no-op commits, delegates to doCommit and schedules a refresh.

nodes.name: refresh
nodes.summary: Calls doRefresh and clears cached metadata if the view has disappeared.

nodes.name: refreshFromMetadataLocation
nodes.summary: Loads new ViewMetadata from a metadata file location with exponential-backoff retries and updates cached state.

nodes.name: metadataFileLocation
nodes.summary: Builds a metadata file path under write.metadata.path or the view location's metadata folder.

nodes.name: newMetadataFilePath
nodes.summary: Creates a versioned, UUID-named metadata file name with a compression-codec extension.

nodes.name: parseVersion
nodes.summary: Parses the numeric version prefix from a metadata file name, returning -1 if absent or malformed.

nodes.name: PropertiesUpdate.java
nodes.summary: Package-private UpdateViewProperties implementation that stages property sets and removals and commits them to ViewMetadata with retries.

nodes.name: PropertiesUpdate
nodes.summary: Collects property updates and removals, rejecting keys that are both set and removed, and applies them through ViewMetadata.Builder.

nodes.name: commit
nodes.summary: Retries commit on CommitFailedException using retry settings from the base metadata's properties.

nodes.name: SetViewLocation.java
nodes.summary: Package-private UpdateLocation implementation that sets a view's base location and commits it with retries.

nodes.name: SetViewLocation
nodes.summary: Holds a pending location and commits a ViewMetadata with the new location.

nodes.name: commit
nodes.summary: Refreshes metadata, then commits new location metadata with Tasks-based retry on CommitFailedException.

nodes.name: FileScopedPositionDeleteWriter.java

nodes.name: PositionDeleteIndex.java

nodes.name: fromJson

nodes.name: predicateFromJson

nodes.name: term

nodes.name: DeleteWriteResult.java

nodes.name: DeleteWriteResult

nodes.name: addResult

nodes.name: FileIOParser.java

nodes.name: BaseComputeTableStats

nodes.name: True.java
nodes.summary: Singleton expression that is always true; negation yields False and Java serialization is routed through a constant proxy to preserve the singleton.
nodes.languageNotes: Private constructor plus writeReplace/readResolve proxy keeps the INSTANCE singleton intact across Java serialization.

nodes.name: True
nodes.summary: Immutable singleton Expression representing the constant true.

nodes.name: True.writeReplace
nodes.summary: Replaces this singleton with a ConstantExpressionProxy during Java serialization.

nodes.name: ClosingIterator.java
nodes.summary: Iterator wrapper that automatically closes an underlying CloseableIterator once it has been fully consumed.

nodes.name: ClosingIterator
nodes.summary: Adapts a CloseableIterator to a plain Iterator, closing it on the first hasNext() that returns false and wrapping IOException in UncheckedIOException.

nodes.name: ClosingIterator.hasNext
nodes.summary: Delegates to the wrapped iterator and closes it once when exhaustion is first observed.

nodes.name: ClosingIterator.close
nodes.summary: Closes the wrapped iterator, marks it closed and converts IOException to UncheckedIOException.

nodes.name: CredentialSupplier.java
nodes.summary: Deprecated interface that exposes the credential string held by a FileIO for systems that do not use FileIO directly.

nodes.name: CredentialSupplier
nodes.summary: Single-method interface returning a credential string; deprecated since 1.10.0 and slated for removal in 2.0.0.

nodes.name: FileRange.java
nodes.summary: Immutable value type describing a byte range of a file (offset, length) together with a future that will hold the read data, used for vectored reads.

nodes.name: FileRange
nodes.summary: Holds a CompletableFuture<ByteBuffer>, an offset and a length, validating non-null buffer future and non-negative offset and length.

nodes.name: SupportsRecoveryOperations.java
nodes.summary: Optional FileIO extension interface offering best-effort recovery of files missing from storage, to repair tables with dangling references.

nodes.name: SupportsRecoveryOperations
nodes.summary: Mix-in interface declaring recoverFile(path), which attempts recovery and reports success.

nodes.name: DefaultCounter.java
nodes.summary: Thread-safe default Counter implementation backed by a LongAdder, with a NOOP instance and cached Integer and Long counter views.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses LongAdder for low-contention concurrent increments; the int view throws ArithmeticException on overflow.

nodes.name: DefaultCounter
nodes.summary: Counter with a MetricsContext.Unit, increment(amount) and value(), plus a static NOOP counter and lazily created typed adapters.

nodes.name: DefaultCounter.AsIntCounter
nodes.summary: Inner adapter exposing the counter as MetricsContext.Counter<Integer>, throwing ArithmeticException when the value exceeds Integer.MAX_VALUE.

nodes.name: DefaultCounter.AsLongCounter
nodes.summary: Inner adapter exposing the counter as MetricsContext.Counter<Long>.

nodes.name: DefaultCounter.asIntCounter
nodes.summary: Lazily creates and caches the Integer counter view.

nodes.name: DefaultCounter.asLongCounter
nodes.summary: Lazily creates and caches the Long counter view.

nodes.name: DefaultTimer.java
nodes.summary: Default Timer implementation that accumulates call count and total elapsed nanoseconds using LongAdders and measures spans with a Guava Stopwatch.

nodes.name: DefaultTimer
nodes.summary: Timer that records durations, offers time(Supplier|Runnable) and timeCallable helpers via try-with-resources, and reports count, total duration and unit.

nodes.name: DefaultTimer.DefaultTimed
nodes.summary: Started-timer handle that holds an atomic Stopwatch reference; stop() records the elapsed time once and fails on repeated calls.

nodes.name: DefaultTimer.record
nodes.summary: Validates a non-negative amount, converts it to nanoseconds and adds it to the total, incrementing the count.

nodes.name: DefaultTimer.start
nodes.summary: Starts a new DefaultTimed handle bound to this timer.

nodes.name: FixedReservoirHistogram.java
nodes.summary: Histogram implementation using reservoir sampling over a fixed-size array, computing mean, standard deviation, min, max and interpolated percentiles.
nodes.languageNotes: Synchronized updates with an immutable sorted snapshot for statistics; uses the uncorrected variance estimator.

nodes.name: FixedReservoirHistogram
nodes.summary: Keeps up to reservoirSize observations, randomly replacing entries once full, and produces a Statistics snapshot on demand.

nodes.name: FixedReservoirHistogram.UniformWeightStatistics
nodes.summary: Immutable sorted snapshot of sampled values exposing size, mean, stdDev, min, max and linearly interpolated percentile.

nodes.name: FixedReservoirHistogram.update
nodes.summary: Records a value, filling the reservoir first and then replacing a random slot with decreasing probability.

nodes.name: FixedReservoirHistogram.statistics
nodes.summary: Copies the reservoir under lock and computes sum-based mean and uncorrected standard deviation into a sorted statistics object.

nodes.name: Histogram.java
nodes.summary: Interface for recording observed long values and computing summary statistics over them.

nodes.name: Histogram
nodes.summary: Defines update(value), count() and statistics(), with a nested Statistics interface for size, mean, stdDev, min, max and percentile.

nodes.name: Histogram.Statistics
nodes.summary: Read-only view of histogram summary statistics including percentile lookup.

nodes.name: SerializationProxies.java
nodes.summary: Package-private collection of Java serialization proxies that restore singleton temporal, identity and void transforms on deserialization.
nodes.languageNotes: Each proxy is itself a singleton whose readResolve returns the canonical transform instance, preserving identity equality.

nodes.name: SerializationProxies
nodes.summary: Namespace class holding one serialization proxy per singleton transform (void, identity, years, months, days, hours).

nodes.name: SerializationProxies.VoidTransformProxy
nodes.summary: Serializable proxy whose readResolve returns the VoidTransform singleton.

nodes.name: SerializationProxies.IdentityTransformProxy
nodes.summary: Serializable proxy whose readResolve returns the Identity singleton.

nodes.name: SerializationProxies.YearsTransformProxy
nodes.summary: Serializable proxy whose readResolve returns the Years singleton.

nodes.name: SerializationProxies.MonthsTransformProxy
nodes.summary: Serializable proxy whose readResolve returns the Months singleton.

nodes.name: SerializationProxies.DaysTransformProxy
nodes.summary: Serializable proxy whose readResolve returns the Days singleton.

nodes.name: SerializationProxies.HoursTransformProxy
nodes.summary: Serializable proxy whose readResolve returns the Hours singleton.

nodes.name: EdgeAlgorithm.java
nodes.summary: Enum of algorithms used to interpolate edges between geography points (spherical, Vincenty, Thomas, Andoyer, Karney) with case-insensitive name parsing.

nodes.name: EdgeAlgorithm
nodes.summary: Enum of edge interpolation algorithms; fromName parses case-insensitively and toString emits the lower-case canonical name.

nodes.name: EdgeAlgorithm.fromName
nodes.summary: Parses an algorithm name using Locale.ROOT upper-casing and rethrows an IllegalArgumentException with a clear message for unknown values.

nodes.name: PrimitiveLikeHolder.java
nodes.summary: Package-private serialization holder that replaces primitive and variant types by their string name and restores them via Types.fromTypeName.

nodes.name: PrimitiveLikeHolder
nodes.summary: Serializable stand-in storing a type as a string; readResolve rebuilds the type through Types.fromTypeName.

nodes.name: PrimitiveLikeHolder.readResolve
nodes.summary: Resolves the stored type name back to a Type instance using Types.fromTypeName.

nodes.name: WrapperSet.java
nodes.summary: Abstract insertion-ordered, null-hostile Set that stores elements inside a serializable Wrapper so that subclasses can supply custom equality semantics (for example StructLike or file wrappers).
nodes.languageNotes: Wrapper instances are reused for lookups (contains/remove set then clear the wrapper) to avoid allocating and retaining references to the probed value.

nodes.name: WrapperSet
nodes.summary: Set implementation backed by a LinkedHashSet of Wrapper<T>; subclasses provide wrapper(), wrap() and elementClass(), and the set rejects nulls and compares through the wrapper's equals/hashCode.

nodes.name: contains
nodes.summary: Checks membership by loading the probe value into a reusable wrapper, querying the backing set, then clearing the wrapper so it holds no reference.

nodes.name: retainAll
nodes.summary: Wraps every element of the given collection (rejecting nulls and casting to the element class) and retains only matching entries in the backing set.

nodes.name: equals
nodes.summary: Compares with any other Set by size and containsAll, treating ClassCastException or NullPointerException as inequality.

nodes.name: BasicType.java
nodes.summary: Package-private enum of the four variant basic types encoded in the low bits of a variant value header: primitive, short string, object and array.

nodes.name: BasicType
nodes.summary: Enumerates the basic type categories (PRIMITIVE, SHORT_STRING, OBJECT, ARRAY) of the variant binary encoding.

nodes.name: LogicalType.java
nodes.summary: Package-private enum of the logical types a variant value can expose to readers, such as numeric, string, date, timestamp, uuid, array and object.

nodes.name: LogicalType
nodes.summary: Enumerates logical variant types (NULL, BOOLEAN, EXACT_NUMERIC, FLOAT, DOUBLE, DATE, TIMESTAMPTZ, TIMESTAMPNTZ, BINARY, STRING, TIME, UUID, ARRAY, OBJECT).

nodes.name: Primitives.java
nodes.summary: Constants class holding the numeric primitive type ids (null, booleans, int8 to int64, decimals, date, timestamps, string, uuid) and the header bit shift of the variant binary encoding.

nodes.name: Primitives
nodes.summary: Non-instantiable holder of TYPE_* primitive ids and PRIMITIVE_TYPE_SHIFT used when decoding variant primitive headers.

nodes.name: SerializedValue.java
nodes.summary: Package-private interface for variant values backed by a serialized ByteBuffer, supplying default sizeInBytes and writeTo implementations that copy the buffer directly.

nodes.name: SerializedValue
nodes.summary: Extends VariantValue and Serialized; defaults size to buffer().remaining() and writeTo to a positional bulk put of the underlying buffer.

nodes.name: VariantData.java
nodes.summary: Immutable Variant implementation pairing a VariantMetadata dictionary with a VariantValue, validating both are non-null.

nodes.name: VariantData
nodes.summary: Concrete Variant holding metadata and value; toString delegates to Variant.toString.

nodes.name: ViewHistoryEntry.java
nodes.summary: Public API interface describing one entry of a view's history: the timestamp of a change and the version id that became current.

nodes.name: ViewHistoryEntry
nodes.summary: Interface exposing timestampMillis() and versionId() for a single view history change.

nodes.name: BaseReadOnlyTable.java
nodes.summary: Abstract Table base class whose mutating operations (schema, spec, properties, append, overwrite, delete, snapshots, transactions) all throw UnsupportedOperationException with a message naming the table kind.
nodes.languageNotes: Every method is an @Override that throws; the constructor takes a descriptor string used to build the error messages.

nodes.name: BaseReadOnlyTable
nodes.summary: Provides a read-only Table skeleton for metadata tables; subclasses supply the read side while all write APIs fail fast.

nodes.name: ClientPool.java
nodes.summary: Public interface for a pool of catalog clients that runs an Action against a pooled client, optionally retrying.

nodes.name: ClientPool
nodes.summary: Generic pool abstraction with a nested Action<R,C,E> callback and run(action[, retry]) methods.

nodes.name: CommitCallbackTransaction.java
nodes.summary: Decorator around a Transaction that forwards every operation to the wrapped transaction and runs a callback after commitTransaction succeeds.

nodes.name: CommitCallbackTransaction
nodes.summary: Wraps a Transaction and invokes a Runnable after the wrapped transaction commits; created through the static addCallback factory.

nodes.name: addCallback
nodes.summary: Static factory returning a Transaction that runs the given callback after commit.

nodes.name: commitTransaction
nodes.summary: Commits the wrapped transaction and then runs the registered callback.

nodes.name: DataScan.java
nodes.summary: Abstract base for data-file table scans that configures a ManifestGroup with filters, schemas, specs, metrics and optional parallel planning.

nodes.name: DataScan
nodes.summary: Generic scan base extending SnapshotScan; builds ManifestGroup instances for data and delete manifests and always uses the snapshot schema.

nodes.name: newManifestGroup
nodes.summary: Creates a ManifestGroup over data and delete manifests applying case sensitivity, column selection, row filter, schemas, specs, scan metrics, residual handling and an optional plan executor.

nodes.name: Delegates.java
nodes.summary: Collection of delegating wrappers around ContentFile, DataFile and DeleteFile used to override selected attributes such as firstRowId or dataSequenceNumber without copying the file.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses anonymous subclasses and generic self-typed ContentFile<F> delegation so wrappers keep the concrete file type.

nodes.name: Delegates
nodes.summary: Non-instantiable holder of static factories and nested delegating file classes.

nodes.name: suppressFirstRowId
nodes.summary: Returns a DataFile wrapper that reports a null firstRowId when the file has one, otherwise returns the file unchanged.

nodes.name: pendingDeleteFile
nodes.summary: Wraps a DeleteFile so its data sequence number is the supplied pending value.

nodes.name: PendingDeleteFile
nodes.summary: DelegatingDeleteFile that overrides dataSequenceNumber() with a fixed value and re-wraps itself on wrap().

nodes.name: DelegatingDataFile
nodes.summary: ContentFile delegate implementing DataFile by forwarding to a wrapped DataFile.

nodes.name: DelegatingDeleteFile
nodes.summary: ContentFile delegate implementing DeleteFile, forwarding delete-specific accessors and supporting rewrap.

nodes.name: DelegatingContentFile
nodes.summary: Base delegate implementing ContentFile<F> by forwarding every accessor and copy method to a wrapped file.

nodes.name: EntryStatus.java
nodes.summary: Package-private enum of manifest entry statuses (EXISTING, ADDED, DELETED, REPLACED, MODIFIED) with numeric ids and a liveness flag, including the v4 additions.

nodes.name: EntryStatus
nodes.summary: Enum mapping manifest entry status ids to constants, with isLive() and a fromId lookup backed by a cached values array.

nodes.name: FieldLabel.java
nodes.summary: Immutables-generated value interface pairing a field id with a map of string labels.
nodes.languageNotes: Annotated with @Value.Immutable so the Immutables processor generates the implementation.

nodes.name: FieldLabel
nodes.summary: Interface with fieldId() and labels() describing labels attached to one field.

nodes.name: FixedSizeSplitScanTaskIterator.java
nodes.summary: Iterator that splits a parent scan task into consecutive tasks of a fixed target size, with a possibly shorter final split.

nodes.name: FixedSizeSplitScanTaskIterator
nodes.summary: Generates split tasks via a SplitScanTaskCreator, advancing an offset and shrinking the remaining length on each next().

nodes.name: GenericBlobMetadata.java
nodes.summary: Immutable BlobMetadata implementation describing a statistics blob (type, source snapshot, sequence number, field ids, properties), with conversion from Puffin blob metadata.

nodes.name: GenericBlobMetadata
nodes.summary: Value class that defensively copies fields and properties, validates non-null inputs, and implements equals/hashCode/toString.

nodes.name: from
nodes.summary: Converts a Puffin BlobMetadata into a GenericBlobMetadata.

nodes.name: equals
nodes.summary: Compares type, source snapshot id, sequence number, fields and properties.

nodes.name: GenericPartitionStatisticsFile.java
nodes.summary: Immutables-generated value interface for a partition statistics file, extending the public PartitionStatisticsFile API.
nodes.languageNotes: Empty body; the Immutables processor generates the implementation from @Value.Immutable.

nodes.name: GenericPartitionStatisticsFile
nodes.summary: Marker interface extending PartitionStatisticsFile for generated immutable implementations.

nodes.name: GenericStatisticsFile.java
nodes.summary: Immutable StatisticsFile implementation recording snapshot id, path, file and footer sizes and blob metadata for a table statistics (Puffin) file.

nodes.name: GenericStatisticsFile
nodes.summary: Value class that validates path and blob metadata, copies the blob list immutably, and implements equals/hashCode/toString.

nodes.name: HasTableOperations.java
nodes.summary: Small public interface for tables that expose their underlying TableOperations.

nodes.name: HasTableOperations
nodes.summary: Interface declaring operations() to retrieve a table's TableOperations.

nodes.name: IndexedStructLike.java
nodes.summary: Adapter that wraps a StructLike as an Avro IndexedRecord so structs can be written with Avro schemas.

nodes.name: IndexedStructLike
nodes.summary: Reusable wrapper that delegates positional get/set to the wrapped StructLike and returns a fixed Avro schema.

nodes.name: InheritableMetadata.java
nodes.summary: Package-private serializable interface for applying inherited manifest-level metadata (snapshot id, sequence numbers) to manifest entries.

nodes.name: InheritableMetadata
nodes.summary: Declares apply(ManifestEntry) that fills in or validates inherited fields of an entry.

nodes.name: InheritableMetadataFactory.java
nodes.summary: Factory for InheritableMetadata strategies: empty (requires explicit snapshot ids), from a manifest (inherits snapshot id and ADDED sequence numbers, sets file spec and location), and copy (stamps a new snapshot id).
nodes.languageNotes: Implements v1/v2 sequence number inheritance rules: sequence defaults to 0 in v1 and is inherited only for ADDED entries in v2.

nodes.name: InheritableMetadataFactory
nodes.summary: Non-instantiable factory exposing empty(), fromManifest(ManifestFile) and forCopy(snapshotId).

nodes.name: fromManifest
nodes.summary: Builds inheritable metadata from a manifest, requiring an assigned snapshot id and capturing spec id, sequence number and path.

nodes.name: BaseInheritableMetadata
nodes.summary: Applies inherited snapshot id, data/file sequence numbers and spec id/manifest location to entries and BaseFile instances.

nodes.name: CopyMetadata
nodes.summary: Sets a fixed snapshot id on each entry when rewriting a manifest before commit.

nodes.name: EmptyInheritableMetadata
nodes.summary: Requires each entry to already have a snapshot id and otherwise throws.

nodes.name: IsolationLevel.java
nodes.summary: Public enum of table isolation levels, SERIALIZABLE and SNAPSHOT, with case-insensitive name parsing; documents conflict-detection semantics for row-level operations.

nodes.name: IsolationLevel
nodes.summary: Enum with fromName(String) that upper-cases using Locale.ROOT and reports invalid names with the cause chained.

nodes.name: fromName
nodes.summary: Parses an isolation level name case-insensitively, throwing IllegalArgumentException for null or unknown values.

nodes.name: MergeAppend.java
nodes.summary: AppendFiles implementation built on MergingSnapshotProducer that adds data files and pre-built manifests, merging manifests to minimize their count.

nodes.name: MergeAppend
nodes.summary: Extends MergingSnapshotProducer and implements AppendFiles; reports the APPEND operation and validates appended manifests have no existing/deleted files and unassigned ids.

nodes.name: appendManifest
nodes.summary: Validates that the manifest has only new files with commit-assigned snapshot id and sequence number, then adds it to the commit.

nodes.name: MetricsModes.java
nodes.summary: Defines metrics collection modes (none, counts, truncate(N), full), their singleton implementations and string parsing, with proxy-based serialization to preserve reference equality.
nodes.languageNotes: Serializable modes use writeReplace to a MetricsModeProxy whose readResolve returns canonical instances via fromString.

nodes.name: MetricsModes
nodes.summary: Non-instantiable container for the MetricsMode interface and its None, Counts, Truncate and Full implementations.

nodes.name: fromString
nodes.summary: Parses none, counts, full (case-insensitive) or truncate(N) into the matching MetricsMode, throwing on invalid input.

nodes.name: MetricsMode
nodes.summary: Public serializable interface describing a metrics calculation mode.

nodes.name: None
nodes.summary: Singleton mode that persists no column metrics.

nodes.name: Counts
nodes.summary: Singleton mode that persists value, null and NaN counts without bounds.

nodes.name: Truncate
nodes.summary: Mode that persists counts plus bounds truncated to a positive length.

nodes.name: Full
nodes.summary: Singleton mode that persists counts and full lower/upper bounds.

nodes.name: ProxySerializableMetricsMode
nodes.summary: Base class whose writeReplace serializes the mode as its string form.

nodes.name: MetricsModeProxy
nodes.summary: Serialization proxy that resolves back to the canonical mode through MetricsModes.fromString.

nodes.name: PlanningMode.java
nodes.summary: Enum of scan planning modes (auto, local, distributed) with case-insensitive name lookup, used to pick where file scan planning runs.

nodes.name: PlanningMode
nodes.summary: Enum constants AUTO, LOCAL and DISTRIBUTED, each carrying a string mode name.

nodes.name: fromName
nodes.summary: Parses a mode name case-insensitively into a PlanningMode and rejects null or unknown names.

nodes.name: RollingManifestWriter.java
nodes.summary: Manifest writer wrapper that rolls over to a new ManifestWriter when the current manifest reaches a target size, producing multiple manifest files.
nodes.languageNotes: Generic over F extends ContentFile<F>, so one implementation serves data and delete files. The size check only runs every 250 rows to avoid querying file length per entry.

nodes.name: RollingManifestWriter
nodes.summary: Closeable writer that delegates add, existing and delete entries to a supplier-created ManifestWriter and starts a new manifest once the size target is met.

nodes.name: existing
nodes.summary: Writes an existing entry, preserving its original snapshot ID and sequence numbers, via the current writer.

nodes.name: delete
nodes.summary: Writes a deleted entry for a file, preserving its sequence numbers, via the current writer.

nodes.name: currentWriter
nodes.summary: Lazily creates the active ManifestWriter and rolls to a fresh one when the size threshold is reached.

nodes.name: closeCurrentWriter
nodes.summary: Closes the active writer, records its ManifestFile and resets row counters, wrapping IOException in UncheckedIOException.

nodes.name: close
nodes.summary: Closes the rolling writer once, flushing the last open manifest.

nodes.name: toManifestFiles
nodes.summary: Returns the list of manifests produced, valid only after the writer has been closed.

nodes.name: RowLevelOperationMode.java
nodes.summary: Enum describing the two row-level modification strategies, copy-on-write and merge-on-read, with case-insensitive name parsing.

nodes.name: RowLevelOperationMode
nodes.summary: Enum with COPY_ON_WRITE and MERGE_ON_READ constants whose Javadoc explains the write versus read cost trade-off.

nodes.name: fromName
nodes.summary: Parses a mode name case-insensitively into a RowLevelOperationMode and rejects null or unknown names.

nodes.name: SetPartitionStatistics.java
nodes.summary: PendingUpdate implementation that adds or removes partition statistics files in table metadata and commits the change through TableOperations.

nodes.name: SetPartitionStatistics
nodes.summary: Accumulates statistics files to set and snapshot IDs to remove, then builds new TableMetadata and commits it.

nodes.name: setPartitionStatistics
nodes.summary: Queues a partition statistics file keyed by snapshot ID, ignoring null input.

nodes.name: removePartitionStatistics
nodes.summary: Queues removal of the statistics file for a snapshot ID.

nodes.name: apply
nodes.summary: Computes the resulting partition statistics list from current metadata without committing.

nodes.name: commit
nodes.summary: Applies pending changes to the base metadata and commits via TableOperations.

nodes.name: internalApply
nodes.summary: Builds new TableMetadata from the base using TableMetadata.Builder, applying sets and removals.

nodes.name: SnapshotIdGeneratorUtil.java
nodes.summary: Utility that generates random non-negative 64-bit snapshot IDs from a UUID.

nodes.name: SnapshotIdGeneratorUtil
nodes.summary: Final static utility class for snapshot ID generation.

nodes.name: generateSnapshotID
nodes.summary: XORs the UUID high and low bits and masks the sign bit to yield a positive long ID.

nodes.name: SplitScanTaskIterator.java
nodes.summary: Package-private iterator contract for splitting a scan task into smaller tasks, with a nested creator callback for building child tasks.

nodes.name: SplitScanTaskIterator
nodes.summary: Iterator interface over split tasks with a nested SplitScanTaskCreator functional interface taking parent task, offset and length.

nodes.name: SupportsLabels.java
nodes.summary: Mixin interface for tables that can expose advisory, catalog-supplied labels.

nodes.name: SupportsLabels
nodes.summary: Declares labels() returning catalog-provided Labels, which callers may ignore and implementations may drop on serialization.

nodes.name: TableUtil.java
nodes.summary: Static helpers that read format version and metadata file location from any Table flavor and test row lineage support.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses instanceof dispatch over SerializableTable, HasTableOperations and BaseMetadataTable to reach the underlying metadata.

nodes.name: TableUtil
nodes.summary: Non-instantiable utility class with table introspection helpers.

nodes.name: formatVersion
nodes.summary: Returns the table format version by inspecting the concrete Table type, failing for unsupported types.

nodes.name: metadataFileLocation
nodes.summary: Returns the current metadata file location by inspecting the concrete Table type.

nodes.name: supportsRowLineage
nodes.summary: Returns true when the table is not a metadata table and its format version meets the row lineage minimum.

nodes.name: TrackedFileAdapters.java

nodes.name: TrackedFileAdapters
nodes.summary: Holds static adapter factories and private nested adapter classes wrapping TrackedFile.

nodes.summary: Wraps a DATA TrackedFile as a DataFile after validating its content type and resolving the spec ID.

nodes.name: asEqualityDeleteFile
nodes.summary: Wraps an EQUALITY_DELETES TrackedFile as a DeleteFile after validating content type and resolving spec ID.

nodes.name: asManifestFile
nodes.summary: Wraps a data or delete manifest TrackedFile as a ManifestFile after validating its content type.

nodes.name: resolveSpecId
nodes.summary: Finds the spec ID for a tracked file, falling back to the table's unpartitioned spec when the ID is null.

nodes.name: TrackedFileAdapter
nodes.summary: Abstract base adapter implementing ContentFile with tracking-derived position, sequence numbers, spec ID and partition.

nodes.name: TrackedContentFile
nodes.summary: Abstract adapter extending the base adapter with content file accessors such as path, format, counts and metrics.

nodes.name: TrackedDataFile
nodes.summary: Adapter presenting a TrackedFile as a DataFile.

nodes.name: TrackedEqualityDeleteFile
nodes.summary: Adapter presenting a TrackedFile as an equality DeleteFile.

nodes.name: TrackedDVDeleteFile
nodes.summary: Adapter presenting a TrackedFile as a deletion-vector DeleteFile.

nodes.name: TrackedManifestFile
nodes.summary: Adapter presenting a TrackedFile as a ManifestFile, with copy support.

nodes.name: ValueSizeFieldMetrics

nodes.name: BaseRewriteTablePath

nodes.name: BaseSnapshotTable.java

nodes.languageNotes: Uses the Immutables annotation processor (@Value.Immutable, @Value.Style) so nested Result interfaces generate immutable builder classes at compile time.

nodes.name: BaseSnapshotTable

nodes.name: BaseSnapshotUpdateAction.java
nodes.summary: Abstract base for actions that commit a snapshot update, collecting summary properties and applying them on commit.

nodes.name: BaseSnapshotUpdateAction
nodes.summary: Abstract generic action holding a summary property map and a self() hook for fluent chaining.

nodes.name: set
nodes.summary: Stores a snapshot summary property and returns self for chaining.

nodes.name: commit
