nodes.name: FileURI.java
nodes.summary: Mutable value holder for a file URI split into scheme, authority and path, with equivalence-aware construction used when comparing file locations in orphan file detection.

nodes.name: FileURI
nodes.summary: Value class with three constructors, getters/setters and scheme, authority and path match helpers.

nodes.name: FileURI
nodes.summary: Constructor that normalizes scheme and authority through equivalence maps from a java.net.URI.

nodes.name: toString
nodes.summary: Renders the URI components using MoreObjects.toStringHelper.

nodes.name: SnapshotUpdateAction.java
nodes.summary: Public action interface adding the ability to set snapshot summary properties on resulting commits.

nodes.name: SnapshotUpdateAction
nodes.summary: Generic interface extending Action with set(property, value) returning the action type.

nodes.name: AvroCustomOrderSchemaVisitor.java
nodes.summary: Avro schema visitor that gives implementations control over traversal order by passing lazy suppliers for child results, rejecting recursive records and handling variant schemas.
nodes.languageNotes: Children are passed as Supplier futures so a subclass decides when and whether to visit them.

nodes.name: AvroCustomOrderSchemaVisitor
nodes.summary: Abstract generic visitor with a static visit dispatcher and overridable record, field, union, array, map, variant and primitive hooks.

nodes.name: visit
nodes.summary: Static dispatcher switching on the Avro schema type, detecting recursion via record names and wrapping children in lazy suppliers.

nodes.name: VisitFuture
nodes.summary: Supplier that lazily visits a schema with the visitor.

nodes.name: VisitFieldFuture
nodes.summary: Supplier that lazily visits a record field's schema through the visitor's field hook.

nodes.name: BaseWriteBuilder.java
nodes.summary: Abstract Avro schema visitor that builds ValueWriter trees, mapping Avro primitives, logical types, option unions, arrays, maps and variants to ValueWriters.
nodes.languageNotes: Switch statements over logical type names and Avro types select the matching ValueWriters factory; subclasses supply record and fixed writers.

nodes.name: BaseWriteBuilder
nodes.summary: Base class leaving createRecordWriter and fixedWriter abstract while implementing the remaining visitor hooks.

nodes.name: union
nodes.summary: Builds an option writer for a two-branch union with a null branch and rejects other unions.

nodes.name: array
nodes.summary: Builds an array writer, or a map-style array writer when the schema is a LogicalMap.

nodes.name: primitive
nodes.summary: Maps Avro logical and primitive types to the corresponding ValueWriters, throwing on unsupported types.

nodes.name: HasIds.java
nodes.summary: Package-private Avro schema visitor that lazily reports whether any node in a schema carries an Iceberg field, key, value or element ID, short-circuiting on the first hit.

nodes.name: MissingIds.java
nodes.summary: Package-private Avro schema visitor that returns true as soon as any field, map or array node lacks its Iceberg ID property; the inverse of HasIds and used to reject partially annotated schemas.

nodes.name: RemoveIds.java
nodes.summary: Avro schema visitor that rebuilds a schema while stripping Iceberg field, key, value and element ID properties, preserving all other properties; exposes static removeIds helpers.

nodes.name: SupportsCustomRecords.java
nodes.summary: Package-private interface for Avro DatumReaders that can resolve custom record classes by name using a class loader and a rename map.

nodes.name: VariantLogicalType.java
nodes.summary: Singleton Avro LogicalType named 'variant' whose validation requires the annotated schema to be a valid Iceberg variant record.
nodes.languageNotes: Extends Avro's LogicalType and exposes a private-constructor singleton via a package-private accessor.

nodes.name: DeleteCounter.java
nodes.summary: Minimal counter used to tally how many deletes have been applied while filtering rows.

nodes.name: EmptyPositionDeleteIndex.java
nodes.summary: Immutable null-object PositionDeleteIndex singleton that has no deleted positions and rejects all mutation.

nodes.name: PositionDeleteIndexUtil.java
nodes.summary: Static helper that merges several PositionDeleteIndex instances into a single bitmap-backed index.

nodes.name: RoaringPositionBitmap.java
nodes.summary: Bitmap for positive 64-bit positions built from an array of 32-bit RoaringBitmaps keyed by the high 4 bytes, with range set, iteration, run-length encoding and portable little-endian serialization.
nodes.languageNotes: Splits a 64-bit position into a 32-bit key and 32-bit offset, and grows its bitmap array lazily; serialization follows the Roaring portable format.

nodes.name: Ciphers.java
nodes.summary: Holds AES-GCM encryption and decryption helpers plus the constants (block sizes, nonce and tag lengths, stream magic) used by Iceberg's GCM stream file encryption.
nodes.languageNotes: Wraps javax.crypto with fresh random nonces per encryption; stream block AADs combine a file AAD prefix with the block index.

nodes.name: EncryptionAlgorithm.java
nodes.summary: Enum of supported file encryption algorithms (AES_CTR, AES_GCM, AES_GCM_CTR) with documentation of their integrity trade-offs.

nodes.name: EncryptionKeyMetadatas.java
nodes.summary: Static factory that builds EncryptionKeyMetadata instances from a ByteBuffer or byte array.

nodes.name: KeyManagementClient.java
nodes.summary: Minimal interface for talking to a key management service: wrap and unwrap keys by master key ID, optionally generate keys server-side, initialize from properties and close.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses default methods so implementations only need to support wrapping; includes a nested KeyGenerationResult holder.

nodes.name: Hilbert.java
nodes.summary: Expression Term representing a Hilbert space-filling-curve ordering over a list of named column references, used for sort and clustering.

nodes.name: Zorder.java
nodes.summary: Expression Term representing a Z-order (Morton) ordering over a list of named column references, used for sort and clustering.

nodes.name: ConfigProperties.java
nodes.summary: Constants holder for Hadoop configuration keys controlling Hive engine enablement, Hive locking and Hive stats retention.

nodes.name: ByteBufferInputStream.java
nodes.summary: Abstract SeekableInputStream over one or more ByteBuffers, with factories that choose a single- or multi-buffer implementation and APIs to slice or take remaining buffers without copying.

nodes.name: EagerInputStream.java
nodes.summary: Seekable, range-readable input stream backed by a byte array that was fetched in one remote call, implementing seek, tail and positional reads over the in-memory contents.

nodes.name: MultiBufferInputStream.java
nodes.summary: ByteBufferInputStream implementation spanning a list of ByteBuffers, supporting seek, skip, mark/reset, bulk reads and zero-copy slicing across buffer boundaries.
nodes.languageNotes: Duplicates input buffers so the originals are never consumed, and records read buffers while a mark is active to support reset.

nodes.name: SingleBufferInputStream.java
nodes.summary: ByteBufferInputStream implementation over one ByteBuffer that works on a duplicate, supporting seek, skip, mark/reset and slicing.

nodes.name: UncheckedInterruptedException.java
nodes.summary: RuntimeException that wraps interruption during JDBC catalog operations, with printf-style message formatting and optional cause.

nodes.name: UncheckedSQLException.java
nodes.summary: RuntimeException that wraps SQLException failures in the JDBC catalog, with printf-style message formatting and optional cause.

nodes.name: CounterResult.java
nodes.summary: Immutables-generated, serializable snapshot of a Counter's unit and value, with factories from a live Counter (null when no-op) or explicit values.

nodes.name: InMemoryMetricsReporter.java
nodes.summary: MetricsReporter that retains only the most recent MetricsReport and exposes it as a ScanReport or CommitReport, mainly for tests and inspection.

nodes.name: TimerResult.java
nodes.summary: Immutables-generated, serializable snapshot of a Timer's time unit, total duration and count, with factories from a live Timer (null when no-op) or explicit values.

nodes.name: HasIds
nodes.summary: Visitor whose results are booleans: true if a field, map or array node carries an ID property, checked lazily so subtrees are skipped once a hit is found.

nodes.name: MissingIds
nodes.summary: Visitor that returns true once any field, map key/value or array element lacks its ID property; primitives and variants never count as missing.

nodes.name: RemoveIds
nodes.summary: Public AvroSchemaVisitor that copies records, maps, arrays and fields while dropping ID properties and keeping every other property.

nodes.name: SupportsCustomRecords
nodes.summary: Interface with setClassLoader and setRenames hooks for readers that instantiate custom record classes by name.

nodes.name: VariantLogicalType
nodes.summary: Singleton LogicalType named 'variant'; validate delegates to AvroSchemaUtil.isVariantSchema and fails with a clear message.

nodes.name: DeleteCounter
nodes.summary: Mutable long counter with increment and get used to count applied deletes.

nodes.name: EmptyPositionDeleteIndex
nodes.summary: Singleton index that reports nothing deleted, is always empty, and throws UnsupportedOperationException on delete.

nodes.name: PositionDeleteIndexUtil
nodes.summary: Non-instantiable utility class holding the merge helper for position delete indexes.

nodes.name: RoaringPositionBitmap
nodes.summary: 64-bit position set built from per-key 32-bit RoaringBitmaps with range operations, cardinality, iteration, run-length encoding and portable serialization.

nodes.name: Ciphers
nodes.summary: Non-instantiable holder of encryption constants, nested AES-GCM encryptor and decryptor classes, and shared key, cipher and stream-AAD helpers.

nodes.name: AesGcmEncryptor
nodes.summary: Encrypts byte arrays with AES-GCM using a freshly generated random nonce per call and optional additional authenticated data, prefixing the nonce to the ciphertext.

nodes.name: AesGcmDecryptor
nodes.summary: Decrypts AES-GCM ciphertext that carries a leading nonce and trailing tag, verifying optional additional authenticated data.

nodes.name: EncryptionAlgorithm
nodes.summary: Enum describing AES_CTR (no integrity), AES_GCM (confidentiality and integrity) and AES_GCM_CTR (GCM metadata with CTR page data).

nodes.name: EncryptionKeyMetadatas
nodes.summary: Non-instantiable factory class with overloads that wrap raw key metadata as EncryptionKeyMetadata.

nodes.name: KeyManagementClient
nodes.summary: Serializable, Closeable KMS client contract with wrapKey, unwrapKey, initialize, and optional server-side generateKey.

nodes.name: KeyGenerationResult
nodes.summary: Value holder pairing a raw secret key with its KMS-wrapped form, returned by server-side key generation.

nodes.name: Hilbert
nodes.summary: Term holding an array of NamedReferences that defines Hilbert-curve ordering columns.

nodes.name: Zorder
nodes.summary: Term holding an array of NamedReferences that defines Z-order ordering columns.

nodes.name: ConfigProperties
nodes.summary: Non-instantiable class of string constants naming Hive-related Hadoop configuration keys.

nodes.name: ByteBufferInputStream
nodes.summary: Abstract stream base defining buffer-oriented reads and slices, with wrap factories choosing Single- or MultiBufferInputStream.

nodes.name: EagerInputStream
nodes.summary: Stream over a fully loaded byte array that delegates sequential reads to ByteArrayInputStream and serves positional and tail reads with arraycopy.

nodes.name: MultiBufferInputStream
nodes.summary: Stream over a list of ByteBuffers that tracks position, mark state and the current buffer while advancing through an iterator of duplicates.

nodes.name: SingleBufferInputStream
nodes.summary: Stream over a single ByteBuffer duplicate that tracks its start offset, length and mark for seek and reset.

nodes.name: UncheckedInterruptedException
nodes.summary: RuntimeException with formatted-message and cause-plus-message constructors for interrupted JDBC operations.

nodes.name: UncheckedSQLException
nodes.summary: RuntimeException with formatted-message and cause-plus-message constructors for SQL failures.

nodes.name: CounterResult
nodes.summary: Immutables-backed interface exposing unit and value, with static factories fromCounter and of.

nodes.name: InMemoryMetricsReporter
nodes.summary: Stores the latest reported MetricsReport and returns it as a ScanReport (validated) or CommitReport (null if another type).

nodes.name: TimerResult
nodes.summary: Immutables-backed interface exposing time unit, total duration and count, with static factories fromTimer and of.

nodes.name: record
nodes.summary: Rebuilds a record by copying each field with its converted schema and no field ID.

nodes.name: map
nodes.summary: Creates a map schema for the value type, copying all properties except key and value IDs.

nodes.name: array
nodes.summary: Creates an array schema for the element type, copying all properties except the element ID.

nodes.name: copyField
nodes.summary: Copies an Avro field onto a new schema while dropping the field-id property.

nodes.name: removeIds
nodes.summary: Public entry point that visits an Avro schema with RemoveIds and returns the ID-free copy.

nodes.name: forEachInRange
nodes.summary: Validates that the range start does not exceed its end and otherwise does nothing since the index is empty.

nodes.name: merge
nodes.summary: Merges all given indexes into a new BitmapPositionDeleteIndex.

nodes.name: set
nodes.summary: Validates a position and sets it in the bitmap for its key, growing the array as needed.

nodes.name: setRange
nodes.summary: Sets all positions in a range, splitting the range across 32-bit key boundaries.

nodes.name: setAll
nodes.summary: Merges every set position of another bitmap into this one.

nodes.name: contains
nodes.summary: Tests membership by looking up the bitmap for the key and testing the low 32 bits.

nodes.name: cardinality
nodes.summary: Sums the cardinalities of all 32-bit bitmaps.

nodes.name: forEachInRange
nodes.summary: Iterates set positions inside a half-open range across relevant key bitmaps.

nodes.name: allocateBitmapsIfNeeded
nodes.summary: Grows the bitmap array to hold a required key, filling gaps with empty bitmaps.

nodes.name: serializedSizeInBytes
nodes.summary: Computes the portable serialized size from the count header and each keyed bitmap.

nodes.name: serialize
nodes.summary: Writes the bitmap count and each key plus Roaring bitmap to a little-endian buffer.

nodes.name: deserialize
nodes.summary: Reads a bitmap in the portable format, validating byte order and bitmap count and handling sparse keys.

nodes.name: validatePosition
nodes.summary: Ensures a position is within 0 and MAX_POSITION, throwing IllegalArgumentException otherwise.

nodes.name: newKey
nodes.summary: Validates AES key length and builds a SecretKeySpec.

nodes.name: newCipher
nodes.summary: Creates an AES/GCM/NoPadding Cipher instance, wrapping security exceptions.

nodes.name: streamBlockAAD
nodes.summary: Builds the AAD for a stream block by appending the little-endian block index to the file AAD prefix.

nodes.name: of
nodes.summary: Wraps a ByteBuffer as EncryptionKeyMetadata via BaseEncryptionKeyMetadata.

nodes.name: wrap
nodes.summary: Returns a single-buffer stream for one buffer and a multi-buffer stream otherwise.

nodes.name: skipFully
nodes.summary: Skips exactly the requested number of bytes or throws EOFException.

nodes.name: sliceStream
nodes.summary: Returns a stream over the next length bytes as zero-copy slices.

nodes.name: seek
nodes.summary: Resets the delegate and skips to the target position, throwing if the position exceeds the length.

nodes.name: readFully
nodes.summary: Copies a range from the in-memory contents into a buffer with bounds checks.

nodes.name: readTail
nodes.summary: Copies up to length bytes from the end of the contents into a buffer.

nodes.name: seek
nodes.summary: Repositions the stream by restarting from the first buffer and skipping forward.

nodes.name: skip
nodes.summary: Skips bytes across buffer boundaries, advancing to the next buffer as needed.

nodes.name: read
nodes.summary: Reads available bytes across buffers into a ByteBuffer output.

nodes.name: slice
nodes.summary: Returns a zero-copy slice of length bytes, copying only when the range crosses buffers.

nodes.name: sliceBuffers
nodes.summary: Returns the next length bytes as a list of sliced buffers and advances the position.

nodes.name: remainingBuffers
nodes.summary: Returns the unread bytes as sliced buffers by delegating to sliceBuffers, or an empty list at end of stream.

nodes.name: reset
nodes.summary: Restores stream state to the marked position using recorded buffers.

nodes.name: nextBuffer
nodes.summary: Advances to the next non-empty buffer and records it while a mark is active.

nodes.name: seek
nodes.summary: Moves the buffer position relative to the starting offset with bounds checks.

nodes.name: skip
nodes.summary: Skips up to the requested bytes within the buffer and returns the count skipped.

nodes.name: read
nodes.summary: Copies bytes from the buffer into a ByteBuffer output.

nodes.name: slice
nodes.summary: Returns a zero-copy slice of length bytes, throwing EOFException if too few remain.

nodes.name: sliceBuffers
nodes.summary: Returns the next length bytes wrapped as a single-element buffer list.

nodes.name: remainingBuffers
nodes.summary: Returns the remaining bytes as a one-buffer list and consumes them.

nodes.name: reset
nodes.summary: Restores the buffer to the marked position or fails if no mark is set.

nodes.name: fromCounter
nodes.summary: Converts a live Counter into a CounterResult, returning null for no-op counters.

nodes.name: scanReport
nodes.summary: Returns the stored report as ScanReport after checking its type.

nodes.name: commitReport
nodes.summary: Returns the stored report if it is a CommitReport, otherwise null.

nodes.name: fromTimer
nodes.summary: Converts a live Timer into a TimerResult, returning null for no-op timers.

nodes.name: FileMetadata.java
nodes.summary: Immutable holder for the footer metadata of a Puffin file: the list of blob metadata entries plus file-level string properties, defensively copied on construction.

nodes.name: FileMetadata
nodes.summary: Value class exposing blobs() and properties() for a parsed Puffin file footer; null-checks and copies inputs into immutable collections.

nodes.name: StandardPuffinProperties.java
nodes.summary: Defines the standard Puffin file property keys, currently only the created-by key identifying the writing application and version.

nodes.name: StandardPuffinProperties
nodes.summary: Final constants holder with a private constructor; exposes CREATED_BY_PROPERTY ("created-by").

nodes.name: ETagProvider.java
nodes.summary: Package-private helper that builds an HTTP ETag for a table load response by hashing the metadata location plus sorted request parameters with 32-bit Murmur3.

nodes.name: ETagProvider
nodes.summary: Static utility class that computes quoted ETag strings; not instantiable.

nodes.name: of
nodes.summary: Validates the metadata location, appends the parameters in sorted key order when present, hashes the result with Murmur3 and returns it as a quoted ETag.

nodes.name: ExponentialHttpRequestRetryStrategy.java
nodes.summary: Apache HttpClient 5 retry strategy for the REST catalog client that retries 429 and (for idempotent or Idempotency-Key requests) selected 5xx/408 responses with exponential backoff and jitter, honoring Retry-After.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements HttpRequestRetryStrategy from Apache HttpClient 5, adapted from DefaultHttpRequestRetryStrategy with exponential delay (capped at 64 seconds plus up to 10 percent jitter).

nodes.name: ExponentialHttpRequestRetryStrategy
nodes.summary: Package-private retry strategy holding max retries, non-retriable I/O exception types and retriable status code sets; decides both exception-based and response-based retries and computes the wait interval.

nodes.name: retryRequest
nodes.summary: Decides whether to retry after an I/O exception (an overload at lines 142-161 covers response-based retry): rejects when over max retries, for non-retriable exception types or cancelled requests, and otherwise retries only idempotent or Idempotency-Key requests.

nodes.name: getRetryInterval
nodes.summary: Returns the wait before the next attempt: uses a positive Retry-After header (seconds or HTTP date) when present, else exponential backoff of 1s doubling up to 64s plus random jitter.

nodes.name: shouldRetryIdempotent
nodes.summary: Returns true when the request is retry-safe (idempotent method or Idempotency-Key header) and the response code is in the idempotent retriable set.

nodes.name: ParserContext.java
nodes.summary: Carries named objects to be injected into Jackson deserialization (via InjectableValues) so REST parsers can access context such as the table's format version.

nodes.name: ParserContext
nodes.summary: Immutable map-backed context built via a Builder; converts to Jackson InjectableValues.Std and reports emptiness. Contains nested Builder with null-checked add().

nodes.name: RESTMessage.java
nodes.summary: Marker interface shared by all REST catalog requests and responses, requiring a validate() hook for objects parsed from external input.

nodes.name: RESTMessage
nodes.summary: Interface declaring validate(), which ensures a message satisfies the REST spec after it was deserialized without all required fields.

nodes.name: RESTObjectMapper.java
nodes.summary: Package-private holder of the shared Jackson ObjectMapper for the REST catalog, configured with kebab-case naming, field visibility, lenient unknown properties and Iceberg serializers.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses double-checked locking with a volatile flag for lazy, thread-safe configuration of a static ObjectMapper.

nodes.name: RESTObjectMapper
nodes.summary: Static singleton accessor class for the REST ObjectMapper; not instantiable.

nodes.name: mapper
nodes.summary: Lazily configures (once, under a lock) and returns the shared ObjectMapper, registering all REST serializers.

nodes.name: RemotePlanTimeoutException.java
nodes.summary: Runtime exception signalling that server-side scan planning did not finish before the client-side deadline.

nodes.name: RemotePlanTimeoutException
nodes.summary: Package-private RuntimeException carrying a message and cause for remote plan timeouts.

nodes.name: AuthProperties.java
nodes.summary: Constants for REST catalog authentication configuration: the auth type key and values, default auth manager implementation class names, and basic/SigV4 property keys.

nodes.name: AuthProperties
nodes.summary: Final constants holder naming auth types (none, basic, oauth2, sigv4, google), their manager implementation classes, and credential property keys.

nodes.name: HashWriter.java
nodes.summary: Writer that feeds encoded characters into a MessageDigest and discards the output, so a hash can be computed over streamed text.

nodes.name: HashWriter
nodes.summary: Writer subclass wrapping a MessageDigest and CharsetEncoder; write() updates the digest and getHash() finalizes it, after which the writer is closed.

nodes.name: getHash
nodes.summary: Finalizes and returns the digest bytes, marking the writer closed so further use throws IllegalStateException.

nodes.name: HilbertByteUtils.java
nodes.summary: Computes a Hilbert space-filling-curve index over multiple fixed-width ordered-byte columns, using Skilling's axes-to-transpose algorithm and bit interleaving for Hilbert clustering.
nodes.languageNotes: Operates on big-endian unsigned bytes and bit manipulation on longs (xor, masks, gray encoding); the output ordering follows the Hilbert curve.

nodes.name: HilbertByteUtils
nodes.summary: Static utility exposing three hilbertIndex overloads (convenience, buffer reuse, and fully allocation-free scratch reuse) plus private validation and byte conversion helpers.

nodes.name: hilbertIndex
nodes.summary: Validates inputs and scratch sizes, reads each column's leading bytes as a big-endian long, transforms axes to the transposed Hilbert index, and interleaves the bits into the reusable output buffer (shorter overloads at lines 42-66 delegate here).

nodes.name: validate
nodes.summary: Checks bitsPerColumn is a positive multiple of 8 not exceeding 64 and that at least one column is supplied.

nodes.name: axesToTranspose
nodes.summary: In-place Skilling transform converting per-axis coordinates into the transposed Hilbert index via inverse undo of excess work and Gray encoding.

nodes.name: ZOrderByteUtils.java
nodes.summary: Converts primitive, string and binary values to fixed-width, lexicographically ordered unsigned bytes and interleaves their bits to produce Z-order (Morton) keys for data clustering.
nodes.languageNotes: Relies on sign-bit flips and IEEE 754 sign-magnitude tricks to make signed and floating point values byte-comparable; uses ByteBuffer reuse to avoid allocations.

nodes.name: ZOrderByteUtils
nodes.summary: Static utility with typed *ToOrderedBytes converters, string/binary truncate-or-pad helpers and the bit interleaving routine; not instantiable.

nodes.name: intToOrderedBytes
nodes.summary: Converts an int to 8 order-preserving bytes by delegating to wholeNumberOrderedBytes.

nodes.name: longToOrderedBytes
nodes.summary: Converts a long to 8 order-preserving bytes by delegating to wholeNumberOrderedBytes.

nodes.name: shortToOrderedBytes
nodes.summary: Converts a short to 8 order-preserving bytes by delegating to wholeNumberOrderedBytes.

nodes.name: tinyintToOrderedBytes
nodes.summary: Converts a byte to 8 order-preserving bytes by delegating to wholeNumberOrderedBytes.

nodes.name: wholeNumberOrderedBytes
nodes.summary: Flips the sign bit of a long and writes it big-endian so negatives sort before positives lexicographically.

nodes.name: floatToOrderedBytes
nodes.summary: Converts a float to order-preserving bytes via floatingPointOrderedBytes.

nodes.name: doubleToOrderedBytes
nodes.summary: Converts a double to order-preserving bytes via floatingPointOrderedBytes.

nodes.name: floatingPointOrderedBytes
nodes.summary: Maps IEEE 754 double bits to lexicographically comparable bytes by xor-ing with a sign-derived mask.

nodes.name: stringToOrderedBytes
nodes.summary: Encodes a UTF-8 string into a fixed-length buffer, truncating longer values and zero-padding shorter or null ones.

nodes.name: byteTruncateOrFill
nodes.summary: Copies a byte array into a fixed-length reusable buffer, truncating or zero-filling as needed (null yields all zeros).

nodes.name: interleaveBits
nodes.summary: Interleaves the bits of all column byte arrays, round-robin from the most significant bit, into an output buffer of the requested size to form the Z-order key.

nodes.name: VariantVisitor.java

nodes.name: VariantVisitor
nodes.summary: Base visitor class with default no-op hooks and null-returning object/array/primitive callbacks, plus static visit() entry points that drive the traversal.

nodes.name: object
nodes.summary: Callback invoked after an object's fields are visited, receiving field names and their results; default returns null.

nodes.name: array

nodes.name: primitive

nodes.name: visit
nodes.summary: Recursively traverses a VariantValue (array, object or primitive), calling before/after hooks in try/finally and passing collected child results to the matching callback; the Variant overload at lines 45-47 delegates to it.

nodes.name: BaseSQLViewRepresentation
nodes.summary: Package-private interface extending SQLViewRepresentation, annotated to drive Immutables generation of ImmutableSQLViewRepresentation.

nodes.name: BaseViewHistoryEntry.java

nodes.name: BaseViewHistoryEntry
nodes.summary: Package-private interface extending ViewHistoryEntry with Immutables style settings producing a public immutable type and builder.

nodes.name: BaseViewVersion.java

nodes.name: BaseViewVersion

layers.name: Public Table API
layers.description: Public interfaces consumers use to work with tables: Table, Transaction, the PendingUpdate family (AppendFiles, RowDelta, ExpireSnapshots and others), events and listeners, and the Iceberg exception hierarchy.

layers.name: Type System and Variants
layers.description: Iceberg data types, nested type visitors, field-id name mapping, schema visitors, plus variant values and geospatial bounds.

layers.name: Expressions and Transforms
layers.description: Expression tree, binding, predicate evaluators and projections, partition transforms, and space-filling-curve helpers used to prune data.

layers.name: Table Metadata Model
layers.description: Immutable table metadata (schema, partition spec, sort order, snapshots, refs), its JSON parsers, metadata updates and requirements, table properties and table operations.

layers.name: Manifests and Content Files
layers.description: Data and delete file descriptors, manifest and manifest list readers and writers by spec version, V4 tracked files, and delete files, deletion vectors and position delete indexes.

layers.name: Scan Planning and Metadata Tables
layers.description: Table scan interfaces and implementations, file scan tasks, delete file indexing, incremental and changelog scans, task splitting, and the read-only metadata tables.

layers.name: Commit and Snapshot Operations
layers.description: Snapshot producers, append, overwrite, row delta and rewrite operations, transactions, schema and spec updates, snapshot expiration and file cleanup.

layers.name: Table Maintenance Actions
layers.description: Action interfaces and base implementations for table maintenance such as rewriting files, manifests and table paths, and expiring snapshots.

tour.title: What Is a Table
tour.description: Iceberg is a library, so the tour starts with the public contract. Table is the central interface: it exposes metadata (schemas, specs, sort orders, snapshots, refs), scan factories, update builders, transactions and the IO, encryption and location providers. BaseTable is the standard implementation that wires a MetricsReporter into every scan and update it creates, and Catalog is the entry point that creates and loads tables by TableIdentifier.

tour.title: Schemas, Types and Partition Specs
tour.description: Everything a table stores is described by the type system. Type is the root interface and Types defines every concrete type as a nested class, including NestedField, variant, geometry and geography. Schema is a struct of typed columns that carry ids, and PartitionSpec describes how partition data is derived from those columns through transforms. Later steps (metadata, manifests, scan pruning) all speak in these terms.

tour.title: TableMetadata: The Source of Truth
tour.description: TableMetadata is the immutable core model of a table: schemas, specs, sort orders, snapshots, refs, properties, logs and encryption keys. Its large mutable Builder records MetadataUpdate changes, which is how a local change can later be replayed against a REST server, and TableMetadataParser handles the JSON layout per format version. TableProperties collects the keys and defaults that tune behavior.

tour.title: TableOperations: The Catalog SPI
tour.description: TableOperations is the central SPI a catalog implements to give a table its current metadata, refresh and an atomic commit, plus its FileIO, EncryptionManager and LocationProvider. This is the seam that lets Table code stay independent of where metadata lives. StaticTableOperations shows the simplest case: a read-only operations object pinned to one metadata file.

tour.title: Snapshots, Branches and Tags
tour.description: A Snapshot is the public view of one committed state of the table: ids, sequence number, timestamp, operation, summary and its manifests. BaseSnapshot loads those manifests lazily from the manifest list through a FileIO, SnapshotRef names a branch or tag pointing at a snapshot with optional retention settings, and SnapshotSummary defines the per-commit summary keys and the builder that fills them.

tour.title: Manifest Lists, Manifests and Content Files
tour.description: A snapshot points to a manifest list, whose entries (ManifestFile) point to manifests, whose entries (ManifestEntry) carry DataFile or DeleteFile descriptors. ManifestFiles is the central API for reading and writing manifests across format versions, while ManifestReader applies projection and partition and row filters, and ManifestListWriter has per-version writers for V1 to V4. DeleteFile also covers deletion vectors.

tour.title: Expressions and Transforms for Pruning
tour.description: Filters are modeled as an Expression tree built through the Expressions factory, bound to a schema by Binder and evaluated row by row by Evaluator. Transform maps source values to partition values and projects row predicates to partition predicates, and ManifestEvaluator and InclusiveMetricsEvaluator use partition summaries and file metrics to skip whole manifests or files without reading them.

tour.title: Scan Planning
tour.description: TableScan is the refinement-style interface for configuring snapshot, ref and time-travel reads. DataTableScan plans FileScanTasks by grouping manifests through ManifestGroup, which filters manifests and entries, applies residuals and optionally runs in parallel, while DeleteFileIndex resolves which position, equality and DV deletes apply to each data file. BaseTableScan and TableScanUtil then split and bin-pack the tasks.

tour.title: The Commit Path: Snapshot Producers
tour.description: Writes go through PendingUpdate, whose apply() previews a change and commit() persists it. SnapshotProducer is the abstract base for every operation that creates a snapshot: it builds the manifest list, retries, cleans up uncommitted files and notifies listeners. MergingSnapshotProducer sits behind overwrites, row deltas and rewrites and provides the concurrent-commit validation helpers, while FastAppend skips manifest merging for quick appends.

tour.title: Transactions and Schema Evolution
tour.description: Transaction batches several updates into one atomic commitTransaction call, and BaseTransaction implements it by applying pending updates to in-memory metadata and committing as a create, replace or simple transaction with retries. UpdateSchema and its SchemaUpdate implementation show a non-snapshot update that records column changes and applies them to produce a new schema.

tour.title: Catalog Implementations
tour.description: BaseMetastoreCatalog is the scaffolding for metastore-backed catalogs: it loads tables, registers them and provides a TableBuilder for create and replace transactions. Concrete catalogs differ in where the metadata pointer lives: HadoopCatalog uses directories and atomic rename, JdbcCatalog uses relational tables, and InMemoryCatalog keeps everything in concurrent maps for tests. CatalogUtil loads implementations reflectively from configuration.

tour.title: The REST Catalog
tour.description: RESTCatalog delegates every operation to RESTSessionCatalog, the core client of the REST protocol, which configures authentication, issues HTTP calls through RESTClient and HTTPClient, and caches loaded tables. RESTTableOperations commits by sending UpdateTableRequests with computed requirements, and RESTTableScan can delegate planning to the server. On the server side, CatalogHandlers turn requests into calls on a backing Catalog.

tour.title: File IO, Formats and Encryption
tour.description: FileIO is the pluggable abstraction for creating input and output files and deleting files, and FileAppender is the common writer contract. Avro is the entry point for manifest and metadata files, FormatModelRegistry maps a file format to readers and writers, and EncryptionManager plus StandardEncryptionManager add envelope encryption with keys wrapped by a KMS. AesGcmInputStream decrypts block-framed data on the fly.

tour.title: Metrics, Puffin and Variants
tour.description: MetricsReporter receives ScanReport and CommitReport objects, and ScanMetrics holds the counters and planning timer behind a scan. Puffin is the entry point for the blob-based statistics file format, and BaseDVFileWriter uses it to write deletion vectors. The variants package models semi-structured values: Variant pairs a metadata dictionary with a value, and Variants is the factory for building them.

tour.title: Table Maintenance Actions
tour.description: Maintenance is exposed as Action interfaces such as RewriteDataFiles, RewriteManifests and ExpireSnapshots, with Action as the root contract. The core module supplies the engine-neutral parts: BinPackRewriteFilePlanner groups files into size-based bins, BaseCommitService commits finished rewrite groups in batches for partial progress, and RemoveSnapshots expires snapshots and deletes files that become unreachable.
